* Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship.
* Drive adoption of best practices in reliability and observability across engineering teams.
* Build and maintain automation that reduces manual, repetitive operational work across the team.
* Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

  

* Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system.
* SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions.
* Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS, GCP or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing).

* Experience with AI tolls (building SRE skills, root cause analysis agents deployed in production systems etc.) is required
* 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience.


**About You**
 You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas.
   

  

 ‌

 Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.

description:

**Position Overview**
 Technical Program Manager – AI\-Enabled Engineering Pods
   

  

 Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud \& AI Engineering
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Experience Required: Minimum 14\+ years of experience
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned
 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead and manage multiple cross\-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands\-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud\-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive\-level reporting.
   

  

 This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade\-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI\-enabled delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud\-native, and enterprise\-grade digital applications.
* Own end\-to\-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.


**Technical Program Management**
* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.


**AI \& Gen AI Enablement**
* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise\-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI\-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI\-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI\-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.


**Agile, DevSecOps \& Release Governance**
* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.


**Stakeholder \& Executive Communication**
* Provide clear, concise, and data\-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO\-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade\-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 14\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross\-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud\-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git\-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.


**Preferred Technical Capabilities**
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance\-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.


**AI Platform Expectations**
 The candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
   

  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI\-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership\-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems - CTI MD Tech (LRL)
AI Platform Administrator
description:
The AI Platform Administrator is responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, deployment, and governance of the organization's Large Language Model landscape, spanning both offline or self\-hosted (on\-premise or public/private cloud) models and paid or commercial LLM services such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other enterprise AI platforms.
   

  

 This person is the primary point of contact for AI platform operations, user enablement, licensing, consumption monitoring, policy enforcement, risk management, and AI service optimization. The role works closely with IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to maximize business value from AI investments while minimizing operational and regulatory risks.
   

  

 The role is platform\-agnostic in scope and applicable across AMETEK’s broader AI ecosystem, including Generative AI, Machine Learning platforms, AI Assistants, AI Agents, Knowledge Systems, and AI\-powered business applications, with current focus on Microsoft 365 Copilot and related commercial LLM services.
   

  

**Administration**
**Roles and Responsibilities:**
* Deploy, configure, and maintain offline/self\-hosted or on\-premises LLMs on local servers, private or public cloud, or air\-gapped environments.
* Manage model installation, version upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management for all self\-hosted AI models.
* Optimize infrastructure (GPU/CPU, memory, storage) for performance, scalability, and cost\-efficiency of locally hosted models.
* Configure and maintain model access controls, authentication, and integration with internal applications and APIs.
* Perform regular health checks, backups, and disaster recovery planning for offline AI environments.
* Manage subscriptions, accounts, and API access for paid/commercial LLMs (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and similar enterprise platforms).
* Provision and de\-provision user access, API keys, and workspace permissions across all paid LLM platforms.
* Coordinate with vendors on contract renewals, tiered plans, feature rollouts, and support escalations.
* Ensure integration of paid LLM services with enterprise applications, chatbots, and internal tools via APIs and connectors.
* Stay current on new model releases, pricing changes, and feature updates from commercial LLM vendors.


**Tracking And Governance**
* Establish and maintain a centralized inventory \& dashboard of all LLM licenses, subscriptions, and API keys (offline and paid) across the organization.
* Continuously monitor usage metrics (tokens consumed, API calls, active seats/users, compute hours) for each LLM platform.
* Track license utilization against entitlements to identify underused, overused, or idle licenses, and recommend right\-sizing.
* Define and enforce governance policies for AI/LLM usage, including acceptable use, data handling, and access approval workflows.
* Set up automated alerts and periodic reports for usage thresholds, budget overruns, and anomalous consumption patterns.
* Conduct periodic license audits and reconciliation against vendor invoices and contracts.
* Maintain documentation of usage policies, entitlements, renewal dates, and compliance requirements for each LLM.
* Partner with Finance to forecast, budget, and optimize spend on paid LLM subscriptions.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT policies, data protection regulations, and applicable AI governance standards.


 User Enablement and Training
   

  

* Develop and maintain user onboarding materials, quick\-start guides, and training content for AI platform adoption.
* Deliver training sessions and internal communications to drive awareness and responsible use of AI tools.
* Serve as the first point of contact for end\-user questions on licensing, access, and platform capabilities.


**Reporting**
* Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards to IT leadership on LLM usage, license utilization, cost trends, and governance compliance.
* Recommend and drive process improvements, automation, and tooling to streamline LLM administration and governance.
* Evaluate emerging LLM platforms and tools and provide recommendations on adoption or migration.


**Experience**
**Candidate Requirements:**
* 10\+ years of overall IT administration and systems/application administration experience, including at least 4 years focused on AI/ML platform management.


**Required Skills**
* Hands\-on experience managing self\-hosted or offline LLM deployment and paid/commercial LLM platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini).
* Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps for provisioning workflows.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for hosting offline models.
* Proficient scripting skills (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for automation of monitoring and reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision\-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs.


**Qualifications**

And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.   We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Zelis is modernizing its infrastructure estate — migrating workloads to AWS and Azure, consolidating data centers, and re\-platforming the network for a cloud\-first, high\-availability future. We are hiring a Senior Network Engineer in Hyderabad to help lead this transformation from the ground up: designing and operating resilient network architectures across on\-premises data centers and hybrid cloud, executing complex migration and consolidation cutovers, and keeping a healthcare\-grade environment secure, observable, and always on.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on senior role for an engineer who can own technically demanding work end to end — architecture through troubleshooting — drive it independently to closure, and partner closely with stakeholders across both the US and India organizations in a matrixed, follow\-the\-sun operating model.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud modernization \& hybrid connectivity**
* Design and deliver hybrid and cloud network architectures across AWS and Azure — VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway/Virtual WAN, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, VPN, DNS, and segmentation — aligned to the cloud modernization roadmap.
* Build connectivity between on\-premises data centers and cloud landing zones, ensuring performance, redundancy, and secure east\-west and north\-south traffic flows.
* Codify the network as infrastructure — authoring and reviewing Terraform and Ansible so cloud and hybrid network changes are repeatable, versioned, and auditable.


**Data center consolidation \& migration**
* Plan and execute network cutovers for data center consolidation and workload migration — discovery, dependency mapping, low\-level design, migration runbooks, and rollback plans.
* Lead cutover events including out\-of\-hours change windows, coordinating validation and hyper\-care with application, cloud, and infrastructure teams across sites.
* Refactor and decommission legacy DC network components (routing, switching, firewall rules, load\-balancer configs, IP space) as sites are consolidated, retiring technical debt safely.


**Network engineering \& operations**
* Design, implement, and operate enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VXLAN/EVPN), data center fabric (Cisco Nexus/ACI or equivalent), SD\-WAN, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Own complex troubleshooting as an escalation point for high\-severity and cross\-domain network incidents — driving root\-cause analysis, resolution, and prevention with minimal supervision.
* Strengthen resilience and security through segmentation, zero\-trust principles, and hardening consistent with healthcare compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, PCI\-DSS) and Zelis standards.


**Observability, automation \& continuous improvement**
* Improve visibility using monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, NetFlow, SNMP, Datadog) with actionable alerting and dashboards.
* Automate recurring work — configuration management, compliance checks, and remediation — using Python, Ansible, and CI/CD to reduce manual effort and change risk.
* Maintain standards — up\-to\-date designs, runbooks, and diagrams (HLD/LLD) — and contribute to network standards, patterns, and best practices.


**Collaboration \& stakeholder engagement**
* Partner across US and India stakeholders — cloud, DevOps, SRE, IT operations, security, and application teams — in a matrixed, follow\-the\-sun model, ensuring smooth handoffs and shared context.
* Drive work independently translating ambiguous requirements into clear plans, sequencing tasks, and delivering to timelines without close oversight.
* Communicate clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders — status, risk, and impact — and mentor junior engineers on the team.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering experience, including a senior/lead role on medium\-to\-large environments.
* Deep, demonstrable expertise in routing and switching — BGP, OSPF, VLANs, spanning tree, and multicast — with strong fundamentals in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and NAT.
* Proven data center networking experience (Cisco Nexus/ACI, Arista, or equivalent) and hands\-on hybrid cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure (VPC/VNet, Transit Gateway/vWAN, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, VPN, security groups/NSGs).
* Hands\-on experience with firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco Firepower/ASA, or Fortinet), load balancers (F5 or equivalent), and SD\-WAN.
* Direct experience delivering data center migration and/or consolidation projects, including cutover planning and execution during change windows.
* Practical network automation skills — Python and/or Ansible — and working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and Git\-based workflows.
* Strong, independent troubleshooting ability across the network stack, with a structured root\-cause approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of collaborating across geographically distributed (US/India) teams and time zones.
* Design hybrid\-cloud networking solutions connecting AWS, on\-premises data centers, and third\-party providers.
* Leverage Megaport and similar cloud interconnection platforms to provide scalable and resilient connectivity.
* Drive network automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and Git.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, and cloud networking certifications (AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate).
* Experience with VXLAN/EVPN fabrics, zero\-trust / micro segmentation, and DNS/IPAM platforms (e.g., Infoblox).
* Familiarity with observability at scale (Logic Monitor, New Relic, Datadog) and ITSM/change\-management practices (Jira Service Management).
* Exposure to regulated environments (healthcare, payments, or financial services) and associated compliance controls.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to standards, design reviews, or communities of practice.


**Core Competencies**
* Ownership \& drive — takes tasks to closure independently and proactively removes blockers.
* Technical depth \& troubleshooting — strong first\-principles problem solving under pressure.
* Collaboration — builds trust and works effectively across a US–India matrix.
* Clear communication — concise, accurate, and audience\-aware.
* Continuous improvement — automates, documents, and raises the standard of the environment.


**Education \& Work Details**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics/Communications, or a related field
* Location \& model: Hyderabad, India; hybrid with sustained overlap into US business hours to support the follow\-the\-sun operating model.
* On\-call: Participation in an on\-call/change\-window rotation for high\-severity incidents and planned migration/cutover events.

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Microsoft Fabric, the Data Integration team enables organizations to connect, move, and shape data across their entire data estate. As data is generated across applications, devices, and systems, our integration capabilities make it easy to ingest, transform, and prepare data for downstream use. Fabric’s unified integration experience simplifies how customers bring data together, ensuring it is trusted, usable, and ready to power analytics, real\-time insights, and AI scenarios.
   

  

 The Customer Data Integration (CDI) organization within Power Query is building a new Live site engineering team that serves as the first line of defense for one of Microsoft's most critical data integration services. You will own incident triage and response across Power BI, Fabric, Power Query Online, Gateway, and hundreds of data connectors, and you will build the agentic automation that makes that operation increasingly self\-driving.
   

  

 This is not a passive monitoring role. You will be on call, triaging real incidents, and ensuring uptime for business\-critical services. You will simultaneously build the intelligent agents, automation pipelines, and tooling that reduce manual effort with every iteration. Your goal is to make yourself more effective over time by engineering your way out of repetitive work.
   

  

 We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Incident triage and first\-line response: Provide on\-call coverage for incoming incidents across CDI services. Perform initial investigation, severity assessment, and routing to owning engineering teams.
* Agentic triage system development: Build and extend AI\-driven agents that ingest ICM alerts, correlate with recent deployments and feature flag rollouts, check known\-issue databases, and produce initial assessments with suggested severity and owning team.
* TSG and known\-issue matching: Develop automation that matches incoming incidents to relevant Troubleshooting Guides (TSGs) and known issues across Fabric and Power Platform — reducing investigation time and enabling faster resolution.


 Auto\-routing and classification: Configure and extend ICM routing rules and build intelligent classification systems based on service tree, alert signatures, and historical patterns.
   

  

* Incident lifecycle automation: Build agents for incident summarization, customer communications drafting, postmortem generation, and reporting, replacing manual authoring with AI\-assisted workflows requiring human judgment only for high\-severity incidents.
* Metrics and continuous improvement: Measure and improve first\-time mitigation (FTM) rates, incident deflection rates, and time\-to\-triage. Use data to identify patterns, propose new TSGs, and drive systemic improvements.
* CSS quality bar: Defend the standard for incoming escalations by enforcing organizational and process standards
* Embody our culture and values

The role requires the leader to operate cross\-mile, partnering with multiple operations and support function’s leaders, along with influencing the stakeholders for SLP specific problem solving.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Overall the role will have following key areas of work for assigned territory and facilities;
   

  

* End to end responsibility of security operations: Physical security is the key aspect of LP specialist II role for the sites assigned to the leader. This includes, i) guarding services management with headcount management, standard work allocation, control room monitoring and performance management of the work force through Specter, and ii) security assets and system’s management to ensure serviceability, requires accesses control and monitoring maintenance and upkeep supporting businesses’ need. Managing above two will require the leader to collaborate with physical security program, technical and vendor teams.
* Site Audits and Certifications: For the cluster of facilities, the role leader is responsible to perform frequent audits with standard binary and also partner with respective site/operations to remediate the defects identified in audits to reduce risk. To support operations, it is critical that we assign leader who will drive required certifications for the sites from security POV and influence operations to get the site compliant for day to day secured processes.
* Process Improvement \& Loss Prevention: LP specialist II is entrusted with controlling shrink and preventing losses, through proactive identification of process violation during audits and floor patrolling and analyzing the trend and collaborating with operations to design corrective mechanisms, to mitigate process violation is critical for this role to reduce continuous defects. The role also requires the leader to identify required tech/ system interventions to make the process improvement scalable across network for long term and provide inputs to solutions.
* Investigations and Actions: Interventional investigation of theft, fraud and customer abuse in network is another important area that SLP


 specialist II will support while accessing the video surveillance evidence and coordinating for local law enforcement recommendations. Identifying the key MOs, while conducting the trend analysis for the sites handled and diving deep into the data to analyze the patterns. The investigation findings play a critical role in driving ECR and buyer escalations as well.
   

  

* Crisis and Incident Management: With dynamic geo\-political environment, LP specialist II is required to periodically evaluate internal and external risk, implement mitigation measure to ensure business continuity. The leader is required to collaborate with stakeholders and operate at multiple level to devise immediate solutions at the time of crisis and front lead the guidance for site to handle crisis and incident situations, as per WWOS standards.

The will require the leader to build strategic and holistic business lens on identifying the right structure, hotly debated topics, representing the required dive deep and partnering with multiple field and program leaders.

* 10\+ years of law enforcement or security\-related experience
* Experience in law enforcement or a security\-related profession

* Experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis, formulae, and data visualization

description:
**Job Summary** 
**:**
 The Senior SAP Security Analyst is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining industry\-leading SAP security architecture and controls. This role works collaboratively with IT and business teams to safeguard SAP business systems, ensure appropriate access governance, and support secure, compliant operations across the SAP landscape.
   

  

 The Senior SAP Security Analyst also serves as a subject matter expert, providing guidance, knowledge transfer, and training to IT and business stakeholders on SAP security best practices, access controls, and compliance requirements.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
* Manage daily SAP security operations while supporting project delivery and strategic initiatives.
* Prioritize, coordinate, and assign tasks related to change management, incident management, and access support activities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional IT teams to promote effective communication, issue resolution, and alignment across projects.
* Deploy, monitor, test, and optimize security and identity access management best practices within the SAP environment.
* Own and support SAP cybersecurity audit controls, identity policy compliance, and operational efficiency improvements across identity environments.
* Partner with security support teams to streamline daily monitoring activities and evaluate the effectiveness of operational processes.
* Contribute to and support SAP security, identity management, and access governance functions across operational and project workstreams.
* Prepare required reports and ensure policies and procedures are maintained to support SOX compliance requirements.
* Gather business security requirements to manage and control SAP data access and network authorization requirements.
* Research, recommend, and develop security and risk mitigation solutions that strengthen the organization’s SAP control environment.
* Ensure SAP accounts are disabled, reviewed, and cleaned up in accordance with established policies and procedures.
* Ensure audit requirements are met for all SAP security access and related control activities.
* Maintain ownership of assigned security incidents, including timely communication, documentation, and resolution tracking.
* Create SAP user accounts and assign approved access in accordance with business requirements and access governance standards.
* Perform user maintenance activities across systems managed by Information Technology.
* Maintain SAP rulebook and mitigating controls in partnership with business stakeholders.
* Update and maintain documentation as changes are made to SAP groups, roles, and access structures.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture teams to define and maintain security\-related technology standards.
* Understand relevant underlying technologies and applications to guide the design, development, and implementation of technology requirements.
* Stay current on emerging technologies, practices, and policies that may enhance capabilities, service quality, and the company’s security posture.


**Education And Experience Profile**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in SAP Security Architecture, with a strong focus on SAP ECC.
* Strong understanding of SAP security concepts, role design, GRC, and compliance management.
* Experience with SAP HANA, S/4HANA, and Fiori security models is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to information security and data protection, including ISO 27001, GDPR, and SOX.
* SAP Security and/or GRC certifications are preferred.


**Required Skills**
* Hands\-on working knowledge of SAP IDM and/or other identity and access management solutions.
* Advanced Security experience with SAP GRC and/or related SAP tools, including SAP ECC, MDG, and Solution Manager.
* Experience supporting complex SAP troubleshooting, mitigation, and resolution activities in a global organization.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and engage stakeholders across multiple functional areas.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and high standards.


**Work Environment** 
**:**
* Work is performed in a standard office environment with a hybrid work model.
* Work hours may need to accommodate global time zones, operational needs, and team meetings as required.

title: Trade Surveillance Analyst
description:
Our India Compliance team works closely with our Trading and Technology teams to manage the regulatory risks of our trading activities in India. As a Surveillance Analyst at IMC, you will assist with our day\-to\-day surveillance operations, monitoring and review of Internal and exchange generated alerts. Your role will cover many different aspects of IMC’s compliance program, requiring you to work with people across all areas of the business. This role will report into Head of Compliance\- India.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Investigating and resolving trade surveillance alerts across market abuse typologies including spoofing, layering, ramping, marking the close, wash trading, and insider trading indicators.
* Monitor and investigate market surveillance alerts and electronic communications to identify potential market abuse risks and provide recommendations to enhance pre\- and post\-trade controls (and our surveillance platforms).
* Managing alert queues, ensuring timely investigation, escalation to Compliance Officer and closure of alerts
* Regular review of parameters and calibrating surveillance alert parameters as new markets, strategies, and products come online
* Record keeping and preparing reports for internal approvals and regulatory submissions.
* Experience in designing or calibrating surveillance alerts from scratch.
* Driving data analysis and reporting in support of broader compliance team needs.
* Experience with Multi\-class surveillance like equities , derivatives or commodities is preferred.
* Collaborate with Compliance, Trading and Tech Teams.
* Collaborate with internal developers and vendor teams.
* Contribute to the design of alert specifications and maintain clear documentation
* Communicating with regional compliance teams on global issues and projects.
* Comfort working with large data sets
* Working knowledge of SEBI and Exchange regulations
* Experience with Excel\-based data analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, macros)
* Promoting IMC’s Compliance culture, awareness of regulatory developments, and best practices within the business.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 2 to 4 years of experience in financial markets surveillance in India at a Trading Firm, Broker, Regulator, Exchange, or similar role.
* Degree qualified in Finance, Business, Law, or a related discipline.
* Experience in trade surveillance and market abuse detection is essential, with a strong preference for candidates who have investigated alerts involving manipulative practices such as spoofing, layering, ramping or wash trading.
* Familiarity with trade surveillance systems, whether in\-house tools or third\-party platforms (such as OneTick, SMARTS, NICE Actimize, Trading Technologies or First Derivatives) is highly regarded.
* Understanding of proprietary trading and market making business models is an advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and analytical/ problem solving skills.
* Strong interpersonal, organisational, and time management skills.
* Ability to work both independently and in teams.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas or concepts clearly.
* Willing to learn and take responsibility for required tasks and projects.


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

 Hitachi Energy is the world leader in Power Quality Solutions (PQS). Hitachi Energy was the first to introduce Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) technology to the power industry and has delivered solutions for more than 50 years now. Hitachi energy has several solutions that enhance the security, capacity, and flexibility of power transmission systems. These solutions enable power grid owners to increase existing transmission network capacity while maintaining or improving the operating margins necessary for grid stability.  Hitachi Energy has the full FACTS portfolio and in\-house manufacturing of key components. Our PQS R\&D group in Chennai is focusing on developing and evaluating functionalities for STATCOM, STATIC VAR Compensator (SVC), Series Compensator and Synchronous Condensers for utilities and industries. * To perform validation testing of the whole FACTS system in a hardware in loop environment with real time digital simulator setup. (ex: RTDS interfaced with MACH system)

 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Applies acquired job skills to work on tasks that are semi\-routine in nature. Focus is on semi\-routine tasks within standard operating procedures. Supports the overall team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Queue Management / Reporting
   

  

* Reviews work order requests in the queue and responds to semi\-routine work orders by adhering to commitment times
* Escalates and expedites orders to appropriate teams upon standard operating procedures; supervision needed on the escalation of nonstandard procedure escalation requests
* Ensures adherence to commit times within standard operating procedures
* Maintains detailed written records of all work activity
* Updates local asset databases and other systems


 Installations
   

  

* Rack and stack semi\-routine customer equipment tickets
* Supports intra\-cage infrastructure installations by following the standard operating procedures of semi\-routine customer installs, which may include:
+ fiber trays, ladder racks, customer equipment and cabinets
+ semi\-basic cage installs for mesh and overhead cable trays
+ performs tape changes and standard operating back\-up changes


 Cross\-Connect
   

  

* Supports semi\-routine data center standard operating cross\-connect work order requests (installs, terminations, modifications, and testing)

* Learns to install 'across' connect circuits (switched, multiplexed, etc.), under supervision


 Testing / Troubleshooting
   

  

* Supports semi\-routine standard operating testing and standard operating installations of customer assets

 Projects

description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
   

  

 Requisition ID: 77772
   

  

**About Skyworks**
 If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high\-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
   

  

 Skyworks offers the industry’s broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best\-in\-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick\-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The IC Validation team leads all post\-silicon activities, including chip bring\-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre\-silicon design to post\-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world\-class products to our customers.
   

  

 We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
* Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring\-up, validation, and characterization.
* Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs.
* Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
* Lead the design and development of high\-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization.
* Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization.
* Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts.
* Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports.
* Own post\-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering with 5\+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s with 3 years of experience.
* Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
* Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
* Extensive hands\-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc.)
* Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
* Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
* Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, .NET preferred, or similar)
* Experience with test frameworks and data analysis tools (JMP, MATLAB, or equivalent)
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross\-functional teams


 Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Sr. Associate I, Software Engineering (Systems Analyst)
description:
**Summary of Position:**
 We are seeking a highly organized and analytical
 **Systems Analyst** 
 to support Digital Health programs by driving operational excellence, system governance, process optimization, and project financial oversight. This role serves as a bridge between Engineering, Product, QA, Operations, and Business stakeholders, ensuring effective tracking, reporting, and coordination across multiple initiatives.
   

  

 The Engineering Systems Analyst will be responsible for maintaining project visibility through Jira and Confluence, analyzing operational and financial metrics, supporting governance processes, and enabling data\-driven decision\-making across Digital Health programs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Business \& Systems Analysis**
* Analyze business and operational processes to identify improvement opportunities and support delivery objectives.
* Gather, document, and maintain business requirements, process workflows, and system\-related documentation.
* Develop reports, dashboards, and metrics to provide visibility into project health, risks, and delivery performance.


**Project Financial \& Operational Analysis**
* Track project budgets, forecasts, and actual expenditures across Digital Health initiatives.
* Monitor spending trends and identify budget variances, risks, and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Support preparation of financial and operational reports for leadership reviews.
* Maintain visibility into project\-related operational expenses, subscriptions, licenses, and vendor costs.
* Assist in annual planning, budgeting cycles, and periodic financial reviews.


**Project Governance \& Engineering Tools Administration**
* Drive Jira governance by ensuring epics, stories, tasks, and sprint boards are accurately maintained and aligned with program objectives.
* Monitor project dashboards and key delivery metrics, ensuring timely updates on status, ownership, priorities, and completion.
* Maintain Confluence spaces, project documentation, meeting notes, decision logs, release documentation, and status reports.
* Support release readiness reviews, dependency management, and risk tracking activities.
* Ensure adherence to governance standards, documentation practices, and engineering processes.


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, and governance forums.
* Coordinate action items, dependencies, risks, and escalations across teams.


**Continuous Improvement \& Operational Excellence**
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, project tracking, reporting, and governance.
* Support implementation of automation, workflow improvements, and operational best practices.
* Drive adoption of standardized processes, templates, and collaboration tools across teams.


**Key Responsibilities/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or Master’s in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field with 5\-7 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, project governance, and operational reporting.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar project collaboration tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with budget tracking, expense management, and financial reporting.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience supporting Digital Health, Healthcare Technology, or Engineering organizations.
* Knowledge of software delivery lifecycle, release management, and project governance frameworks.
* Familiarity with procurement, vendor management, and financial approval processes.
* Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.
* Exposure to portfolio management, resource planning, and PMO practices.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Accurate visibility into project delivery, financial performance, and operational metrics.
* Well\-governed Jira and Confluence environments supporting effective engineering execution.
* Timely identification and escalation of risks, dependencies, and budget variances.
* Improved efficiency through streamlined processes, reporting, and operational controls.
* Strong stakeholder confidence and recognition as a trusted partner for engineering operations and delivery governance.
* Consistent support for successful project execution across Digital Health programs.

title: Staff SW Engineer
description:
**Description**
 At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network\-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
   

  

 As a Staff Software Engineer – Automation Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain the automation test infrastructure that underpins Gigamon’s continuous build, test, and delivery ecosystem. You will work closely with development and QA teams to build tools, frameworks, and dashboards that improve product quality and accelerate release cycles. In this highly technical role, you will own key automation components end\-to\-end—from requirements gathering and design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing support. You will have the opportunity to work with network visibility products and modern automation technologies, directly impacting engineering efficiency and product delivery.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain web dashboards to represent build and test metrics such as execution progress, pass/fail status, and trend analysis.
* Implement and enhance test automation frameworks and supporting libraries (e.g., controlling DUTs, test sets, lab equipment, and packet manipulation) to automate complex test scenarios.
* Design, implement, and maintain continuous delivery and automation tools and dashboards using Python, GUI frameworks, and database systems.
* Integrate automation test frameworks into the engineering build and continuous integration environment using Jenkins.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams to gather requirements, design solutions, implement, deploy, enhance, and maintain automation tools and infrastructure.
* Provide front\-line support for failed test environments and test execution frameworks, including debugging, failure analysis, and issue resolution.
* Contribute to improving the sustainability, reliability, and scalability of tools and operations within the continuous build and test platform.


**What You’ve Done**
* Earned a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Accumulated 4\+ years of work experience in developing and/or designing automation test frameworks and automation reporting tools.
* Gained 2\+ years of experience with front\-end and back\-end programming or scripting languages such as Python, TCL, and C\#, including exposure to SQL databases and backend API development; experience with Flask is preferred.
* Developed and consumed REST APIs and built or supported web\-based applications using HTML and related web technologies.
* Worked effectively within rapid, overlapping product release cycles in a deadline\-driven environment.
* (Nice to have) Worked with network protocols and network products in test or development environments.
* (Nice to have) Gained working knowledge of VMware ESX and virtual machine system administration.
* (Nice to have) Built experience with Linux and/or Windows system administration and with software build, configuration integration, and engineering tools.


**Who You Are**
* A self\-starter who is highly self\-motivated, organized, and able to work autonomously to solve complex problems under time pressure.

* Detail\-oriented and disciplined, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple simultaneous tasks.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!
   

  

 Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi\-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
   

  

 Life @ Skillz
   

  

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well\-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) \& company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.


 Why Skillz?
   

  

* Pioneers of Skill\-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill\-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T\-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.


 The Future of Gaming Awaits!
   

  

 The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest\-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025\. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Own the Blackout Bingo LiveOps calendar end to end — events, tournaments, promotions and the limited\-time\-offer slate — as the single accountable operator for the game.
* Be accountable for the three ratified KPIs on the surface: incremental NGR per campaign (holdout\-audited), event margin (collection vs prizes), and the count of events running at negative margin.
* Lead the Blackout Bingo LiveOps line — the Senior Associate today and the Associate bench as it lands — setting standards, developing the team and hiring into it.
* Design and configure campaigns directly: segments, entry\-fee tiers, prize curves, schedules, eligibility and guardrails, in the admin portal and in CleverTap.
* Tune the slate to Blackout Bingo's own economy — entry\-fee distribution, session profile, tail composition and marquee rhythm — rather than inheriting a shared calendar.
* Hold offer discipline on the surface: 30% standard bonus cap, same\-day bonus decay, wallet\-balance gating and net\-winner exclusions; prevent LTO stacking across Daily, Weekend and Filler offers.
* Reserve holdouts at send time and run experiments end to end — hypothesis, segment, control, read — retiring what does not earn its incentive cost.
* Deliver the tail live\-event tier, zonal identity events and month\-long merch events on Blackout Bingo as the economy rebalance rolls out.
* Own the Blackout Bingo line in the weekly LiveOps Review and the per\-venue scorecard commentary: what moved, why, and what happens next.
* Partner with Product on capability and roadmap, Analytics on measurement and independent scoring, Lifecycle CRM on messaging, and Launch GTM on feature adoption.
* Contribute to the Game LiveOps operating model alongside Indrani G as the function scales.


**Key Competencies**
* Owns a number, not a calendar — reasons in event margin and incremental NGR, and can tell the difference between a campaign that worked and one that ran during a good week.
* Economy sense — understands that an offer is a cost, and reasons about prize curves, collection versus prizes and net deposits rather than participation counts.
* Hands\-on operating detail — comfortable in campaign tooling and configuration, and precise about eligibility rules and guardrails. A build\-and\-run role, not a briefing role.
* People leadership — has managed or closely mentored operators, sets standards rather than approving individual campaigns, and can hire and develop a small bench.
* Experiment discipline — reserves the holdout before the send, defines the read before launch, and accepts a null result.
* Willing to kill a popular event — can retire a well\-liked but negative\-margin event and explain why to players, Product and their own team.
* Peer\-level presence — can hold a position against Product and Analytics without a reporting line, and be the accountable voice for the surface in a room of senior stakeholders.
* Clear written communication — weekly commentary that says what moved, why, and what happens next.


**Experience**
* 6–10 years in LiveOps, game operations, product marketing, promotions or growth operations for a consumer mobile product, including full ownership of an events and offers calendar for a live title at scale.
* People leadership — has managed at least one or two operators directly, or has a clear and evidenced step\-up into a management line (setting standards, reviewing work, developing others).
* Real\-money gaming, online gambling, fantasy sports, fintech or a mid\-core F2P title with a deep in\-game economy strongly preferred. Bingo, casual or social\-casino category experience is a plus but not required.
* Evidence of running a title's economy, not just its calendar: prize curves, entry\-fee tiering, bonus rules, and a documented decision to change or retire something on margin grounds.
* Ran a measured experimentation practice — control groups or holdouts with a defined read — and can show a result that changed what was shipped, including a null result.
* Hands\-on with campaign and segmentation tooling (CleverTap, Braze, MoEngage, WebEngage or an internal admin portal) and comfortable pulling their own data in SQL or a BI tool.
* Comfortable with a fast weekly cycle, with a function being built around them, and with having their results independently scored by an analytics function.


 Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
 *.*

**The Impact You'll Make**
 International trade is evolving rapidly, and compliance has never been more critical. As a
 **GTM (SAP GTS) Business Consultant** 
 , you will help shape the future of Danfoss’ global trade operations by designing and improving SAP GTS solutions that enable compliant, efficient, and scalable business processes across the world.
   

  

 In this role, you will combine your expertise in
 **SAP GTS Edition for HANA (E4H)** 
 , international trade compliance, and business process optimization to support global teams and drive digital transformation. Your work will directly influence how goods move across borders, helping Danfoss navigate complex regulatory requirements while supporting business growth.
   

  

 You will join a collaborative international environment where you can partner with Trade Compliance, Supply Chain, Logistics, and IT experts while contributing to the long\-term vision for Global Trade Management and SAP S/4HANA integration.
   

  

 Ready to help shape the future of global trade compliance and digital transformation at Danfoss?
 **Apply today and bring your SAP GTS expertise to a team that is making a global impact.**
**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Lead the delivery of SAP GTS implementation, enhancement, migration, and rollout projects, turning business needs into scalable and compliant solutions that support global operations.
* Enhance and optimize key global trade processes, including Export Control, Import Compliance, Product Classification, Sanctioned Party Screening, Customs Declarations, Customs Special Procedures, including Free Trade Zones and Bonded Warehouses Intrastat Reporting, License Management, and Free Trade Agreements (FTA).
* Partner with global stakeholders to facilitate workshops, provide expert guidance, and bridge the gap between business requirements and technical solution design.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, increase automation, strengthen compliance, and leverage new SAP GTS capabilities and innovations.


**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\- 6\+ years of hands\-on SAP GTS experience, including implementation, support, and solution delivery activities.
* Proven experience in the participation of at least one end\-to\-end SAP GTS implementation project and supporting SAP GTS transformation or migration initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of SAP GTS Edition for HANA (E4H), SAP S/4HANA integrations, and international trade compliance processes.
* Expertise in areas such as Export Control, Customs Management, Customs Special Procedures, including Free Trade Zones and Bonded Warehouses, Product Classification, Trade Preference Management, and Trade Compliance.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across global and cross\-functional teams.


**What You'll Get From Us**
* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance.
* We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
* You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

You will influence senior leaders and engineering partners, establish durable product and measurement frameworks, and drive investments that improve Windows experiences at ecosystem scale.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. description:

***At Redwood Software we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights\-out automation for their mission\-critical business processes.***
**About Us**
 Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission\-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS\-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.
   

  

***CORE VALUES***
 One Team. One Redwood.
   

  

 Make Your Own Weather
   

  

 Obsess over Customer Success
   

  

 Work the Problem
   

  

 Be Curious
   

  

 Own the Outcome
   

  

 Respect Each Other
   

  

***YOUR IMPACT***
 As the Product Leader you will own the product strategy, customer retention, and migration roadmap for Redwood's legacy workload automation portfolio. You will maximize customer lifetime value, and position migrations as expansion opportunities—not churn events.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Product team to ensure migration blockers are addressed in the roadmap (feature parity, migration utilities, customer\-specific integrations)
* Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize defect fixes, security patches, and compliance requirements while minimizing investment in legacy platforms
* Work with Customer Success to design migration engagement models: discovery workshops, migration planning, technical validation, go\-live support
* Support Sales with migration business cases, competitive positioning


 Team Leadership \& Mentorship
   

  

* Develop Product Owners responsible for backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and delivery execution
* Model product management best practices customer\-centric discovery, data\-driven prioritization, outcome\-based roadmapping, transparent communication
* Build PO capability in migration management customer segmentation, churn risk assessment, migration planning, technical enablement


**Your Experience**
 Required Experience:
   

  

* 5–7 years in product management with demonstrated track record of shipping complex B2B enterprise software
* Legacy product management experience, Sustained platforms while building migration paths to modern architectures
* Customer retention expertise: Prevented churn during platform transitions, positioned migrations as value\-add vs. disruption
* Enterprise software domain knowledge: Workload automation, ERP integration, cloud infrastructure, or mission\-critical operations software preferred
* Cross\-functional leadership: Partnered with Engineering, Sales, CSM, and Support to balance competing priorities and deliver customer outcomes
* Analytical rigor: Used data (renewal rates, support ticket trends, usage telemetry) to inform prioritization and predict churn risk


**Preferred Experience**
* 8\+ years in product management with portfolio\-level accountability for multiple products or customer segments
* Migration strategy execution: Led customer migrations at scale (100\+ accounts), developed segmentation models, built migration tooling/playbooks
* Workload automation or IT operations domain. Deep understanding of job scheduling, batch processing, ERP integration, SAP workflows, or cloud orchestration

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
