* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

title: System Project Mgmt. Eng.
description:

As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
   

  

 General Information:
   

  

 The Technical Project Manager is responsible for the complete required engineering deliverables from Requirements to final test including project effort estimation and overall time planning of big projects. He / she leads functional Technical Project Managers of all disciplines and coordinates the technical activities. He / she has to take care of issues which cannot be solved within one discipline team. Approves the technical solution of the product and drives the Product Release.
   

  

 He/she is the main technical interface to the customer and supports the project manager by coordinating all disciplines and finding the best balance between system functionality and project costs.
   

  

 Your Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Preliminary note:
   

  

* The following lists many TPM responsibilities and much work content. It is clearly understood that the underlying work amount often cannot (and should not) be handled by one single person. Hence, work content may also be delegated to others within a system project, e.g. a Subsystem\-TPM. However, the overall responsibility remains with the TPM.
* Furthermore some responsibilities listed here are shared with dedicated roles within the system development project team (e.g. the requirements engineer or the test manager).
* On the contrary, for reduced scope projects (e.g. a ""SW\-only"" variant of an existing product) the work scope of the TPM role may be limited. Then roles may be combined, fulfilled by one person.
* Also, depending on the Project type, specific BU PLC being followed or Project Size/Complexity (requiring multiple TPMs), not all responsibilities and tasks may apply to the assigned/single TPMs.


 Tasks:
   

  

* Is responsible for time\-wise and content\-wise Release Planning.
* Drives the aggregation of the technical status/maturity/deviations of a system configuration incl. dedicated risks towards a System Release.
* Consolidates (w/ the tech. project team) the recommendation for releasing / not releasing towards the Engineering Release Manager (ERM).
* TPM is authorized to reject the technical system release (i.e. in case of exceeded deviations of the product functional quality).
* Is responsible for all system engineering work products according the engineering processes.
* Leads the technical communication with the customer.
* Is the main Technical Interface to the Customer (system only as STPL).
* Ensure implementation of platform solutions.
* Defines and monitors the responsibility/work split with the customer (Testing, Calibration, ...).
* Ensures the proper Test Environments, equipment and/or specifications is available from the Customer.
* Leads problem resolution as representative of the engineering within his project.
* Is part of the CCB (change control board).
* The TPM has to work according PLC and ensures PLC compliance within the engineering.
* Uses the standardized processes, methods and tools within his/her scope of responsibility.
* Ensure ASPICE compliance within the engineering.
* Leads and/or co\-ordinates all technical activities performed by engineering disciplines.
* Supports the resource planning and role assignment.
* Provide constructive feedback for team members.
* Contributes to the build up and maintenance of a supportive culture by using the 3C's globally: Communication, Collaboration, Cooperation.
* Contributes to the promotion of a learning organization (reflection loops).
* Manage and moderate conflicts.
* Supports the PM in the overall R\&D effort monitoring.
* Ensures the technical team works cost consciously towards meeting the R\&D budget, including preventing unnecessary costs
* Assures that customer induced cost increases are properly identified and addressed to the PM within Change Management
* Supports, w/ the technical team, to achieve the TMC (Total Manufacturing Cost) target of the project
* Ensures that the definition / selection of the design choices is aligned with the BOM. He/she approves the committed BOM from Engineering (where applicable at quote and during change mgt.)

title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high\-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.*
**How You Will Impact Skylo**
 You will own end\-to\-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the
 **packet core** 
 , the
 **signalling plane** 
 , and
 **billing \& settlement** 
 . You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on\-time technical delivery.
   

  

 This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch\-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the MNO technical onboarding program end\-to\-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
* Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP\-over\-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS\-over\-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
* Coordinate billing \& settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
* Program\-manage the multi\-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel\-run and rollback planning, and de\-risking the transition away from single\-supplier dependency.
* Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross\-functional launch\-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
* Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing\-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
* Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.


**Sound like you? You bring:**
 You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi\-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.
   

  

* 8\+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands\-on time in the signalling plane
* Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
+ NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
+ DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy \& topology
+ A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

* NB\-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control\-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel\-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
* Hands\-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per\-partner signalling readiness.
* Working understanding of billing \& settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57\), RAP (TD.32\), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
* Demonstrated track record shipping cross\-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
* Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.


**It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With**
* NTN, NB\-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
* SMS\-over\-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP\-via\-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control\-plane CIoT).
* Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming\-hub environments.
* Familiarity with BCE and next\-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance\-system integration for billing.
* Exposure to clearing\-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.


**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months)**
* A single, trusted onboarding program that partner\-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
* Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post\-launch surprise.
* The multi\-supplier roaming transition de\-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single\-supplier lock\-in surprises.
* Program\-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO Statement**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

 We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

description:
Sandoz is going through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Generic and Biosimilar medicines.

* Support capability building by guiding teams on validation practices, documentation standards, and system lifecycle processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, applying fit\-for\-purpose and lean approaches in quality and validation processes.
* Engage with stakeholders, vendors, and suppliers to ensure consistent understanding and application of quality requirements.


**Experience And Skills**
* 3\-5 Years of relevant experience in BioPharma IT Quality \& Compliance departments


**Skills**
* ITSQM skills
* Has successfully managed quality during multiple international and/or cross\- functional IT projects and/or operations and has a minimum of 3 years hands\-on quality management.
* Expert Knowledge and hands\-on working experience of Quality and Security Management in the following areas / disciplines GxP, CSV and GAMP·
* Good understanding of pharmaceutical validation requirements driven by health authorities like FDA etc.
* IT System Lifecycle (Requirement Management, Design, Testing, Deployment)
* Adequate project management skills to plan quality and information security tasks and monitor their implementation during assigned projects.
* Software Development Methodologies: Agile (must have), Dev / SecOPs (good to have)
* Quality and Process Management (CMMI, Six Sigma, good to have)

* Has a sound generic, domain and specialist knowledge necessary to perform effectively in the organization typically gained from recognized bodies of knowledge and organizational information


**Other Skills**
* Demonstrates effective application of knowledge.
* Has an appreciation of the wider business context
* Plans, schedules, and monitors own work (and that of others where applicable) competently within limited deadlines and according to relevant legislation, standards, and procedures.

* Demonstrates an analytical and systematic approach to issue resolution.

**Education**

**Languages**

**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, touched the lives of almost 500 million patients last year and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!

Morgan Stanley Electronic Trading (“MSET”) is a global leader in equity and derivatives electronic trading. The Vice President, MSET \& COO Support, is responsible for leading business management, operational risk, regulatory response, commission management support, client onboarding coordination, and process governance across the MSET COO organization. The role partners with senior stakeholders, coverage teams, technology, risk managers, and regional teams to strengthen controls, execute business priorities, and deliver scalable operating solutions.
   

  

 The position also includes leading a team supporting Request for Information (RFI), Commission Management Group (CMG), Client Onboarding for Cash and Listed Derivatives, management reporting, automation, and data maintenance activities.
   

  

 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 MSET is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED and Fixed Income Division (FID) ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Support the MSET COO function through business management, governance, executive reporting, stakeholder engagement, and cross\-regional coordination.
* Lead and manage end\-to\-end Request for Information (RFI) processes, ensuring timely, accurate, and audit\-ready responses while driving process improvements and automation.
* Oversee Commission Management Group (CMG) activities, including commission\-related requests, data validation, reporting, issue resolution, and control governance.
* Coordinate Client Onboarding for Cash and Listed Derivatives, ensuring efficient onboarding, documentation management, account setup, and stakeholder alignment.
* Lead operational and strategic projects, deliver reporting, analytics, process enhancements, and automation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
* Manage, develop, and mentor a high\-performing team while building strong partnerships across COO teams.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Bachelor’s degree from any stream with 8 \- 12 years of relevant experience. A master’s degree specialized in Finance will be advantageous
* Exposure to / knowledge of different equity and equity derivatives asset classes is desirable
* Relevant experience in financial services operations, COO support, business management, risk management, or client onboarding.
* Experience leading teams, managing BAU deliverables, and supporting transformation or automation projects.
* Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office skills, with experience in Python, Power BI and SAP BusinessObjects reporting preferred.
* Strong project management, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and issue\-escalation skills.
* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, control mindset, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced global environment.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.

Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

title: Network Engineering - Architecture Focus
description:
**Job Description**
 Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: \[Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry\-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end\-to\-end across LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi\-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end target\-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi\-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program\-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security \& Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro\-segmentation, and identity\-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI \& Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on\-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site\-to\-site, and remote\-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end\-to\-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud \& Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on\-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch \& Site Modernization
* Architect branch network modernization for our global manufacturing and distribution footprint, including SD\-WAN and Zero Trust Branch patterns.
* Improve user experience, application access, and operational simplicity at sites by reducing dependence on centralized backhaul.
* Define site reference designs that scale across geographies and plant types. Leadership \& Influence
* Mentor staff and senior engineers; raise the technical bar across the networking discipline.
* Partner with vendors and strategic technology partners on evaluations, proofs of concept, and roadmap alignment.
* Translate complex technical trade\-offs into clear, business\-relevant recommendations for senior leadership.
* Maintain authoritative network documentation — reference designs, topology diagrams, and standards — that the broader engineering organization can rely on. What you’ll need to be successful Must\-haves
* 10\+ years of network engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years in an architecture role at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining enterprise reference architectures and standards adopted across a multi\-site organization.
* Deep expertise across enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF), segmentation, WAN, SD\-WAN, and wireless.
* Strong network security architecture experience with platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass.
* Strong Azure networking experience, including VNet design, peering, private connectivity, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Experience with DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), IP schema design, and core service resiliency.
* Proven experience architecting Zero Trust Branch, micro\-segmentation, or identity aware network access.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to work across hybrid cloud and on\-premises environments in a global, distributed enterprise.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues clearly for both engineering and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement capabilities at the Director and VP level. Nice\-to\-haves
* Experience in manufacturing, CPG, or other industrial environments with significant OT/IT convergence considerations.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCDE, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or TOGAF.
* Experience leading vendor evaluations and architecture proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with network automation, infrastructure as code, and enterprise observability platforms. Our Total Rewards philosophy Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values. Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance\-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future — we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Travel: Up to 10–15%, as needed.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
   

  

 Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und \-verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Führt Komponenten\- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt\- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs\- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk\-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

title: Assistant Sales Manager (C&I Energy Storage Solutions)
Oracle CX Architect-Associate Business Transformation Architect-Sales and Services-Customer
Lakehouse Data Products Solution Owner
description:
Through STEP (Sandoz Transformation Enterprise Program), we are creating a unified, integrated digital core and simplifying our end\-to\-end ways of working. From SAP S/4HANA to Veeva, Workday, LabVantage, and beyond, you’ll help design and deliver future\-ready systems that drive global impact — enabling us to deliver affordable medicines to more patients worldwide.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) platform and related platform components, ensuring they effectively meet evolving business needs, perform optimally, and are regularly improved to support strategic objectives and innovation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Act as the central point of contact for all SAP BDC functionality, ensuring continuous alignment with business strategies and process requirements.
* Manage the entire lifecycle of the SAP BDC system, overseeing scheduled upgrades, patch management, and version control through SAP's Software Update Manager (SUM) or similar tools.
* Partner with other IT teams working on BDC components like Datasphere or SAC to translate requirements into SAP BDC configurations
* Identify and implement SAP Data Products, Insight apps or enhancements to improve user experience and increase productivity, ensuring the BDC platform supports emerging business needs.
* Define and oversee platform solution architecture standards and development guidelines and perform implementation reviews to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation in close alignment with enterprise archtecture standards
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless business solution implementations and integrations with other platforms (e.g., Databricks), ensuring that SAP BDC acts as the central hub for reporting \& analytics on SAP data.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation of custom data products
* Manage relationships with SAP and third\-party service providers, ensuring that SAP BDC service levels and support or customizations meet technical, business and compliance requirements
* Coordinate with SAP for procurement decisions related to credit consumption, additional licenses, modules, or software that enhance the capabilities of the existing SAP BDC landscape
* Ensure proper change \& release management processes on the platform to control deployments Effective user training is in place to provide on\-demand learning and support.
* Engage and manage stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Ensure SAP BDC meets the organization’s security requirements, including securing user roles and access control using SAP Identity Management (IdM) or SAP GRC.
* Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support compliance audits, leveraging SAP's audit logging capabilities and tracking of system changes to ensure data integrity


**Minimum Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* Strong understanding of SAP related data management and governance principles
* Extensive knowledge of SAP technologies (BDC, SAC, BTP, BW) with a proven track record of successful implementation and integration in the data analytics area
* Understanding of main Technology feature supporting data management and analytic
* Technical leadership role model for delivering of POVs/POCs and to oversee the development of data platform features
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex data challenges.
* Ability to align SAP BDC data solutions with business objectives and deliver measurable value


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related business field; (Master’s degree is preferred)


**Languages**
 English
   

  

**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**
**\#Sandoz**

title: Domain Pre Sales AP
description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre\-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions\-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Contribute**
* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go\-to\-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C\-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.


**What We’re Seeking**
* Exceptional executive\-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C\-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior\-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real\-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network\-specific operating models.
* End\-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.


**Our Offer to You**
* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
   

  

 Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
   

  

 FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy\-policy

title: RC FS -BTI INS -Life and Annuity -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life \& Annuity Senior position:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life \& Annuity insurance domain.


**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**
* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.


**Ideally, good to have**
* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.

description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Creative Strategist at RZR, you will translate audience insights, performance data, and campaign objectives into actionable content strategies and creative concepts that drive measurable results across mobile advertising platforms.
   

  

 This role sits within the Creative Growth pod as an individual contributor — owning research, audience analysis, creative hypotheses, and copy development for assigned accounts. You will work closely with the Creative Strategy Manager, Creative Designers, and Analytics to ensure strategic intent flows through from brief to final execution.
   

  

 This is not a generalist content or social media role. This is a performance\-focused, insight\-driven strategy role in a mobile advertising environment.
   

  

 The right person for this role is analytically curious and creatively sharp — someone who can read a performance signal, build a hypothesis around it, write the copy to test it, and document what they learned. You will operate with real ownership across your accounts from day one.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Conduct independent market, competitive, and audience research for assigned accounts
* Develop content strategies aligned to campaign goals and client KPIs
* Tailor creative concepts to specific audience segments using behavioural and psychographic data
* Generate new creative concepts based on performance insights and research findings
* Write and develop copy for ad creatives — headlines, CTAs, and messaging frameworks
* Synthesise performance signals into actionable hypotheses for creative testing
* Identify A/B testing opportunities from campaign data and propose structured test frameworks
* Maintain audience profiles, user personas, and competitor insight documents
* Support QBR preparation with research, insights, and audience\-specific recommendations
* Monitor performance reports and flag emerging trends or declining signals
* Document all hypotheses, test results, and learnings in the shared knowledge base
* Coordinate with Creative Designers on concept visualisation and storyboarding
* Interface with Analytics for performance data pulls and reporting inputs


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 3–5 years of experience in content strategy, creative strategy, or a performance creative role in a digital or mobile advertising environment
* Demonstrated ability to develop content strategies and creative concepts grounded in audience data and performance insights
* Strong copywriting skills — able to craft compelling ad headlines, CTAs, and messaging frameworks
* Familiarity with mobile advertising platforms and performance metrics (CTR, IPM, ROAS, CPI)
* Experience synthesising research and data into clear, actionable recommendations
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and workstreams simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard for output quality
* Collaborative working style with clear, structured communication


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Exposure to creative A/B testing frameworks and hypothesis\-led thinking
* Familiarity with platform\-specific creative best practices (Meta, TikTok, Google UAC, DSPs)
* Experience in ad tech, programmatic, or mobile\-first marketing environments
* Experience contributing to QBR preparation or client\-facing strategy documentation


 Work Setup
   

  

 This is a hybrid role requiring regular onsite attendance for collaboration, creative reviews, and team activities. Creative team members may occasionally work onsite more frequently depending on project demands. Fully remote candidates will not be considered.
   

  

 Why Join RZR in Manila / Bangalore?
   

  

* Embedded strategy with direct influence on performance — you are not producing content in a vacuum. Your hypotheses get tested, your copy runs in live campaigns, and you see the results. The feedback loop is real and fast.
* Work across a diverse portfolio of mobile advertising accounts — no two accounts are the same. You will build genuine depth across different verticals, audiences, and creative formats.
* Close collaboration with Creative Leadership and cross\-functional partners — you will work directly alongside the Creative Strategy Manager and interface regularly with Analytics and Revenue. Your work is seen and valued.
* High\-ownership environment — your ideas matter here. If you have a hypothesis, you can propose it, test it, and own the outcome.
* Clear progression path — the natural next step from this role is Senior Creative Strategist, with a well\-defined track within the Creative Growth pod.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

 You will own NapChief’s entire content and social function everything the brand publishes, the calendar it runs on, the team that produces it, and the audience response it earns.This is a management seat first and a craft seat second. Five people report to you, and you will be measured by what your team produces, not by what you produce personally. If your ambition is to be the best maker in the room, this is the wrong role. If your ambition is to build a content engine that runs on a calendar and hits its dates without you in the middle of every task, this is the right one.
 



  





 Responsibilities:
 



**Content calendar and planning**

**Production and shoot management** 



* Own the shoot calendar end to end: concept, script, model casting and confirmation, location, props, styling, call sheets, and post\-production timelines.
* Hold the production schedule. A shoot that loses its models on the morning of is a planning failure build the confirmations, buffers, and fallbacks that prevent it.
* Manage external partners: photographers, videographers, editors, and studios, including rate negotiation and delivery timelines.
* Ensure every new collection has shoot\-ready assets before it goes live on the website and marketplaces.



  





**Organic social and community** 



* Own organic performance as a number: reach, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, and non\-follower reach reported weekly against target, not anecdotally.
* Run publishing discipline. No reposting old content as filler. Retire formats once they stop performing and test new ones on a defined cadence.
* Own community management comments, DMs, and the response SLA routing anything that becomes a service issue to customer service.



  





**Influencer and UGC** 



* Own the influencer program through the influencer marketing owner on your team: partner selection, brief quality, deliverable tracking, usage rights, and cost per asset.
* Build a repeatable UGC pipeline from customers and parent creators, and route the best\-performing assets into the paid creative pool.

**Brand storytelling** 



* Own the brand narrative in content: what NapChief stands for, how it sounds, and how that holds together across every post, campaign, and collection launch.
* Write and approve scripts and copy, or direct the team that does.
* Maintain the Master Creative Document as a living reference that survives any individual leaving.
* Run seasonal campaign concepts end to end: brief, narrative, asset list, timeline, and post\-campaign review against results.



  





**Team leadership** 



* Manage five people directly. Run weekly 1:1s and a documented weekly team review.
* Set priorities explicitly. Every person on your team should be able to state their top three priorities for the week without asking you.
* Hold people to dates. Where work slips you handle it directly — the conversation, the written expectation, the follow\-up, and the escalation if it repeats. Repeated following\-up is not management.
* Develop the team. Two of the five are in their first or second year. Your job is to make them independent, not to absorb their work when they struggle.
* Own hiring input, interview scorecards, and probation recommendations for your team.



  





**Coordination** 



* Work alongside the Brand Strategist, who owns creative for paid media. Your organic and production engine feeds that pipeline.
* One team member is coached by the Brand Strategist on creative craft while reporting to you — you own their priorities, performance, and review.
* Work with the Shopify and marketplace owners so launches, sale events, and campaigns have assets on time.



  





**KPIs you own** 



* Organic reach and engagement growth vs monthly target, including non\-follower reach
* Content calendar adherence — planned vs published, on date
* Shoot\-to\-live turnaround — days from shoot to assets available for use
* Asset throughput per month at the agreed quality bar
* Influencer cost per usable asset
* Team scorecard completion every person on your team on a live weekly scorecard



  





**Requirements:** 



* 4–6 years in content and social for consumer brands, including 2\+ years managing a team of four or more. Agency backgrounds are welcome, particularly if you ran a pod across brands and now want to go deep on one.
* Demonstrated people management with a mechanism behind it. You will be asked in the interview to walk through, week by week, how you handled someone who repeatedly missed deadlines. We are looking for a specific method, not persistence.
* Experience running a production calendar with real deadlines and real consequences — shoots, launches, and campaign dates that could not move.
* Strong planning and timeline management. This is the core competency for this seat, ahead of design or editing skill.
* Storytelling ability. You can articulate why a piece of content exists and what it should make a parent feel or do.
* Comfort with numbers: platform analytics, weekly reporting, and making format decisions from data.
* Hands\-on enough to be credible. You can brief, review, and give sharp feedback on a reel or a script even if you are not the one editing it.
* Working proficiency with Asana or an equivalent, plus social scheduling and analytics tooling.
* Not a fit if: your strongest asset is your personal portfolio and you would rather be making content than running a team; your management experience is limited to freelancers; or you have led social at a large brand where an agency and a producer handled production.

* Candidate communication

* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple trackers, sheets, and processes without errors.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Strong candidate experience orientation.

* Experience handling candidate pre\-onboarding and documentation processes.

**Technical Skills**

* Operations: Interview scheduling, recruitment coordination, pre\-onboarding, documentation tracking

**What We're Looking For**
* Attention to Detail: Strong accuracy across trackers, documentation, and recruitment operations.
* Ownership: Ability to independently manage multiple processes end\-to\-end.
* Coordination Skills: Excellent stakeholder management across recruiters, candidates, hiring managers, and HR teams.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders.
* Candidate Experience: Passion for creating a seamless candidate journey from application through joining.

**You'll Know You're Winning When**

* Accurate, real\-time tracking across all sheets and systems.

* Strong trust and reliability with recruiters and business stakeholders.

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 The AVP, CoreTech Governance Lead is part of the CoreTech Governance and Risk organization and operates as a First Line of Defense (1LOD) function. This role is responsible for driving enterprise\-wide adherence to CRI, NIST, internal technology standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. The team partners closely with Technology, Audit, Compliance, Risk, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate risks across Synchrony’s global technology infrastructure, while promoting strong governance, accountability, and risk management practices.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 AVP, CoreTech Governance \& Risk, will lead governance, risk, and compliance activities related to regulatory requirements. This role is accountable for timely issue remediation, supporting audits and regulatory examinations, managing policy lifecycles, driving risk acceptance processes, and overseeing exceptions management. The AVP collaborates cross\-functionally to ensure Synchrony mitigates risks, and provides clear, auditable documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Issue Management: Ensure timely identification, tracking, remediation, and closure of CoreTech related issues by collaborating with Technology teams, Issue Management, Second Line of Defense (2LOD), and Internal Audit.
* Audit and Examination Support: Coordinate internal meetings, evidence collection, preparation, and responses to auditors, regulators, and Internal Audit teams.
* Risk Acceptance Oversight: Lead risk acceptance activities by managing documentation, obtaining approvals, and ensuring alignment with company policies.
* Policy Lifecycle Management: Manage the development, review, approval, and publication of CoreTech related policies, standards, and procedures.
* Exception Management: Oversee the intake, validation, documentation, and approval of exception requests, ensuring compliance with governance requirements.
* Metrics and Reporting: Provide regular status updates and metrics on issue remediation, risk acceptance activities, exceptions, and audit readiness to senior leadership and stakeholders.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of IT controls.
* Experience managing governance and risk programs in a regulated environment.
* Proven project management and coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including technology, audit, and risk.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and analytical abilities.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior experience supporting internal and external audits.
* Understanding of risk acceptance frameworks and process automation tools.
* Familiarity with enterprise policy management systems.
* Experience working in financial services or consumer finance industries.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Bachelor's degree with 6\+ years of 1st Line of Defense experience Or in lieu of a degree 8\+ years of experience required.
   

  

**Work Timings**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. The days moves along as you and the team you are a part of are solving physical security operational issues across the Americas.  Security Integrations Group (SIG), a part of Worldwide Physical Security (PhySec), is primarily an engineering team for Amazon's physical security systems across the globe, but also participates in the design, development, deployment, and project management aspects of these systems. SIG provides 24/7 customer support for physical security systems. SIG provides 24x7 support via support engineering teams based in North America, Australia, and Europe. Engineers are available in\-office at all times.

**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance** 




 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
 



 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
 



 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
 



 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This isn’t a typical Reporting role.
 


* You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
* CoinDCX operates in a market where volumes, products and regulation move faster than any quarterly plan can anticipate. That makes business finance far less about reporting the past and far more about being the analytical engine behind what we do next.
* In this role you will sit close to the sales, marketing, operations and product teams, turning raw performance data into a clear Finance point of view on what is working, what is not, and where the next rupee should go.
* You will build the scorecards, models and ROI frameworks that leadership uses to make calls — and you will be in the room when those calls are made.



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Drive data analysis across KPIs for different sales channels, marketing effectiveness and core business metrics to explain what is actually moving the business
* Develop and automate Finance review scorecards with key KPIs to decode revenue performance across products and channels
* Evaluate cost\-benefit and ROI across different spends to bring scientific rigour to investment decisions
* Build financial models and forecasts, and own your inputs into the annual planning/budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles
* Lead Post\-Implementation Reviews after a project or initiative launches, to verify whether the projected financial benefits were actually realised
* Drill down into the profitability of specific business units and channels to identify opportunities and share insights that change decisions



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 3–5 years of experience in business finance, with a CA or MBA qualification
* Hands\-on experience across data analysis, stakeholder management and finance automation
* Prior experience of working in business finance in a high\-growth environment
* Strong understanding of business financials and P\&L, with the ability to add value and drive a Finance POV in discussions
* Good understanding of different business KPIs — their uses, calculations and limitations
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, plus working fluency with AI tools such as Gemini or Claude
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, with strong collaboration and interpersonal skills



  





**You’ll Excel in This Role If You** 



* Think in first principles and act like an owner of the P\&L, not a reporter of it
* Are as comfortable in the detail of a dataset as you are summarising it in one slide for leadership
* Communicate with precision and empathy, and build working relationships with business stakeholders quickly
* Thrive in ambiguity and build clarity from incomplete data
* Have a bias for automation — if you have built it manually twice, you will find a way to make it run itself
* Bring a Finance point of view and can hold it in a room of strong operators
* Are curious about crypto and energised by an industry that rewrites itself every quarter



  





**You’ll Know You’re Winning When** 




 Key success metrics for the first 6 months:
 


* Finance review scorecards for key channels/products/functions are automated and running with minimal manual effort
* ROI and cost\-benefit frameworks you have built are actively shaping where spend goes powered through regular Post\-Implementation Reviews
* Your inputs into the quarterly forecast are accurate and trusted enough for the business to plan against
* Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You
* You’ll work closely with senior leadership, influence high\-stakes decisions, and create visible impact in one of the world’s fastest\-evolving industries.



  





**Hiring Process** 



* Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving



  





**Where We Work** 




 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
 



 With this belief, we operate as a
 **work\-from\-office organisation.** 
 This role is based out of our
 **Bangalore office,** 
 where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
 



  





**Perks That Empower You** 



* We believe great people deserve great experiences.
* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities



  





**Ready to Build What’s Next?** 




 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
 



 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.
