About us :
   

  

 Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.
   

  

 Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.
   

  

**Role Summary :**
 BKNG Treasury is seeking a proactive, self\-starting professional to drive the execution of global Treasury activities. In this role, you will lead efforts across bank account management, banking administration, and automated TMS static data management. Initially focused on supporting one of the verticals in our global banking structure, the role will evolve to encompass broader TMS data ownership and operational leadership within our maturing treasury framework.
   

  

 As a vital member of the BKNG Treasury team, you will collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Banking, Technology, Legal, and Risk. This position demands exceptional coordination, disciplined execution, and a passion for process standardization as we transition key operations to our Bangalore Center of Excellence (CoE).
   

  

 You will be expected to champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization, strengthening internal controls, and enhancing data governance across our global banking partnerships and treasury platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities :**
* Bank Account Management
* Manage and optimize the global bank account inventory, ensuring rigorous oversight for in\-scope entities.
* Facilitate end\-to\-end bank account lifecycles, including openings, modifications, and closures, by coordinating internal approvals and external partner requirements.
* Ensure bank account records, account attributes, signer information, and related supporting documentation remain complete and accurate.
* Track account lifecycle events and ensure timely follow\-up on pending requests with internal stakeholders and external banking partners.
* Support the maintenance of centralized repositories for bank account documentation, agreements, and supporting records.


 Banking Administration
   

  

* Execute core banking administration activities including KYC support, signatory management, bank form administration, and documentation handling for in\-scope entities.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and business stakeholders to collect and validate required documentation for bank requests and periodic reviews.
* Manage updates to mandates, signer structures, bank contacts, and related documentation across the banking landscape.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of required information to banking partners in line with regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
* Monitor outstanding bank requests and escalations, and provide clear status updates to stakeholders


 TMS Static Data Management
   

  

* Act as the primary owner for treasury static data within the TMS, overseeing counterparties, settlement instructions, and master data integrity.
* Ensure all static data changes are completed accurately, approved appropriately, and recorded in line with control and governance requirements.
* Support the automation and standardization of static data maintenance processes to reduce manual intervention and improve data quality.
* Perform data quality reviews and reconciliations between the TMS, banking platforms, and supporting source documentation.
* Partner with Treasury Technology and other teams on system enhancements, issue resolution, testing, and process improvements related to static data management.


 Banking Operations
   

  

* Support selected banking operations activities including payment investigations, proof of payment requests, bank query resolution, and follow\-up on operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners to investigate payment issues, confirm transaction status, and resolve operational incidents within agreed timelines.
* Maintain clear tracking of cases, dependencies, and actions required to support smooth operational execution.
* Build end\-to\-end understanding of the transitioning operational scope and contribute to a structured knowledge transfer into the Bangalore CoE.
* Help establish clear process documentation, ownership models, and control points for the operational activities brought into scope.


 Controls, Governance and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, and policy expectations across all assigned treasury back\-office activities.
* Support periodic reviews, evidence collection, and documentation requests linked to SOX, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify process inefficiencies, control gaps, and recurring pain points, and propose practical improvements.
* Contribute to the design of scalable processes and a sustainable operating model for treasury back\-office activities in the CoE.
* Provide cross\-team support where needed to maintain continuity of treasury operations.


**Qualifications :**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in treasury operations, banking administration, bank account management, cash operations, or similar roles within global multinational corporations, financial institutions, or complex finance environments.
* Hands\-on experience with bank account lifecycle management, banking documentation, KYC coordination, signatory management, and related treasury administration activities.
* Experience supporting banking operations activities such as payment investigations, transaction confirmations, proof of payment requests, exception management, and operational query resolution.
* Good understanding of treasury systems, static data governance, and process controls, with hands\-on experience in one or more Treasury Management Systems such as SAP, Oracle\-based platforms, or FIS Quantum preferred.
* Experience with major electronic banking platforms such as CitiDirect, J.P. Morgan Access, Straight2Bank, HSBCnet, or similar tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications such as Excel and Word and/or Google Workspace tools such as Google Docs and Sheets.
* Ability to work in a complex and dynamic environment, coordinating across Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk and Control, FP\&A, FinCrime, Treasury Technology, external counsel, and banking partners.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to conduct technical discussions, align on requirements, and support stakeholders across multiple BKNG brands, countries, and levels of seniority.
* Strong understanding of legal, regulatory, and business requirements relevant to treasury operations, with the ability to assess implications and support practical, controlled solutions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory developments, new regulations, and internal policy changes, identify risk impacts, and support implementation of appropriate controls with internal teams.
* Prior experience working within a SOX control environment, including control adherence, documentation, evidence gathering, and support for testing or audit requests.
* Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy in handling documentation, static data, and operational requests.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, balancing daily operational execution, process improvement priorities, and project or implementation support.
* Strong process\-improvement mindset, including identifying automation opportunities, reducing manual operational effort, and contributing to optimized and scalable treasury processes.
* Interest in systems and technologies, with the ability to work closely with Treasury Technology teams on process improvements, system enhancements, testing, and operational design.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.


**Pre\-Employment Screening**
*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre\-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre\-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*

 Our Purpose
   

  

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships, and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
   

  

**Title And Summary:**
 Senior Analyst, Global Real Estate Services
   

  

**Overview:**
 The Global Real Estate Services team is seeking a Senior Analyst, Global Real Estate Services to support the Global Capital Project Management team in the administration and execution of workplace and capital projects across Mastercard's global real estate portfolio. This role is responsible for coordinating purchase order and invoicing processes, partnering with Mastercard Sourcing and the Mastercard Global Business Service Center (GBSC), supporting project governance activities, maintaining project documentation and reporting, and helping ensure projects are delivered efficiently and in accordance with established processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, detail\-oriented, and able to effectively collaborate with stakeholders across a global organization.
   

  

**Job Description:**
* Manage the full lifecycle of purchase orders and invoices, partnering with internal stakeholders, Finance, and vendors to ensure compliance, budget alignment, and timely payment of project\-related expenses.
* Partner with regional project managers and vendors to ensure consistency in project delivery, reporting, and adherence to established processes.
* Support procurement activities, consultant engagements, contract administration, and project change management
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders working together to meet Mastercard’s objectives and goals.
* Maintain accurate project records and documentation to support audit, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, reporting tools, and portfolio governance practices.
* Lead smaller capital projects and workstreams with limited supervision.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects, driving accountability amount stakeholders and external partners.
* Provide strategic recommendations based on project data, trends, and portfolio analysis to support decision\-making.
* Mentor and guide junior Team members, contractors, and project coordinators on project processes and best practices.
* Manage the end\-to\-end contingent worker lifecycle, including onboarding coordination, badge and facility access requests, profile maintenance, and timely offboarding activities to ensure compliance with security, workplace, and contractor governance requirements.
* Obtain and maintain industry designations applicable to this position, fulfilling ongoing mandatory education and training requirements as necessary
* Adhere to internal policies and procedures


**All About You:**
* Real Estate \& Facilities experience within a corporate office environment, preferably in Class A office space.
* Experience monitoring and reporting on detailed budgets, schedules, and multiple ongoing project statuses.
* Ability to support new process improvement opportunities.
* Ability to relentlessly prioritize.
* Bachelor's degree in business, communications, real estate (or equivalent experience). Facilities or Real Estate professional membership, registration and/or certification from an accredited organization preferred.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret common statement of work terms \& business language.
* Excellent data analytics skills, including experience in IWMS Applications.
* Proficient in the use of MS Office Applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


**Desired Skills**
* Highly self\-motivated and directed with strong attention to detail
* Creative, innovative, and effective problem\-solving skills.
* Successfully navigate and thrive within various global \& regional team environments.
* Ability to deal with situations involving sensitive and confidential issues.
* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* Exercise sound judgment and initiative by raising concerns, identifying opportunities for process optimization, and contributing to the development of best practice across the Real Estate Services function
* Ability to effectively present to various levels of management. You are a strong, confident, and exacting writer and speaker.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!
   

  

 The Customer Success Engineer is responsible for product adoption and expertise of the LogicMonitor customer at scale. You will contribute to the product experience through resolving customer problems, educating users on LM functionality and providing useful solutions within the LogicMonitor product. The CSE is responsible for all aspects of the customer's success within the product, including training, adoption, problem resolution, business value realization, retention, and growth \- all done at scale utilizing tool automation 1:many and 1:1 customer meetings. The CSE is the primary point of contact for product adoption and creative solutions and is responsible for working in tandem with a team of Customer Success Managers, Account Owners, Executives, and other cross\-functional teams as needed to meet customer and LM leadership expectations.
   

  

**Here's a closer look at this key role:**
 Product Adoption \& Expertise

 Retention

* Identify proactive opportunities to work with and provide "value" to your customers

* Work with Technical Support to understand your customer's issue, and assist as an escalation point of contact
* Provide constant\-availability to your customer set during critical situations and outages
* Conduct Renewal Cycle business reviews within your accounts showcasing LogicMonitor's value and learning about clients goals and challenges

* Ability to follow structured process and information entry
* The ability to work in a fast\-paced dynamic environment during tremendous growth

description:
**Company Description**
 IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data\-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor\-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
   

  

 We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Work alongside AI agents as co\-workers within our AI\-SDLC framework — using Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and AWS Bedrock throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance cycles
* Drive work from Jira tickets and Confluence documentation as the source of truth for requirements, decisions, and context
* Leverage deep domain and product knowledge to evaluate and challenge requirements — ensuring they are precise, complete, and structured for effective processing by both human engineers and AI agents
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement — to keep delivery on track and priorities aligned
* Surface and mitigate quality risks before they escalate — proactively communicating test coverage gaps, flagging scope concerns during planning, and helping keep the team's quality commitments on track
* Own the test strategy and automation architecture with data quality as the primary focus — spanning ETL/ELT pipeline validation, source\-to\-target reconciliation, functional, end\-to\-end (Playwright), BDD, and performance (JMeter) layers
* Build and maintain robust Python\-based test frameworks and BDD feature suites — including reusable SQL and pandas/PySpark assertion libraries for data comparison, profiling, and reconciliation — that align test coverage to biopharma business requirements
* Design and govern JMeter performance test plans covering both application and data layers — pipeline throughput, load\-window adherence, and large\-volume query response; analyse results and drive remediation with development teams
* Own end\-to\-end data quality across the platform's ingestion and transformation pipelines — designing and automating validation of raw, staged, and curated layers in Snowflake and PostgreSQL
* Write and own the complex SQL that proves business logic independently of the pipeline code — reconciling source, staging, and curated layers rather than trusting transformation output at face value
* Build automated reconciliation suites covering row counts, control totals, referential integrity, deduplication, late\-arriving data, slowly changing dimension handling, and idempotency on pipeline reruns
* Design and maintain reusable test data — synthetic and masked production\-like datasets that exercise edge cases, nulls, boundary values, historical restatements, and malformed or out of\-spec source files
* Validate orchestration behaviour end\-to\-end — dependency ordering, retries, partial\-load recovery, backfills, incremental vs. full loads, and failure alerting
* Test schema evolution and data contracts between upstream sources and downstream consumers, catching breaking changes before they reach client\-facing outputs
* Define, automate, and report on data quality rules and SLAs — completeness, accuracy, timeliness, uniqueness, and conformity — making data quality visible to the team and to stakeholders
* Serve as the go\-to QA engineer for the harder test challenges — the person the team relies on when data complexity, regulatory risk, or system ambiguity is highest
* Produce clear test strategy documents, defect trend analyses, and quality reports that inform team and stakeholder decisions; communicate quality status and risk effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Incorporate pharma manufacturer client needs and regulatory requirements into test coverage decisions; participate actively in incident responses and quality reviews that have direct client impact
* Apply strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to trace data defects back to root cause through the pipeline — distinguishing source data issues from transformation logic defects and orchestration failures — anticipating failure modes and designing coverage for them proactively rather than reactively; evaluate quality trade\-offs and drive decisions with appropriate rigour
* Demonstrate full accountability for your own work and the team's quality output — holding yourself answerable to team\-level quality outcomes, not just individual test deliverables; proactively managing risks, communicating progress, and owning quality end\-to\-end
* Lift the overall quality output of the team — through proactive test design collaboration, knowledge sharing, unblocking, and consistently raising the bar on what the team ships
* Stay current with the team's evolving test toolset — including AI\-augmented testing practices, Playwright updates, BDD patterns, and biopharma regulatory developments — and actively bring relevant updates into team practices
* Partner effectively across backend developers, UI/UX developers, product analysts, and domain stakeholders — communicating clearly within a geographically distributed team
* Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the team
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-powered testing tools into the QA workflow


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years in software quality engineering, with the majority of that time spent on data\-centric testing — ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and reporting/consumption layers. Strong expertise in requirement analysis, test data design, test planning, and detailed test case design across automation and manual testing.
* Any experience with AWS/Cloud hosted applications is an added advantage.
* Expert\-level SQL (MUST) — able to independently write and tune complex queries against Snowflake, PostgreSQL and MySQL (multi\-table joins over large fact/dimension tables, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, set operations) to validate transformation logic without depending on developers
* 4\+ years specifically testing data pipelines / ETL\-ELT processes end\-to\-end — source\-to\-target mapping validation, reconciliation, data quality rule design, and root\-cause analysis of data defects
* Hands\-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake strongly preferred) — comfortable with stages, streams, tasks, time travel, clustering, and reading query profiles for tuning
* Working knowledge of pipeline orchestration and transformation tooling (Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, Step Functions, or equivalent) and of common ingestion formats (CSV, fixed\-width, JSON, Parquet; EDI/X12 an advantage)
* Python data\-handling skills applied to testing — pandas, PySpark, or equivalent — for building comparison, profiling, and reconciliation utilities at scale
* Exposure to data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, or Soda, or experience building equivalent in\-house capability
* 3\+ years of test automation across UI and API layers — creating, executing, and maintaining automated tests with Selenium WebDriver (v3\+)/Playwright, with programming experience in Python (MUST) — complementing, not replacing, the core data testing focus
* Deep BDD expertise — framework design, Gherkin authoring, step library architecture, living documentation
* Proven JMeter experience — test plan design, distributed execution, and results analysis
* Hands\-on experience working in an AI\-augmented or agentic development/testing environment (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent)
* Experienced working with Agile methodologies, such as Scrum, Kanban
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of owning data quality outcomes end\-to\-end — accountable to team\-level quality outcomes, not just individual deliverables
* Influences technical decisions on the team through well\-supported proposals and demonstrated expertise; beginning to shape team practices through example and mentorship
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills within a geographically distributed, cross functional team
* Key competencies required: Problem\-Solving, Analytical, Collaboration, and Accountability. Strong communication skills \& stakeholder management. Advantage if,
* Has Healthcare/Life Sciences domain experience — particularly pharma commercial data (distributor 867/852 files, chargebacks, claims, gross\-to\-net, or master data management)
* Has experience designing and enhancing test automation frameworks, especially data validation frameworks built in\-house
* Team leading experience Professional Approach
* Ready to work in flexible working hours and collaborate with US/India/Colombia teams
* Good communication skills (written, verbal, listening, and articulation)


 Additional Information
   

  

**What does IntegriChain have to offer?**
* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits \+ non\-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off and much more!

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage.  You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise\-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud\-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities.**
 Cloud\-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads.
   

  

**Platform Hardening, Network \& Container Security**
* Implement and manage Kubernetes Network Policies for micro\-segmentation and least\-privilege communication.
* Configure and enforce OpenShift Security Context Constraints (SCCs) and Multi\-Category Security (MCS).
* Deploy and operate Container Security Operators for continuous vulnerability scanning of running pods and images.
* Build platform functionality for image scanning, signing, and policy enforcement Advanced Cluster Security for runtime threat detection, compliance monitoring, and network policy enforcement.
* Drive platform compliance with CIS benchmarks (Kubernetes and Linux), FIPS, and zero\-trust guidelines.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large\-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience: 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on building scalable distributed systems, cloud platforms, or security infrastructure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Cluster API (CAPI), NetworkPolicies, SCCs, MCS, and related security primitives.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability.
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), and kernel security modules.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* This role combines deep platform engineering with hands\-on security ownership. You will shape how NKP delivers secure, compliant, and production\-grade Kubernetes \+ storage capabilities at enterprise scale.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

**Job Description\*** 
 .
   

  

 We are seeking a Data Engineer to support CACR 2\.0 as the platform and enterprise data landscape continue to scale. This role will contribute to delivering trusted, compliant, and scalable data solutions while helping reduce risks arising from manual processes and inconsistent practices.
   

  

 The Data Engineer will work closely with senior engineers and architects to implement Data Virtualization, support Data Quality frameworks, and contribute to Metadata and Data Lineage capabilities that improve data accessibility, accuracy, and transparency. This role focuses on hands‑on development, implementation, and operational support within established enterprise data standards and architectures.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
 Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, integrations, and data processing solutions within enterprise data platforms.
* Contribute to end‑to‑end delivery of data engineering initiatives, including requirements understanding, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Assist in the implementation and adoption of Data Virtualization, Data Quality frameworks, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage capabilities.
* Develop scalable and reusable data integration patterns to support batch and near real‑time data processing use cases.
* Support modernization of legacy data processes by reducing manual interventions and improving automation and monitoring.
* Follow and help enforce enterprise data standards, best practices, and governance guidelines to ensure data quality, security, and compliance.
* Collaborate with architects, platform teams, governance, security, and business stakeholders to deliver aligned data solutions.
* Troubleshoot and support performance, reliability, and scalability issues in production data platforms.
* Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives across the data engineering team.


**Requirements**
**Education\***
* Any Graduation / Post Graduation


**Experience Range\***
* 6 to 8 years


**Foundational skills\***
* Solid understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including data ingestion, transformation, integration, orchestration, and data lifecycle management.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and good programming skills in Python for building and maintaining data pipelines.
* Hands‑on experience with data integration and ETL/ELT tools such as Informatica, supporting batch and near real‑time processing.
* Working knowledge of data virtualization concepts, with exposure to platforms such as Starburst (Trino/Presto) preferred.
* Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, and familiarity with data warehouses and data lake architectures.
* Understanding of data modeling concepts, including conceptual, logical, and physical models (dimensional and normalized).
* Exposure to distributed data systems, APIs, and messaging or event‑driven integration patterns.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of Data Quality, Metadata, and Data Lineage principles.
* Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and cloud‑based data engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and automation for data solutions.
* Awareness of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements in enterprise environments.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.


**Desired skills\***
* Exposure to cloud‑native data services (e.g. ADLS, S3\).
* Familiarity with CDC patterns, and hybrid (on‑prem \+ cloud) data integrations.
* Knowledge of streaming platforms such as Kafka for near real‑time data ingestion and processing.
* Experience with data observability, monitoring, and alerting tools for data pipelines.
* Understanding of master data management (MDM) and reference data concepts.


**Work Timings\*:**
 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM IST
   

  

**Job Location\*:**
 Gurugram / GIFT City

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years building RTL that tapes out clean, not almost clean, actually clean, and you know the difference between a subsystem that works in simulation and one that survives silicon. The dopamine rush you get from first\-time\-right RTL is real, and it is what keeps you coming back to the hardest parts of digital design. You have driven multiple tape\-outs and learned that the architecture decisions you make in week two will either or sink the team in month six. You think in hierarchies, timing paths, and power domains without losing sight of what the block is actually supposed to do. Working with verification teams does not slow you down, it sharpens your thinking, and you write RTL that makes their job possible, not harder. You are comfortable owning a subsystem from spec to release, navigating ambiguity, making tradeoffs, and driving cross\-functional work without waiting for someone else to connect the dots. At Synopsys, you will work on complex IP and subsystems that power the semiconductor industry, and the RTL you write will matter.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the full lifecycle of complex subsystem design from requirements and architecture through RTL development, verification collaboration, implementation handoff, and final release
* Craft subsystem architecture and functional specifications, define micro\-architecture, and write production\-quality RTL using industry best practices
* Drive RTL quality checks including lint, CDC, RDC, and work closely with verification teams to ensure functional correctness and coverage closure
* Integrate and design around standard protocols including PCIe, DDR, UFS, USB, and AMBA\-based interconnects
* Implement low power design techniques across clock gating, power gating, and multi\-voltage domains, ensuring power intent is captured and verified
* Collaborate with logic synthesis, STA, and physical design teams to ensure timing closure, develop synthesis constraints, and resolve equivalence check issues
* Work with DFT teams to architect scan, MBIST, and other testability features into your subsystems from the start

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your RTL will tape out in production silicon used by leading semiconductor companies building next\-generation AI, automotive, and mobile SoCs
* The subsystems you architect will enable faster time\-to\-market for Synopsys IP customers who depend on proven, reusable, and robust design blocks
* Your attention to RTL quality and first\-time\-right design will reduce verification cycles, implementation iterations, and post\-silicon debug time across the product
* The protocols and low power techniques you implement will directly influence power, performance, and area outcomes in customer chips
* Your collaboration with cross\-functional teams will set the standard for how design, verification, and implementation work together on complex projects
* The design practices and methodologies you bring will influence how the team approaches architecture, coding standards, and release quality
* Your ability to drive projects to completion will unlock new IP releases and product milestones that depend on subsystem readiness

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical field
* 8\+ years of hands\-on RTL design experience with multiple tape\-outs under your belt, ideally in complex IP, subsystems, or SoC blocks
* Deep proficiency with Verilog or SystemVerilog and proven ability to write synthesizable, timing\-clean, low power RTL at scale
* Strong working knowledge of standard protocols such as PCIe, DDR, UFS, USB, or AMBA (AXI, AHB, APB)
* Hands\-on experience with low power design techniques including clock gating, power gating, retention, UPF, and multi\-voltage domain architecture
* Solid understanding of logic synthesis, constraint development (SDC), static timing analysis (STA), and equivalence checking flows
* Familiarity with DFT concepts including scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST, and how testability requirements shape design architecture, experience working directly with DFT teams is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a high\-level requirement document and turn it into a clean subsystem architecture without needing every detail spelled out for you
* You write RTL that passes lint, CDC, and synthesis checks on the first pass because you think about those constraints while you code, not after
* You can sit in a room with verification engineers, implementation leads, and DFT architects and walk out with a plan that actually works for everyone
* You push back when a specification is ambiguous or a timeline does not account for real design complexity, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You are organized enough to manage multiple release phases, cross\-functional dependencies, and shifting priorities without dropping threads
* You care about the quality of what you release, not just hitting the schedule, and you know how to balance both

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

description:
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent - a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists - and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system''s bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points - BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility - rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance - extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review - and document objects so client IT can maintain them. BATCH MANAGEMENT TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE - REQUIRED Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA - batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status - and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program''s largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity - SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents - and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output.Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage).Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud.SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management.ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP.SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite. Language Requirement - Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage - many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese - but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability. Engagement Details Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams. Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role Clean-core development discipline - CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration. SAP BTP Integration Suite - Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer. Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery - Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support. Batch and lot data expertise - batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic.  The Rubrik Cloud Native Protection team helps customers secure their data on the cloud. description:
**Job Description**
 Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem\-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI\-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM\-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
   

  

**Your Impact:**
* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production\-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise\-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python\-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context\-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.


**Qualifications**
**Your Skills \& Experience:**
* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands\-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool\-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time\-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding\-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security \& access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.


**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**
* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG\-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real\-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.


**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
 “AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands\-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future\-ready.
   

  

**Benefits of Working Here:**
* Gender\-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well\-being.


**Company Description**
 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start\-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem\-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000\+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

description:
**WHO WE ARE** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE:** 
 Senior Member of Technical Staff, Cloud Networking \& Network Security
 



 We're seeking a Senior Member of Technical Staff to own the design and delivery of cloud networking features that power enterprise multi\-cloud deployments. You'll tackle complex challenges spanning routing, NAT, IPSec/VPN tunneling, traffic engineering, firewall enforcement, and network observability across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. This role bridges strong individual contribution with growing technical influence, requiring 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in cloud networking, routing protocols, VPN technologies, or network security. You'll take technical ownership from design through production delivery, with increasing influence across the engineering team.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Design and implement cloud networking features across control plane and data plane systems, authoring design documents and driving features from conception through production delivery.
* Build and troubleshoot multi\-cloud network topologies including VPC/VNet segmentation, routing tables, cloud gateways, NAT gateways, security groups, and cloud\-native connectivity models across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
* Implement and troubleshoot routing protocols (BGP, policy\-based routing), IPSec/VPN configurations (site\-to\-site, route\-based, IKEv1/IKEv2\), and NAT systems (SNAT/DNAT).
* Write production\-grade code in Python and/or Go for networking services, agents, and tooling; develop comprehensive unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests for networking components.
* Debug complex networking issues using packet analysis tools (tcpdump, Wireshark), cloud\-native diagnostics, and IPSec tools; investigate and resolve issues across lab, staging, and production environments.
* Improve telemetry, logging, and alerting for networking and VPN systems to enhance operational visibility and reliability.
* Collaborate with senior engineers on architecture discussionsparticipate in code and design reviews, mentor junior team members on networking best practices, and document runbooks and designs.



  





**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of professional engineering experience building networking\-intensive systems at a networking company, cloud infrastructure provider, or equivalent organization.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of: cloud networking (AWS VPC, Azure VNet, GCP VPC, OCI VCN), routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, static routing), IPSec/VPN technologies, or network security product development.
* Strong understanding of IP networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, ARP, ICMP, DNS, subnetting, CIDR) and working knowledge of routing protocols, IPSec/IKEv2 tunneling, VPN architectures, NAT, and firewall concepts.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Go for writing clean, maintainable, production\-grade code; comfort with Linux networking tools (iptables, ip route, tcpdump, traceroute) and shell scripting.
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD workflows; demonstrated ability to debug complex networking issues methodically.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to independently own features from design through production delivery.



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Experience with advanced cloud networking services including transit gateways, peering, private link/endpoints, and load balancers across multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with Kubernetes networking including CNI plugins, service mesh technologies, and network policies in containerized environments.
* Experience with network automation frameworks such as Terraform or Ansible, or cloud\-native APIs for infrastructure\-as\-code provisioning.
* Familiarity with distributed systems concepts applied to networking, including consistency guarantees, fault tolerance, and replication strategies.

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 As a
 **Staff Software Engineer, Finance Integrations** 
 within Zscaler’s IT organization (reporting to the Manager, Integrations), you will lead the design and delivery of scalable integration and automation solutions supporting Finance transformation. In this role, you will partner closely with Finance stakeholders to modernize processes, reduce spreadsheet dependencies, improve data flow across systems, and deliver intelligent automation using APIs, middleware, RPA, and AI technologies. You will act as a key technical driver working across cross\-functional groups to deliver measurable business outcomes.

description:
**Why We Stand Out**
 Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!
   

  

 Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited's (the "Company") offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.
   

  

 The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back\-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well\-being. Our values are translated into action every day."
   

  

 Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri\-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
   

  

 The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023\. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
   

  

**Think you have what it takes?**
 This role spans four Microsoft platform disciplines — SharePoint development, Power Apps, Power BI, and Azure DevOps. The ideal candidate is a versatile M365 engineer who can build production\-grade intranet solutions, automate business workflows, deliver self\-service analytics, and maintain the DevOps pipelines that keep it all running reliably.
   

  

**Requirements**
**How You'll Contribute:**
**SharePoint Online Development**
* Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, portals, and intranet experiences that serve KR's internal teams — including department hubs, document libraries, approval workflows, and knowledge bases
* Develop custom SharePoint solutions using SPFx (SharePoint Framework) web parts, extensions, and application customizers — delivering rich, branded experiences that conform to the KR design system
* Configure and manage SharePoint site architecture: site collections, hub sites, managed metadata, content types, taxonomy, permissions hierarchies, and information architecture
* Build SharePoint\-integrated workflows and forms using Power Automate and Power Apps — eliminating manual, email\-based processes with structured, auditable digital workflows
* Implement SharePoint as the firm's primary document management and collaboration platform — migrating content from legacy systems, configuring retention policies, and applying sensitivity labels via Microsoft Purview
* Optimize SharePoint performance: page load times, search configuration, content query tuning, and CDN integration
* Conduct regular governance reviews of SharePoint environments — identifying sprawl, inactive sites, overly permissive access, and opportunities to consolidate and rationalize


**Power Apps Development**
* Design and build Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps in Power Apps to replace manual workflows, paper\-based processes, and disconnected spreadsheet\-driven operations across KR's service lines
* Develop responsive, mobile\-friendly Power Apps that connect to SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and REST APIs — delivering cohesive user experiences across desktop and mobile
* Implement complex business logic in Power Apps using Power Fx, custom connectors, and component libraries — following reusable, maintainable development patterns
* Build and maintain Dataverse solutions for structured business data — defining tables, relationships, forms, views, business rules, and role\-based security aligned to KR's data governance standards
* Integrate Power Apps with Power Automate flows, SharePoint document libraries, and Azure\-hosted APIs — creating end\-to\-end solutions that automate and digitize business processes
* Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination and post\-deployment support for Power Apps — gathering feedback, resolving defects, and iterating toward adoption
* Apply ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) practices for Power Platform solutions — using Azure DevOps pipelines and solution packaging for structured, repeatable deployments across Dev, Test, and Production environments


**Power BI Development \& Analytics**
* Design and build Power BI reports and dashboards that deliver actionable business intelligence to KR's leadership, advisory teams, and operational stakeholders — replacing Domo and legacy reporting tools as part of KR's BI modernization initiative
* Develop semantic models (datasets) in Power BI Desktop using DAX — building robust, reusable measures, calculated columns, and hierarchies that serve as the single source of truth for each reporting domain
* Connect Power BI to KR's data sources: Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, SQL databases, SharePoint lists, and REST APIs — using DirectQuery, Import, and Composite models appropriately
* Build and maintain Power BI dataflows for reusable, governed data transformation logic — applying Power Query (M) to cleanse, reshape, and standardize data before it reaches report layers
* Implement Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Object\-Level Security (OLS) in Power BI — ensuring reports enforce data access rules that align with KR's client confidentiality and internal access control requirements
* Publish and manage Power BI content in workspaces — configuring refresh schedules, gateway connections, deployment pipelines, and sensitivity labels for published reports
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, validate data accuracy, and iterate on dashboard design — translating business questions into well\-structured, intuitive visuals
* Document all semantic models, data source connections, and report logic — maintaining a living data dictionary that supports governance, audit, and onboarding of new developers


**Azure DevOps Engineering**
* Build, configure, and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for M365 and Power Platform workloads — automating build, test, and deployment processes for SPFx solutions, Power Platform solutions, and supporting APIs
* Manage Azure DevOps Boards for assigned initiatives — maintaining Epic/Feature/Story/Task hierarchy, sprint structure, board hygiene, and workflow automation rules in coordination with the PO/BA
* Configure branch strategies, pull request policies, and code review gates in Azure Repos — enforcing quality standards and protecting production deployments from unreviewed changes
* Implement automated testing stages in CI/CD pipelines — unit tests, integration tests, and deployment validation checks — reducing manual release verification effort
* Maintain environment configurations across Dev, Test, and Production for all M365 and Power Platform workloads — using variable groups, service connections, and environment approvals
* Monitor pipeline health and build metrics — proactively identifying flaky tests, slow builds, and deployment failures, and resolving them before they impact delivery velocity
* Support the Azure Architect in extending Azure DevOps practices to other KR application workloads as the firm's DevSecOps maturity grows


**Governance, Security \& Platform Health**
* Apply Microsoft 365 governance standards across all deliverables — sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, conditional access, and information barriers where required
* Implement Power Platform governance: environment strategy (Dev/Test/Prod), DLP connector policies, solution management, and usage analytics via Power Platform Admin Center
* Collaborate with the IT Security team to ensure SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power BI solutions comply with KR's security standards — including Entra ID authentication, least\-privilege access, and audit logging
* Contribute to KR's M365 Center of Excellence (CoE) — building reusable component libraries, templates, coding standards, and developer guidance that raise the quality baseline across the team


**Collaboration \& Delivery**
* Work directly from user stories and acceptance criteria provided by the Bengaluru PO/BA and US stakeholders — asking clarifying questions early and flagging platform constraints before sprint commitment
* Participate in all sprint ceremonies — planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives — contributing estimates, surfacing blockers, and demoing completed solutions to business stakeholders
* Produce and maintain technical documentation for every deliverable: solution architecture, data source mappings, deployment guides, and user guides — so solutions are maintainable and transferable
* Mentor junior developers on the Bengaluru team on SharePoint, Power Platform, and Azure DevOps best practices


**What Skills You'll Bring:**
**Required**
* 4\+ years of hands\-on development experience across Microsoft 365 / Power Platform technologies in a professional environment
* Proficiency in SharePoint Online development — SPFx web parts and extensions, site architecture, permissions management, and content management
* Hands\-on Power Apps development — Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps, Power Fx, Dataverse, and custom connector integration
* Power BI development experience — semantic model design, DAX, Power Query (M), RLS/OLS implementation, and report/dashboard delivery
* Proficiency in Azure DevOps — CI/CD pipeline configuration (YAML), Azure Repos, Boards management, and release management
* Familiarity with Power Automate for workflow automation integrated with SharePoint and Power Apps
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, and M365 security and compliance tooling
* Experience with ALM practices for Power Platform: solution packaging, environment management, and DevOps\-integrated deployments
* Excellent written and spoken English — ability to communicate solution designs and delivery status to US\-based non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred**

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The Technical Architect \- DevOps is responsible for advising, designing, and managing deployment orchestration solutions for complex Salesforce implementations. This role requires close collaboration with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, Solution Architects, and Account Teams, as well as direct client engagement to architect DevOps solutions tailored to their needs.
   

  

 The Technical Architect \- DevOps ensures solutions align with industry best practices to drive long\-term customer success. This hands\-on role involves architectural work and, when necessary, deployment execution. You are both a big\-picture thinker and an in\-depth problem solver, with broad and deep technical expertise. You take pride in designing resilient systems that withstand high volumes and critical demands while balancing technical and enterprise\-level considerations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations.
* Assess existing DevOps processes, tools, and practices, recommending improvements.
* Design, present, and implement best\-fit DevOps solutions, considering customer needs, tool preferences, and commercial constraints.
* Drive the selection and implementation of DevOps tools and technologies.
* Lead DevOps design sessions, architect solutions, and document best practices.
* Develop and enforce DevOps frameworks and governance models for consistency across deployments.
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects.
* Ensure successful continuous delivery deployments across environments.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including discovery sessions, technical deep dives, and proof\-of\-concept (PoC) development.
* Collaborate with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations.
* Travel to client sites as needed (estimated 50\-75%).


**Requirements (Technical Skillset)**
* 10\+ years of CRM experience, with at least 8 years on the Salesforce platform.
* Expert knowledge of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Experience, Industries (Vlocity), and Data Cloud.
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, version control best practices, and deployment methodologies.
* Understanding of branching strategies such as Git Flow, Trunk\-based development, Feature branching
* Salesforce Development Lifecycle – Metadata API, SFDX (Salesforce DX), Salesforce CLI, Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Salesforce Release \& Deployment Strategies – Sandbox management, Source\-driven development, Change sets, Unlocked \& Managed Packages.
* Experience with CI/CD tools: Copado, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI.
* Experience with Version Control Systems \- Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, Azure Repos.
* Strong grasp of software configuration management (Chef) and release management.

description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Identity and Access Management team is responsible for building a secure, reliable, and seamless identity platform for all Postman users. This team owns the systems behind authentication, session management, access control, service accounts, invites, and other foundational identity capabilities that power the product.
   

  

 Postman’s identity layer is a critical part of the product experience. It sits on the path of every authenticated request and enables users, teams, and systems to access Postman securely and collaborate effectively. The team works on a mix of core platform improvements, new product capabilities, and reliability/security investments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, build, and evolve backend systems that power Postman’s identity and authentication platform.
* Own projects end to end: clarify requirements, drive technical design, implement solutions, manage rollout, and support production.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to scope, build, test, and launch new features and platform improvements.
* Improve system reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness for services owned by the team.
* Make sound technical trade\-offs between speed, quality, and long\-term maintainability in a fast\-moving environment.
* Lead execution for projects involving 2–3 engineers when needed, including task breakdown, technical guidance, and code reviews.
* Participate in debugging, incident response, root cause analysis, and long\-term production fixes.
* Raise engineering quality by improving test coverage, reviewing designs and code, and advocating for strong software engineering practices.
* Partner with your manager on roadmap, prioritization, and SLAs for the services you own.
* Help create a team culture of ownership, reliability, and continuous improvement.


**About You**
* You have 5\+ years of experience building complex backend or distributed systems at scale.
* You have experience designing and operating production systems with strong reliability requirements.
* You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems and driving them from idea to production with minimal supervision.
* You have experience leading or guiding small groups of engineers on execution.
* You have strong engineering fundamentals in areas like distributed systems, networking, data modeling, and system design.
* You write code that is testable, maintainable, and easy to understand.
* You are comfortable making architectural and implementation trade\-offs, and can explain the reasoning clearly.
* You collaborate well with cross\-functional stakeholders and are comfortable respectfully challenging PMs, EMs, and peers when needed.
* You care about production quality, observability, and operational excellence, not just feature delivery.
* You have good written and verbal communication skills.


**Technical Experience We Value**
* Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, Go, or Ruby
* Strong understanding of distributed systems and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building or operating microservices at scale
* Experience with databases, caching, queues, and event\-driven systems
* Experience with testing, monitoring, and incident response
* Familiarity with authentication, authorization, identity, RBAC, access control, or security\-sensitive systems is a plus, but not required


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.
