description:
Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The Battery Pack Product Owner is accountable for the end\-to\-end definition, delivery, and lifecycle management of one or more battery pack products across Agratas’ targeted markets (e.g., Passenger Vehicle (PV), Commercial Vehicle (CV), and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)). The role acts as the central integrator across systems engineering, design engineering, cell, BMS, manufacturing, and commercial functions, ensuring delivery of competitive, safe, compliant, and cost\-effective battery pack solutions aligned to customer and business needs.
   

  

 In addition to owning the battery pack product, the role is responsible for defining, managing, and coordinating Battery Management System (BMS) requirements, feature content, integration activities, and delivery execution to ensure successful deployment of complete battery system solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibility Areas
   

  

 Customer Interface and Technical Leadership
   

  

* Function as the main customer interface for technical battery system topics with the Agratas Program Management team.
* Lead cross\-functional alignment across Pack Engineering, BMS, Cell, Manufacturing, Systems Engineering, and Quality.
* Lead customer and supplier meetings with relevant engineering leads on battery system technical topics.
* Communicate development progress and lead resolution of technical concerns with engineering teams and suppliers.
* Provide technical leadership for battery system integration, including battery pack and BMS customer requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for customer concerns and technical trade\-off decisions.


 Development Planning and Execution
   

  

* Drive product trade\-offs across cost, performance, safety, manufacturability, serviceability, and scalability.
* Own product KPIs including cost, energy density, reliability, safety, and feature maturity.
* Plan and monitor battery pack and BMS development against program milestones.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Hardware, Software, and Systems teams to align program timelines and PI goals using SCRUM.
* Support PM in development timing, resources, cost estimates, and technical risk management.
* Lead BMS feature delivery and integration activities against program milestones.
* Coordinate hardware and software development for successful BMS deployment within the battery pack.
* Provide regular development status reports to internal and external stakeholders.


 Requirements Analysis and Product Definition
   

  

* Translate customer, regulatory, and business requirements into engineering product requirements.
* Own battery pack system definition, architecture, performance targets, and product features.
* Own BMS requirements, feature definitions, interfaces, and functional performance targets.
* Collaborate with customers, ESP, third\-party suppliers, Systems Engineering, and component teams to define and publish battery system requirements.
* Act as the primary customer contact for requirement reviews and approvals.
* Establish and maintain product requirement baselines and documentation throughout development.
* Own feature prioritization and requirement traceability across Pack and BMS development.


 Production Readiness and Quality Assurance
   

  

* Ensure battery system sign\-off and production readiness.
* Serve as Product Owner in Agile development, ensuring timely TLA, hardware, and software releases within the Agratas NPI process.
* Lead customer and supplier resolution of Pack, BMS, and integration issues throughout development.
* Support FTA, FMEA, 8D problem\-solving, and applicable quality documentation.
* Support Engineering and Quality teams in customer reporting and compliance validation.
* Own the battery system feature maturity matrix for Pack and BMS development.
* Oversee battery pack, BMS, and PDU integration, verification, and validation.
* Support ASPICE, ISO 26262, and ISO 21434 compliance activities where applicable.


 Strategic Planning and Roadmap Development
   

  

* Contribute to battery product strategy and technology roadmaps.
* Define future battery pack and BMS feature roadmaps aligned with customer and market requirements.
* Identify technology trends and integrate innovative battery system solutions.
* Work with R\&D teams and strategic partners to evolve battery system functionality and performance.
* Support Agratas\-owned battery system and BMS IP, requirements, models, tools, and engineering capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement in product functionality, quality, performance, and customer value.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
* Proven experience in HV battery systems, battery pack development, Battery Management Systems, and automotive control units.
* Strong background in automotive product development, qualification processes, and technical documentation.
* Experience managing system\-level requirements, product roadmaps, and cross\-functional development activities.
* Knowledge and experience with automotive quality management tools such as FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and 8D methodologies.
* First\-hand experience in ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity for Automotive Systems).
* First\-hand experience with CAN tools, diagnostics, requirements management tools, and JIRA (or equivalent) for project tracking and product management.
* Working knowledge of embedded software development, software release processes, and Agile methodologies (SCRUM).
* Understanding of HV battery packs, Battery Disconnect Units (BDU), Power Distribution Units (PDU), and battery system architectures.
* First\-hand experience developing battery pack and/or BMS architectures and their associated requirements.
* Familiarity with verification and validation processes including Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SiL), Model\-in\-the\-Loop (MiL), Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HiL), system integration, and vehicle\-level testing.
* Previously worked on a project from Kick\-off to Job 1/Start of Production.
* Knowledge of State of Charge (SoC), State of Health (SoH), State of Power (SoP), balancing strategies, diagnostics, and prognostic systems.
* First\-hand experience with cell development is beneficial but not required.


**Additional Skills And Attributes**
* Strong leadership, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.
* Problem\-solving collaborative mindset with an ability to drive engineering solutions effectively.
* Initiative\-taking and adaptable to fast\-paced automotive development environments.

 At Kuehne\+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:

 Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Data domain. description:
**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager (US Region)\- HYD based**
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
   

  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment


**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.


**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

**About The Job**
 Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. Operating across all major Product Areas including Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay, Pixel, Android, and Play the CoE creates defensible market moats and drives user habituation across some of the core User Segments: Youth, Premium, Merchants, and Bharat, among others.
   

  

 As the Senior Strategic Alliance Lead, you will play a role in hunting and scoping, architecting high\-impact agreements and be the strategic steward of Google India’s partnership portfolio.  Notion’s Content Onboarding team builds the systems that help customers move content into Notion, get started faster, and keep growing reliably over time. The role matters because one of Notion’s core differentiators is replacing multiple tools — and that only becomes real when customers can get their information out of those tools and into Notion with confidence. You’ll partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of our content importers, internal administrative tooling, and compliance workflows like exports.
   

  

 This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

* Shape the technical and product vision for Notion’s import systems, so customers can pull content from more sources and transform it into a trustworthy system of record.

You’ll connect AI\-era and agentic workflow patterns to onboarding and import experiences — using AI to improve product judgment, prototyping, and engineering quality from design through production.
* By the end of your first year, engineering excellence will be a team norm: reliable systems, clear operational standards, and a shared understanding of what it takes to keep critical workflows running.  Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \- Develop, create, and curate engaging content (graphics, photos, stories, etc.) that resonates with our target audience.
 



 \- Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to produce high\-quality visual assets

title: Research Fellow
description:

 The Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in CoreAI, Microsoft, invites applications for research fellow (RF) positions. FoSSE is an applied research team focused on solving real\-world software engineering problems for large codebases, including code migration, code translation, and static analysis, using AI and formal methods. Our RF program provides an opportunity to work on practical research problems while collaborating closely with Microsoft researchers and product groups. RFs spend 1\-2 years with us and receive ongoing guidance and mentoring from experienced colleagues.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Apply with your CV and at least one letter of recommendation. The letter(s) must be submitted directly by the letter writers via email to fosse\-hiring@microsoft.com. Applications will be considered on an ongoing basis. For any queries, please write to fosse\-hiring@microsoft.com.
   

  

 The positions are based in Bangalore, where we are co\-located with Microsoft Research India. FoSSE provides an excellent research environment and a welcoming, diverse community. The team includes full\-time researchers and engineers, along with postdocs, interns, and research fellows in fixed\-term roles. Learn more about Microsoft’s commitment to Global Diversity and Inclusion here.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Working with FoSSE and other Microsoft colleagues on applied research problems at the intersection of PL, SE, and AI.
* Experimenting with and building tools that work on real world and large code bases.


**Qualifications**
 Candidates should have completed their Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are seeking a high\-caliber professional to join our Marketing Communications team under the Communications group, in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram office. This team produces fundraising materials and investor\-focused communications that are integral to firm’s fundraising, client service, and asset retention efforts across investment strategies. The role sits at the intersection of investment expertise, strategic communications, and storytelling, helping translate complex investment concepts into clear, compelling narratives for sophisticated institutional audiences. The successful candidate will serve as a key contributor to the firm's content and communications platform, partnering closely with investment professionals, product specialists, investor relations teams, legal, and senior leadership to create institutional\-grade communication materials that reflect analytical rigor, strategic clarity, and intellectual sophistication.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 You will draft, review, and refine investor\-facing communications that support both existing and new investment products, developing content for strategy presentations, product materials, investment insights, fundraising documents, and investor updates. You will translate complex investment strategies, portfolio positioning, risk frameworks, and performance drivers into clear, structured, and compelling institutional communication, while maintaining high\-quality content libraries to support efficient and scalable documentation. You will elevate the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of messaging across investor\-facing materials, and support the preparation of investor diligence materials, consultant questionnaires, and RFP responses as needed. You will partner with portfolio managers, product specialists, and senior investment professionals to distill investment views into concise and engaging narratives, helping shape how the firm communicates investment opportunities, competitive differentiation, and market perspectives to institutional investors. You will challenge and refine content to ensure clarity, precision, and audience relevance. You will build robust working relationships across investment, investor relations, legal, compliance, finance, and senior management teams, navigating complex stakeholder environments and synthesizing diverse perspectives into cohesive communications. You will drive content projects from concept to completion while managing multiple priorities and deadlines. You will leverage technology and AI\-enabled tools to enhance content creation, maintenance, and distribution processes, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency while preserving quality, accuracy, and intellectual rigor.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree from a top\-tier institution in journalism, communications, English literature, economics, finance, business or public policy or a related discipline
* 2–5 years of experience creating published content, investment communications, market commentary, thought leadership, or investor\-facing materials within financial services, business media, investment publishing, or related industries
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
* Solid editing, proofreading, and content development capabilities with meticulous attention to detail
* Demonstrated ability to manage projects independently and collaborate effectively across functions and seniority levels
* Robust critical thinking skills and intellectual curiosity, particularly regarding financial markets and investing
* Readiness to submit writing samples and complete a writing assessment as part of the interview process


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience authoring market commentary, investment insights, thought leadership content, white papers, published articles, newsletters, or other analytical content
* Exposure to asset management, hedge funds, alternative investments, private markets, capital markets, wealth management, or institutional investing
* Experience working directly with investment professionals, portfolio managers, product specialists, or senior business stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to simplify sophisticated financial concepts for professional audiences
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, and Excel


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/AnaSrAnaMarCommsJuly26

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
 Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world\-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Senior Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 You’ll analyze Treasury operations to design future\-state models, support Kyriba solution design, and configure static data for Treasury processes. You’ll automate cash reconciliation, enable bank statement integration, set up Cash Position worksheets, and manage cash forecasting with ERP integration. Responsibilities include interfacing Kyriba with systems like ICD, FXALL, and Oracle, establishing cash pools, configuring payment workflows, and adding Chart of Accounts for accounting. You’ll also handle documentation, user guides, end\-user training, and team coordination to ensure seamless Treasury operations.
   

  

**The team:**
 Controllership \& Treasury Transformation (C\&TT) is one of the offerings within the Finance Transformation portfolio of Deloitte US India Consulting. This Offering advises, implements, and delivers solution as\-a\-service relating to digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, enterprise performance strategies and technologies solutions. By taking a holistic view of these key business areas from strategy development through process design and technology enablement, we help our clients navigate their challenges while continuing to succeed in their business.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Kyriba – Working knowledge of at least two Kyriba modules like Core Data, Bank and Cash, Payments, Accounting, Financial Transactions, Security. Exposure to Kyriba Connectivity, BAM and BFA would be an added advantage
* Payments formats – XML Pain, EDI822, MT101 etc.
* Bank statement formats – MT940/42, BAI, CAMT053 etc.
* A good understanding of Treasury, Cash Management, Cash Pools, Account structures, and global Payment methods
* Job skills – Interpersonal Communication, Critical Thinking, Decision Making
* Total experience of 5 to 8 years, 2\+ years of experience directly in implementing Treasury management solutions (Kyriba)
* Kyriba Certification – Gold or above (Platinum, Platinum Plus)


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Big 4 experience


**Education:**
* B.Tech/CA/MBA degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata


**Shift Timings:**
* 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirement

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life.  Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

title: Project Lead- Telangana
description:
**About Khan Academy**
 Khan Academy is a fast\-paced, nonprofit on a mission to provide free, world\-class education for anyone, anywhere. We reach millions of students every month and are growing rapidly. We’re building a library of world\-class instructional and practice resources that empowers learners. Whether they’re studying matrices, mitosis, or multivariable calculus, we want to offer students the resources to realize that they can learn anything.
   

  

**About Khan Academy India**
 Khan Academy India aims to deliver a world\-class user experience to learners in India that is locally relevant and is enabled by a strong on\-the\-ground team and operations. Our learning system is mastery\-based, which allows students to master key concepts at a pace that’s right for them before moving on to more challenging content. From serving under 500,000 learners in 2016, we are now serving almost 10 million learners a month across our websites, apps and youtube channels. These learners include both independent learners accessing us at home and teacher directed learners in schools. Our focus is to reach the underserved by making our content accessible in local languages and by working with large public school systems. Khan Academy is already available in English, Assamese, Hindi, Hinglish, Odia, Marathi, Kannada, Telugu and Punjabi.
   

  

**About The India Schools Team**
 In line with our focus to reach the underserved, we partner with government school systems to improve student learning outcomes by enabling teachers and students to optimally utilize the tools and resources on the Khan Academy platform. From our government partnerships, we have reached 2 million learners this last year, partnering with 65,000\+ schools across various states. Our goal is to expand our scale to reach over five million learners in five years.
   

  

 The Schools Team works in a lean and collaborative way with our partners, developing strong implementation plans and providing support at every step of the way. Specifically, the team supports teachers and administrators through training and resources, and enabling peer\-to\-peer sharing. We learn and constantly iterate by gathering feedback and through data\-backed insights and efficacy studies.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Khan Academy India is looking for a passionate individual to join our growing Schools Team as a Project Lead consultant to support our programme with the school education department in Telangana. The role will be based in Hyderabad. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the implementation of the Khan Academy programme in the state, in collaboration with the Department of School Education, Telangana. You will also work closely with Khan Academy India’s Content team, Partner Operations, Teacher Professional Development, and Data and Efficacy teams to ensure high\-quality implementation of our programme.
   

  

 Please note that is a contract\-based role (12\-months contract, subject to extension).
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To**
* Support programme implementation: Work with Department of School Education, Telangana and the state nodal officer to help support the implementation of the Khan Academy learning platform across government schools in Telangana.
+ Take ownership of work streams and deliver on the pre\-agreed goals
+ Deliver and support in delivering training to education officials (Khan Academy program mentors/administrative cadre) and teachers on a regular basis.
+ Follow up on training implementation and unearth insights and challenges to strengthen the program for all teachers continuously.

* Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with administration officials which include nodal officers, state resource persons, district\-level officers, and school stakeholders.
* Gather data\-backed insights: Assist the program and partners throughout the implementation to take the right decisions based on data\-backed insights.
* Regularly conduct field visits(3\-4/week) and have regular touchpoints with the officers and teachers to generate insights from the schools that will help the Khan Academy team identify strategic levers to increase adoption and deepen usage of Khan Academy.
* Manage knowledge effectively: Ensure that all state discussions are documented in a standard format and keep key stakeholders (internal and external) in the loop.
* Build our learning muscle by analyzing qualitative feedback from the state systems
* Collaborate with the rest of the teams at Khan Academy India to ensure timely and successful delivery of our program and services.
* Provide any other support, as needed, for the programme.


**About You**
**You would be a great fit for the role if you are:**
* Someone with 5\+ yrs of relevant work experience. Having been an educator or having worked with government schools in Telangana is an added advantage.


**Fluent in English and Telugu (reading, speaking and writing)**
* Someone with a strong collaborative mindset with an ability to build and maintain relationships with various stakeholders
* Able to navigate through complex situations comfortably and make informed decisions aligned with the shared goals between partners and Khan Academy.
* Someone with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage a variety of tasks simultaneously.
* Someone with an excellent ability to document information from multiple sources and present it in a consumable format for others in English and Telugu.
* Comfortable working with data – you are skilled at working with large volumes of data, identifying trends, and drawing evidence\-based conclusions. You are equally comfortable analyzing qualitative insights and adjusting partnership plans accordingly.
* A great communicator – you can address different audiences using audience\-appropriate language to communicate clearly and efficiently in multiple formats, including email, written documents, digital presentations, and verbal conversations.
* A quick learner – you immerse yourself in new problems and quickly get up to speed.
* Someone with an entrepreneurial mindset, including a high tolerance for ambiguity, a penchant for experimentation, and a bias toward action.
* Willing to roll up your sleeves and help the team get work done as we grow.
* Passionate about education and have a strong desire to change the world for the better.


**Comfortable being based out of Hyderabad and traveling regularly across different schools in the state of Telangana.**

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Ethos is looking for a Lead Business Analyst to join our Sales Strategy \& Operations team supporting B2C sales. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role sitting at the intersection of sales analytics, process optimization, and systems ownership. In this role, you'll translate complex data into decisions that directly move revenue.
   

  

 The Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst will drive infrastructure that powers our sales teams: funnel reporting, performance dashboards, experiment analysis, and the data quality standards. You're the kind of person who loves digging into data, spots broken metrics before anyone else notices, already has a hypothesis about why, and ships a fix before the next standup.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
***Analytics \& Insights***
* Own end\-to\-end reporting across the marketing\-to\-sales funnel, including leading indicators (dial volume, connect rate), in\-process metrics (CVR by segment, handle time), and lagging outcomes (issued AP, persistency)
* Build and maintain dashboards in Mode, Hex, and Amplitude that give sales leadership a real\-time pulse on performance
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on conversion rate trends, agent performance, campaign effectiveness, and channel mix; surface findings in a format executives can act on
* Design and evaluate A/B experiments across outreach cadences, agent workflows, and channel strategies; communicate results with statistical rigor and business context
* Partner with Sales and Finance on building models to help define initiatives such as compensation plans,headcount requirements, and other business critical models


***AI Native***
* Fluent in leveraging AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive workflows, and surface insights faster
* Default to AI\-augmented workflows: uses large language models to draft, analyze, and iterate at speed, while maintaining the judgment to know when to verify, push back, or go deeper
* Actively integrates AI into day\-to\-day work; from writing SQL and building dashboards to synthesizing qualitative feedback


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 4\+ years in Data Analytics, Revenue Operations, or a closely related analytical role — ideally in a B2C or high\-velocity phone sales environment
* Strong SQL skills; experience querying large datasets to answer open\-ended business questions, not just pull pre\-defined reports
* Hands\-on experience with dashboarding and analytics tools (Salesforce, Mode, Amplitude, Hex, or similar)
* Familiarity with sales tech stack tools like Regal, Balto, or comparable dialer/QA platforms is a plus
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: you scope your own work, ask the right clarifying questions, and don't wait for a fully defined spec to get started
* Strong English communication skills both written and verbal
* High bar for data accuracy; you treat a wrong number in a dashboard as a fire, not a footnote
* Available to work onsite in our Bangalore office on night shift hours (3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST) to align with US\-based sales teams


**Nice to Have**
* Master of Business Administration
* Experience with insurance, fintech, or other licensed sales environments
* Exposure to compensation modeling, quota design, or headcount planning workflows


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

Technical Recruiter
description:
**About the Role:** 




 The Technical Recruiter will be responsible for end\-to\-end hiring delivery of technology and support roles for:
 


* Arcot Group companies – Arcitech.ai, AllTalent.com, Haire.ai, ProSchool.ai and other internal projects.
* External client mandates that require tech talent and support staff.



 This is a hands\-on, target\-driven role focused on active, outbound sourcing – not just processing incoming applications.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 You will:
 


* Own the recruitment lifecycle for assigned roles – from intake to joining.
* Focus mainly on tech positions while also handling non\-tech/support hiring depending on business needs.
* Spend a significant portion of your time on proactive sourcing via LinkedIn, job portals, and communities, rather than only relying on direct applicants.
* Work closely with the Recruitment Manager and hiring managers to close positions within agreed timelines and quality standards.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Requirement Understanding \& Role Briefing
 


* Attend detailed intake meetings with the Recruitment Manager / hiring managers to understand:
* Tech stack, tools, and frameworks required
* Must\-have vs good\-to\-have skills
* Experience range, budget, and location preferences
* Role context, reporting, and career growth
* Ask clarifying questions where needed and ensure screening criteria and search strategy are clearly defined before sourcing.



  





 2\. Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Building
 


* Take full ownership of active sourcing, not just processing applicants from posted jobs.
* Use LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, and other job portals extensively to identify and reach out to relevant candidates.
* Build and continuously refine Boolean search strings and advanced search filters to narrow down to the right profiles quickly.
* Proactively send connection requests, InMails, emails, and job portal messages to targeted candidates with tailored outreach, followed by systematic follow\-ups.
* Tap into multiple channels beyond job boards:
* Employee and external referrals
* GitHub / Stack Overflow and other tech communities
* WhatsApp/Telegram groups, alumni networks, meetups, and online forums
* Build and maintain role\-wise talent pools for recurring roles such as:
* Developers (frontend, backend, full\-stack, mobile)
* DevOps / Cloud / SRE
* Data / AI / ML engineers
* QA / Automation testers
* Product and business analysts
* Support roles (operations, customer success, sales, marketing, etc.)
* Ensure all sourcing activity and candidate touchpoints are logged accurately in the ATS / trackers.



  





 3\. Screening \& Assessment
 


* Conduct initial telephonic / video screening to evaluate:
* Technical skills and relevant stack exposure
* Complexity and relevance of previous projects
* Communication skills and cultural fit
* Alignment with compensation, notice period, location, and work setup expectations
* Coordinate technical assessments / coding tests / assignments as required and follow up for completion.
* Quickly calibrate profiles with the Recruitment Manager / hiring managers by sharing a first batch of sourced candidates and aligning on what “good” looks like.
* Present shortlisted candidates with structured notes (skills summary, notice period, CTC, reasons for fit, potential risks).



  





 4\. Interview Coordination \& Process Management
 


* Schedule interviews with internal stakeholders and/or clients, sharing clear information with candidates (role, panel, format).
* Ensure interviewers have updated resumes, your screening notes, and any test results in advance.
* Keep candidates informed about timelines, feedback expectations, and next steps.
* Collect and record structured feedback from interviewers; update ATS/trackers promptly.
* Escalate bottlenecks or delays to the Recruitment Manager and propose solutions (parallel pipelines, wider search, adjusted criteria, etc.).



  





 5\. Offer Management \& Joining
 


* Support the Recruitment Manager / HR in preparing offer details / CTC structures.
* Clearly explain offer components to candidates and handle queries around salary structure, benefits, and role expectations.
* Manage offer negotiation within guidelines and keep candidates engaged until joining (check\-ins, documentation support, pre\-joining engagement).
* Coordinate with HR operations / onboarding for smooth joining – documentation, systems access, induction schedules.



  





 6\. ATS, Reporting \& Documentation
 


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the ATS / trackers – including stages, notes, and communication history.
* Track and report your sourcing funnel metrics, including:



 Profiles identified → contacted → responded → screened → shortlisted → interviewed → offered → joined.
 


* Clearly mark candidates as sourced vs applied to help measure outbound impact.
* Share weekly updates with the Recruitment Manager on open roles, pipeline health, risks, and suggested corrective actions.



  





 7\. Market Intelligence \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Stay updated on tech recruitment trends, salary benchmarks, demand\-supply patterns, and competitor hiring.
* Share market feedback on challenging roles, skill shortages, or unrealistic expectations with the Recruitment Manager for calibration.
* Suggest improvements in JDs, search strategy, interview process, assessments, and candidate engagement based on your daily experience.



  





**Key Skills \& Requirements:** 



* Graduate (any discipline); specialization in HR / IT / related fields is an advantage.
* 2–5 years of experience in technical recruitment / IT staffing, preferably in a tech/startup or staffing / consulting environment.
* Strong comfort with hiring for tech roles (developers, data, QA, DevOps, product, etc.) and willingness to handle non\-tech/support roles as needed.
* Hands\-on experience in proactive sourcing using:
* LinkedIn (including advanced search techniques)
* Major job portals such as Indeed, Naukri, and others
* Boolean search and keyword strategies
* Good understanding of common tech skills and terminology (e.g Python, React, Node, microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL/NoSQL, etc.).
* Structured, process\-oriented working style with strong documentation and follow\-through.
* Strong communication and candidate engagement skills; ability to build rapport quickly.
* Comfortable working with targets, SLAs, and multiple simultaneous open roles.
* High ownership, persistence, and ability to work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

 Quality Assurance and Risk Management

 Process Optimisation and Innovation

description:
**Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships**
**About the Role:**
 JioStar is India's leading media and entertainment business, home to JioHotstar (500M\+ monthly active users) and the exclusive home of the IPL (₹47,551 Cr rights value), ICC events and India's most\-watched entertainment. With piracy costing India's video sector an estimated $1\.2 billion annually, content protection is a key priority.
   

  

 This is a build\-and\-lead mandate. The function operates as a lean, intelligence\-led command centre. The Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships will own operational strategy, platform governance, vendor management, law enforcement coordination and live\-event readiness across domestic and future international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy \& Operations:**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of JioStar's anti\-piracy strategy across broadcast, OTT, IPTV, social media and emerging ecosystems.
* Define the function's operating model, KPIs and business\-impact metrics — moving beyond volume\-based takedown counts.
* Lead international expansion planning: jurisdictional scoping, coalition partnerships, and phased capability build\-out.


**Platform Partnerships \& Escalation:**
* Own senior relationships with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs, hosting providers, registrars and CDNs.
* Lead escalation pathways for high\-priority takedowns, repeat\-offender action and live\-event enforcement.
* Represent JioStar in industry coalitions and platform trust \& safety forums (ACE, IBCAP, AAPA and equivalents).


**Live\-Event Anti\-Piracy Operations:**
* Command the live\-event anti\-piracy operation for IPL, ICC and premium events — 24/7 control\-room oversight, mobilization within hours.
* Establish playbooks for restream takedowns, app\-store enforcement and ISP\-level blocking during marquee fixtures.


**Intelligence, Investigations \& Vendor Governance:**
* Oversee the Intelligence \& Investigations and the Data, Automation \& Vendor Governance portfolio; ensure intelligence precedes every enforcement action.
* Govern the external vendor ecosystem: set SLAs, manage performance, rationalize the partner footprint and drive automation.


**Law Enforcement, Legal \& Regional Coordination:**
* Build senior relationships with national and state law enforcement, cyber cells, and MIB.
* Direct Regional Enforcement Coordinators on field operations, raids and state\-level piracy disruption.
* Partner with in\-house Legal on orders, dynamic injunctions, site\-blocking and criminal complaints.


**Executive Engagement:**
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Business, Legal, Distribution, Content Operations and Technology.
* Deliver executive reporting on threat landscape, enforcement outcomes and business impact to senior leadership.


**Required Experience \& Capabilities:**
* 15\+ years in OTT, digital media, broadcasting or Trust \& Safety, with a meaningful share in content protection, anti\-piracy, fraud or platform integrity.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-stakeholder enforcement programs at scale across digital, broadcast and physical distribution.
* Direct engagement with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs and hosting providers at a senior governance level.
* Deep, current understanding of digital piracy ecosystems — illegal IPTV networks, restream chains, Telegram piracy, cyberlockers and app\-based modalities.
* Intelligence orientation — approaches problems as an investigator, not an operator; comfortable with attribution analysis and OSINT outputs.
* Systems thinking, platform ecosystem fluency, operational maturity and strong stakeholder management at executive, regulatory and law\-enforcement levels.
* Live\-event content protection operations experience strongly preferred.


**Alternative Backgrounds Considered:**
*JioStar will actively consider Ex\-Armed Forces SSC officers (Indian Navy / Air Force) from Signals, Intelligence, Cyber or Information Warfare backgrounds with demonstrable platform\-ecosystem fluency.*

**Core Skills \& Experience**
* A minimum 8 years hands on experience of network solutions within a global enterprise scale organization (5,000\-50,000 users) with both traditional datacenters and Cloud.

**Technical Skills \& Experience**

* Network Routing, Switching and Network Security
* Cisco, Juniper – Routers \& Switches

* Cisco, Silver\-Peak SD\-WAN

* Public Cloud
* Azure Sentinel


**Technical Certification**

* CCNA, CCNA Security, CCNP Routing \& Switching
* Check Point CSSE
* SD\-WAN
* ITILv3 foundation or higher


 It would be desirable and advantageous to also have certification demonstrable working experience:
   

  

* CCIE Routing \& Switching, Or CCIE Data Center


**Personal Attributes**
* You will be highly organized and have proven ability to operate well under pressure, working to tight deadlines
* You will have good problem management and customer service skills.
* You will have a positive attitude and be capable of remaining positive even when under immense pressure.
* You will be able to work with global teams to deliver projects, often at pace and under challenging circumstances.
* You are someone with high professional standards, who never accepts the status\-quo; who challenges why things are done the way they are.
* You will be a strong communicator, both written and verbal
* You discourage hero culture and ensure the team always comes before the individual, although always ensuring for the welfare of staff at all times.
* You will always act with integrity and embrace the philosophy of treating our customers fairly (compulsory)
* You will work effectively as one IT community across the regions and the business
* You will embrace the philosophy and principles of group IT
* You understand and apply Northern Trust’s working practices, policies and procedures


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Interior Designer
description:
Role & responsibilities Job Description Interior Designer Position Interior Designer — Studio Role Overview We are looking for an Interior Designer to join our studio team. The ideal candidate should have a good basic aesthetic sense, strong design understanding, and the ability to develop ideas into detailed drawings and 3D visualisations. The role will involve working closely with the design team, consultants, vendors, and site teams to ensure that designs are executed accurately and that project updates are communicated on time. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop interior design concepts, layouts, furniture designs, material selections, and detailing as per project requirements. Create and modify AutoCAD drawings for plans, elevations, sections, furniture details, and execution drawings. Develop SketchUp 3D models and produce good-quality 3D renders to communicate design intent. Understand materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, hardware, and basic construction details. Coordinate with senior designers and the studio team during the design development process. Coordinate with different site vendors, contractors, carpenters, fabricators, electricians, painters, etc. Visit project sites when required and understand site conditions and execution requirements. Communicate design requirements clearly to vendors and site teams. Check work at site against approved drawings and designs and highlight discrepancies. Share timely site updates , photographs, measurements, progress reports, and issues with the studio team. Follow up with vendors to ensure that work is progressing as per the agreed timelines. Identify execution issues and coordinate with the design team for appropriate solutions. Maintain organised drawings, revisions, material details, and project documentation. Work within project timelines and ensure that assigned design and site-related tasks are completed on schedule. 
 Required Skills Design & Aesthetic Sense Good basic aesthetic sense and understanding of proportions, colours, materials, textures, and finishes. Ability to understand and develop design references into practical interior solutions. Good attention to detail and willingness to learn and improve design skills. 
 Software Skills — Must Have AutoCAD — Mandatory SketchUp — Mandatory 3D Rendering — Mandatory Basic knowledge of Photoshop/Enscape/V-Ray/Lumion or similar software will be an added advantage. 
 Site & Coordination Skills Basic understanding of interior execution and construction processes. Ability to read and understand architectural and interior drawings. Ability to coordinate with multiple vendors and contractors at site. Good follow-up skills and ability to track pending work. Ability to identify basic site/execution issues and communicate them clearly. 
 Communication Skills Basic communication skills are essential. Should be comfortable speaking with vendors, contractors, site supervisors, and the internal design team. Should be able to clearly communicate drawings, design intent, changes, and execution requirements. Must provide regular and timely updates regarding site progress, pending work, and issues. 
 Desired Qualities Creative and design-oriented approach. Good attention to detail. Responsible and organised. Proactive in following up on work. Ability to manage multiple tasks and project timelines. Willingness to visit sites and take ownership of assigned work. Ability to work collaboratively within a studio environment. Practical approach towards design and execution. Good attitude towards learning and taking feedback. 
 Experience 0–3 years of experience in interior design preferred. Freshers with strong software skills, good aesthetic sense, and a willingness to learn may also be considered. 
 Key Performance Expectations The candidate will be expected to: Develop designs that are aesthetically strong and practically executable. Produce accurate AutoCAD drawings and detailed SketchUp models. Create quality 3D renders that clearly communicate the proposed design. Coordinate effectively with vendors and site teams. Ensure timely communication and regular site updates . Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion. Maintain quality and attention to detail from design development through execution.

**Business Development \& Market Expansion**

* Track market trends, competitor activity, buying patterns, pricing movements, and regulatory developments.

**Channel Partner Management**
* Manage authorized distributors and channel partners in line with sales priorities and commercial policies.

* Identify coverage gaps and improve customer and market penetration.
* Support partners with product, pricing, promotional, and commercial inputs.
* Support distributors in achieving Annual Operating Plan (AOP) commitments.

**Customer Engagement \& Brand Visibility**
* Build strong relationships with end customers, distributors, influencers, and laboratory decision\-makers.

* Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills.

 This role offers an opportunity to play a key role in growing the
 **Research Chemicals business across India** 
 , working with leading pharmaceutical, research, analytical, healthcare, and industrial customers.
   

  

 The position provides strong visibility across
 **customers, channel partners, product teams, and business leadership** 
 , with significant opportunity to influence market growth and commercial strategy.
   

  

**About Us**
**About Solstice Advanced Materials**
 Solstice Advanced Materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. Solstice offers high\-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. Solstice is recognized for developing next\-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as Solstice®, Genetron®, Aclar®, Spectra®, Fluka™, and Hydranal™. Partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, Solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. For more information, visit Advanced Materials .

title: Senior Accounts Officer
description:
**Position Overview** 




 The Senior Accounts Officer will take ownership of day\-to\-day accounting operations and period\-end activities, ensuring that financial records are complete, accurate, timely, and supported by appropriate documentation. The role will also review transactional work, resolve exceptions, strengthen financial controls, support audits, and provide clear reporting to management and client stakeholders.
 



  





**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 



* General ledger ownership: Maintain ledger integrity through accurate coding, reconciliations, supporting schedules, and prompt correction of identified errors.
* Accounts payable: Oversee invoice processing, approval follow\-up, payment runs, supplier statement reconciliations, and resolution of pricing, duplication, or allocation issues.
* Accounts receivable \& credit control: Monitor billing, receipts, allocations, ageing, and overdue balances; coordinate collection follow\-ups and escalate risks appropriately.
* Banking \& cash: Complete bank and payment\-platform reconciliations, investigate unmatched items, monitor cash movements, and support cash\-flow reporting.
* Compliance \& controls: Apply accounting policies, tax and statutory requirements, delegated authorities, and internal control procedures; retain complete audit\-ready evidence.
* Stakeholder \& vendor management: Act as a reliable point of contact for clients, suppliers, operational teams, and internal stakeholders; resolve queries professionally and maintain clear status updates.
* Review \& team support: Review work prepared by junior team members, provide practical guidance, share knowledge, and help maintain standard operating procedures and process documentation.
* Process improvement: Identify recurring issues and opportunities for standardization, automation, stronger controls, and improved turnaround times; support implementation and track outcomes.
* Ad hoc responsibilities: Complete additional finance activities and analytical requests assigned by the client or management, while managing priorities and communicating delivery risks early.



  





**Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant accounting or finance operations experience, including hands\-on exposure to reconciliations and month\-end activities.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, journals, accruals, prepayments, and financial reporting.
* Experience using ERP software’s (like Xero) and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel; exposure to reporting or automation tools is advantageous.
* Experience supporting audits, maintaining process documentation, and working within defined controls and service timelines.

description:
**Role Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud DevOps Team Lead to lead and mentor a team of engineers responsible for designing, building, and supporting cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks. This role will drive secure, scalable, and reliable application delivery while providing technical leadership and hands\-on contribution across cloud platforms, infrastructure automation, containerization, and DevOps practices.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and mentor the Cloud DevOps team, providing technical guidance, coaching, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Design, deploy, manage, and support cloud infrastructure using Azure OR AWS, including provisioning, lifecycle management, scalability, and recovery support.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure deployment and management.
* Design, build, optimize, and support CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitLab OR Jenkins OR GitHub Actions OR Azure DevOps.
* Drive automation initiatives and develop infrastructure and operational automation using Python OR Shell scripting and Terraform.
* Implement and support containerized application environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Establish and maintain DevOps best practices to enhance reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to streamline deployment processes, improve release quality, and accelerate delivery cycles.
* Evaluate and adopt AI\-enabled development and DevOps capabilities, including GitHub Copilot OR AI technologies, to improve productivity and automation.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, pipeline, and deployment issues while ensuring platform stability and performance.


 Required Skills
   

  

 Proficient
   

  

* Azure OR AWS
* Python OR Shell scripting
* Terraform
* any CI/CD pipeline (GitLab or Jenkins or GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)
* Docker
* Kubernetes


 Knowledge
   

  

* GitHub Copilot OR AI


 Experience
   

  

* Minimum of seven years of experience in DevOps and Infrastructure.
* Experience working in large\-scale or enterprise cloud environments.
* Experience supporting cloud infrastructure, automation, and CI/CD implementations.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong focus on automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Leadership and team mentoring capabilities.


 Why Join UST
   

  

 At UST, you will work on technology\-driven transformation initiatives that help global enterprises solve complex business challenges. You'll have opportunities to contribute to innovative cloud and DevOps solutions, collaborate with talented teams worldwide, and continuously enhance your technical and leadership capabilities through ongoing learning and career growth opportunities.
   

  

**Skills**
 Azure/AWS, Python or Shell scripting, Terraform, any CI/CD pipeline (GitLab/Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), Docker, Kubernetes and practical exposure to GitHub Copilot/AI.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solutions Services Domain Architect to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, including applications, networks, and cloud integration. Your expertise will be crucial in vertical and horizontal integration across various cloud platforms and applications. Additionally, you will lead the execution of comprehensive testing, including functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, ensuring our solutions meet customer requirements.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing end\-to\-end test strategies.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, driving continuous improvement.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Senior Manager**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 In a world that’s changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our ‘North Star’ guiding our more than 300,000 people – providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. In doing so, we play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, clients, and communities. Thanks to our innovative services in auditing, tax consulting as well as transaction and management consulting, we proudly drive our clients into the future.
   

  

 From small businesses to some of the world’s best\-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information, and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, so whether you’re looking for a long\-term, or are interested in progressing on to other areas, this is a great place to be. As the only one of the Big 4 with a specialist cross‑border practice, we offer our clients seamless, consistent, and high‑quality services around the globe. With our Assurance Services, we strengthen public confidence in global capital markets and promote sustainable growth. If you’re looking to develop your individual skills whilst working in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams, come join us!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for an experienced professional to join EY FAAS, with deep expertise across FAAS solutions and a strong focus on engagements related to transactions and technical accounting governance.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will be responsible for leading a portfolio of complex, high‑impact client engagements, ensuring the timeliness, quality, and delivery of work in line with EY Global Standards. The role requires overseeing multiple engagement teams, driving technical excellence, and acting as a trusted advisor to clients on transaction‑related accounting matters.
   

  

 While the Senior Manager will be based out of one of our EY GDS locations globally, the individual will play a key role in supporting EY practices and clients across global markets, collaborating with onshore teams and senior stakeholders. The individual may also be required to travel internationally on short‑term assignments to support client engagements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client responsibilities**
* Lead consulting engagements focused on the planning and execution of Transactions initiatives (including planning and execution of IPOs, and/or the planning and execution of acquisitions and divestitures), looking at a company’s internal finance and accounting processes and advising clients on solutions to increase deal value / benefits, improve processing efficiency, drive automation or reengineer existing processes to better align with future state target operating models;
* Lead business development initiatives including service offering development and roll\-out, proposal development, responding to RFP’s and participating in oral presentations
* Stay informed of changing market conditions and new regulatory developments and their impacts on clients.
* Specialization in our Transactions service offering to provide subject matter expertise and relevant go\-to\-market activities in this area
* Manage the financial and commercial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking fees and communicating issues to project leaders; and
* Build strong internal relationships within our national and global FAAS practice and across EY’s service lines including Advisory, Tax and Assurance.
* Drive innovation by creating an environment that encourages innovation and being a leader in this area by implementing new and improved ways of working, delivery models and / or technological advancements


**People Management Responsibilities**
* Prioritize the development of people through effective coaching, constructive on\-the\-job feedback and mentoring
* Foster an innovative and inclusive team\-oriented work environment
* Effectively motivate teams with diverse skills and backgrounds
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff
* Lead/contribute to people initiatives including recruiting, retaining and training FAAS professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand, follow, and lead by example as it relates to workplace policies and procedures


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Technical accounting experience in IFRS and US GAAP
* In\-depth knowledge in several of:
+ IPO readiness assessment and management of activities across the IPO lifecycle. Past participation / involvement in an IPO would be an asset
+ Planning and integration of acquisitions across all aspects of Organization / People, Process and Technology including both project management and execution
+ Planning and management of disposals across all aspects of Organization / People, Process and Technology including both project management and execution
+ Audit or business experience in financial statement close

* Highly developed analytical skills focused on business case
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to think critically and identify creative solutions outside of the box and thrive on new challenges
* Proven track record with a blue\-chip consulting firm in the field or significant equivalent industry experience would be an asset
* Experience in leading and delivering program/projects that cover the full life cycle of assessment, design and implementation support
* Strong spoken and written English skills
* Leading and driving high\-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
* The ability to lead and work collaboratively in a team environment
* Dedication to teamwork, people development and leadership, with experience in managing and/or mentoring junior staff and providing direction to team members
* Excellent communication skills including verbal, written, and presentation
* A high level of motivation and a self\-starting attitude
* A willingness to travel on short notice to meet client needs


**Professional experience:**
 Typical experience may include, whilst not limited to:
   

  

* Experience of working in a consulting role in financial accounting and advisory or transaction advisory, or a transformation role in industry,
* Advanced skills and experience with: M\&A support, SPAC transactions, IPO readiness support, Carve\-out, GAAP conversions etc.
* Hands\-on consulting experience at a Big 4, or top tier consulting firm, or leading change programmes in industry, or leading a line function in a finance or controllership environment.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US) or ACCA (UK)
* 10\-13 years (post qualification) in Assurance including 5 years of Financial Accounting and Advisory experience
* Candidates with prior Big 4/Big 10 experience would be an added advantage
* Exposure to AI, data analytics and visualization tools (an added advantage)


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Job_Description":" DentalKart 
 Careers at DentalKart 
 Chat Expert 
 Customer Experience | Live Chat Desk 
 Location 
 DentalKart Head Office 
 Reports To 
 Team Leader / Ops Manager Customer Experience 
 Primary Channel 
 Live Chat (high concurrency), with working knowledge of Voice and Email 
 Experience 
 14 years, with chat handling in logistics / last-mile / e-commerce 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 DentalKart is looking for a Chat Expert who thrives on live chat and can genuinely hold maximum concurrency multiple real conversations running at once without dropping quality, tone, or accuracy on any single one. This is a chat-first role, but we need someone whose skillset doesnt stop at chat: you should be equally comfortable jumping on a call or writing a clean email when a case needs it, and you should understand what happens end-to-end when an order or delivery goes wrong. 
 You will be the first serious line of resolution for our customers fast enough to keep multiple chats moving, and sharp enough to actually solve the problem instead of just replying quickly. 
 WHAT YOULL OWN 
 - Maximum concurrency chat handling: Running multiple live chats simultaneously at a high concurrency level, keeping every customer moving without generic copy-paste replies or long response gaps. 
 - End-to-end escalation handling: Owning a query from first message to final resolution order issues, delivery delays, refunds, or product concerns rather than handing it off after the first response. 
 - Voice and email fluency: Stepping onto a call when a chat needs a human voice to resolve faster, and writing precise, professional emails for cases that need a documented trail. 
 - Logistics and last-mile understanding: Applying real knowledge of last-mile delivery, courier partners, and e-commerce order flows to give customers accurate updates instead of vague reassurances. 
 - Judgment under load: Reading tone in a chat and adjusting your approach in real time slowing down, acknowledging, or escalating internally before a routine query turns into a complaint. 
 - Documentation: Keeping chat, voice, and email interactions logged clearly and consistently, so context is never lost if a case is picked up by someone else. 
 WHAT WERE LOOKING FOR 
 - 14 years in a live chat or blended support role, with proven experience managing high concurrency not single-chat or low-volume queues. 
 - Prior experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, courier, or e-commerce operations, with real understanding of how shipments, RTOs, and delivery exceptions work. 
 - Comfortable handling voice calls and writing emails, not chat-only. 
 - Expert-level typing speed and accuracy able to type fast and correctly under pressure across several open chats. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgment to know when a chat should be escalated versus resolved directly. 
 - Comfortable owning a case end-to-end rather than passing it along at the first sign of difficulty. 
 GOOD TO HAVE 
 - Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or a similar helpdesk/CRM platform. 
 - Exposure to dental, healthcare, or B2B e-commerce categories. 
 - A track record of consistently high CSAT or chat resolution scores in a previous role. 
 WHY THIS ROLE 
 Chat is the highest-volume, highest-visibility channel in our CX operation, and the people who excel here are the ones who move fastest into escalation and team lead tracks. If you can genuinely handle volume without losing quality, this role is built to grow with you. 
 DentalKart |
