title: Shared Services Finance Manager, Trilogy (Remote) - $100,000/year USD
description:
Most finance managers gradually stop doing finance. Their calendars fill with status meetings, task chasing, and people administration while their technical skills go stale. This role takes the opposite path.
   

  

 You will run global finance operations through a team of Senior Accountants while staying close enough to the work to know whether it is actually right. You'll inspect invoices, payments, reconciliations, allocations, and other finance outputs; diagnose the accounting or process failures behind errors; and turn those findings into written coaching that prevents the same mistakes from happening again. When a critical deadline or difficult finance problem demands it, you will still be capable of getting hands\-on yourself.
   

  

 Trilogy's Central Finance team operates differently from a traditional accounting organization. We automate routine coordination and continuously look for ways AI and automation can eliminate manual work, leaving finance professionals focused on judgment, quality, and improvement. You'll get exposure to complex global finance operations while retaining the technical edge that many managers lose as they advance. If you want management responsibility without becoming a professional meeting\-attendee, this is where your accounting expertise becomes leverage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Run day\-to\-day finance operations through Senior Accountants, continuously prioritizing work based on deadlines, business impact, dependencies, and financial risk.
* Inspect finance dashboards and completed work to ensure bills, invoices, payments, bank transactions, reconciliations, control accounts, revenue, and spend allocations are accurate and current.
* Diagnose quality failures using your own accounting expertise, identifying whether the root cause is incorrect data, system configuration, accounting treatment, or process execution.
* Write evidence\-based coaching that explains what went wrong, how to correct it, and how to prevent it from happening again.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, LLMs, and automation to eliminate manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of finance operations.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Filling your week chasing status updates, assigning routine tasks, or sitting in project\-management meetings.
* Personally processing every transaction because delegating is easier than developing a strong accounting team.
* Giving generic performance feedback disconnected from actual invoices, payments, reconciliations, reports, or other finance outputs.
* Accepting recurring errors and inefficient manual processes as "just how finance works."


**Shared Services Finance Manager Key Responsibilities**
 Build a high\-performing finance operations team that consistently produces accurate, timely finance deliverables while continuously improving quality and reducing unnecessary manual work.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* A degree in Accounting or Finance.
* A recognized professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent.
* Experience on at least five audits involving a Big 4 accounting firm, either as the auditor or the client.
* Accounting or finance experience within an organization with at least $100M USD in revenue.
* People\-management experience with direct responsibility for finance or accounting professionals.
* Hands\-on experience across AP, AR/customer invoicing, bank and control\-account reconciliations, and revenue and spend allocation.
* Experience prioritizing and allocating operational finance work across a team while managing deadlines and resolving blockers.
* Experience embedding AI or LLM tools into a recurring, high\-volume finance transaction\-processing workflow, beyond ad hoc prompting or reporting\-only analysis, with a clear impact on efficiency or accuracy.
* Ability to work US business hours.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* Experience designing or building finance workflow automations using tools such as n8n, Lovable, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business lines or international entities.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $50 USD/hour, which equates to $100,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

**Job Summary**
 Build the Surfaces Where Humans Command the Agents
   

  

 Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Agents without great human surfaces are just noise. This role builds the surfaces.
   

  

 You will own the consoles and dashboards through which product managers approve, engineers review, security screens, and executives see value: decision inboxes, review queues, gate approvals, and live value boards. It is full\-stack work where the front end is the product and the stakes are trust.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Build the Consoles
   

  

* Design and build persona consoles: decision inboxes, review surfaces, approval queues, and commitment views, one clear surface per role
* Make agent work legible: what an agent did, why, with what confidence, and what needs a human, rendered so a busy owner decides in seconds
* Sweat the interaction details with UX; approval fatigue is the failure mode, and design is the defense


 Build the Value and Telemetry Layer
   

  

* Build the dashboards that report cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption, agent health, and cost, live from the pipeline
* Turn telemetry into narrative: executive value boards that show committed versus realized without manual curation
* Instrument everything; the platform's credibility rests on numbers nobody has to assemble by hand


 Engineer the Full Stack
   

  

* Build the backend\-for\-frontend layer, APIs, and event consumers that connect consoles to the orchestrator and enterprise systems such as Jira
* Implement enterprise\-grade authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth) and respect data boundaries by design
* Ship on the approved enterprise React stack with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability as defaults


 Raise the Bar
   

  

* Use agents in your own workflow and feed friction back into the platform; you are user zero
* Set frontend and BFF patterns others reuse: components, state, accessibility, performance
* Bring craft: the fundamentals still decide whether this works


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Approvers clear their queues in minutes and trust what they see; nobody asks for a spreadsheet export as a workaround
* Executives quote your value board in their own decks
* Console patterns you built become the default for every new agent the fleet adds
* The stack stays fast, tested, and observable as surfaces multiply


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 6\-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of large\-scale production systems.
* Significant hands\-on experience designing and deploying LLM\-powered applications, AI agents, or intelligent automation platforms.
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks, testing strategies, and governance models for AI\-enabled systems.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Python or Java or TypeScript.
* Strong background in distributed systems, APIs, platform engineering, cloud\-native architectures, and event\-driven systems.
* Experience leading technical initiatives across teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI systems to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to influence architecture, standards, and engineering direction.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep experience with agent frameworks and technologies such as MCP, A2A, LangGraph, OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, or Vertex AI.
* Experience building developer platforms, internal engineering products, or enterprise orchestration systems.
* Experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.
* Experience leading AI governance, privacy reviews, security reviews, and responsible AI initiatives.
* Strong record of technical leadership through open\-source contributions, patents, technical publications, or industry speaking engagements.


**Why This Role**
 Incubation is a durable capability, not a project team: the team persists, and the product rotates. Agentic delivery is product one; the next incubation bets follow. Overview:
**About the company**


Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

**Role Overview** **:**


The Full Stack Software Engineer is responsible for software development, maintenance, monitoring, problem resolution of both front\- and back\-end systems development solutions with or within .NET, Relativity or other tools that relate to eDiscovery applications, databases and workflows. This role participates in projects from all SDLC lifecycles, including inception of the project through the maintenance phase. Executing on the analyzing, writing, building and deployment of software with high quality development solutions.
Responsibilities:
* Responsible for the creation and maintenance of moderate to highly complex solutions (including data infrastructure, reporting, and applications) that address the informational and analytical needs of the various groups.
* Responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle which include requirements definition, solution design, application development, and system testing.
* Analyze end user data needs and develop user\-oriented solutions which interface with existing applications.
* Maintain documentation for all work processes and procedures.
* Make improvement suggestions and adhere to all approved work changes for the team.
* Interact and partner effectively across all appropriate internal business teams.
* Provide backup support for all work and project efforts as needed.
* Assist with team planning and growth strategy.
* Ensure execution of all industry InfoSec specific compliance matters within the team.
* Participate in major upgrades to systems, platforms and/or software.
* Participate in training on business functionality for system end users.
* Test operation of completed programs, debug as needed.
* Develop functional unit testing around developed applications for testing automation.

**Additional Responsibilities/Details:*** Works with minimal supervision and is responsible for making an established range of decisions, escalating to Manager when necessary and updating Manager on a regular basis
* Adaptable and able to learn quickly and demonstrate a big picture approach when working on projects.


Qualifications:
**Minimum Education Requirements:*** Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or related field, or comparable business/technical experience.

**Minimum Experience Requirements:*** At least 5\-8 years of experience in application development including web UI and API programming, business\-layer programming, database programming, and CLI scripting
* Proven ability to design, develop, and deploy full\-stack web applications
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle and testing strategies
* Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new engineering tools, languages, and frameworks


**Required** **Technical Skills (Must\-have):**  

* C\# / .NET for server\-side development
* SQL Server (relational database design, querying, and data access)
* JavaScript/HTML/CSS and one modern frontend framework (React preferred; Angular or Vue acceptable)
* RESTful API design and development
* Git version control and CI/CD pipeline basics

 **Preferred Skills (Nice\-to\-have):**  

* Relativity or other eDiscovery platform experience
* Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Redis or other caching mechanisms
* Event\-driven architecture, messaging protocols, and/or stream processing
* NoSQL databases
* Enterprise Integration Patterns, Service\-Oriented Architecture, and/or Microservices
* Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure and distributed systems
* OAuth 2\.0 / JWT authentication and authorization
* Java or Python in addition to .NET
* Data engineering (data management, collection, modeling, and interpretation across complex data sets)

**Workmode \& Shift timings:*** Work mode : Hybrid ( 3 days in a week at office)
* Shift Timings : 11 AM to 8 PM IST

**Our True North in Action*** **Client Experience** \| Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* **Collaboration** \| Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* **Innovation** \| Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
* **Grit** \| Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Drive closure for ER matters thoroughly and expeditiously, ensuring compliance. Excellent analytical, reporting and quantitative capabilities. 
Experience supporting organizations with globally diverse cultures and geographically dispersed employee bases. Preference for those having experience in handling sexual harassment cases through ICC

description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self\-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee\-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high\-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
 Ares is seeking a curious, hands\-on Full Stack Developer at the Analyst level to join our Legal \& Compliance Technology engineering team in Mumbai. You will work with experienced engineers and global business partners to build, enhance, and support applications that help our Legal \& Compliance teams manage critical workflows, monitoring, controls, and reporting.
   

  

 This is an opportunity for an early\-career engineer to deepen full\-stack development skills, learn how technology supports the investment lifecycle and regulated business processes, and take increasing ownership of production software. You will contribute across user interfaces, services, integrations, and data while learning through design discussions, code reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration.
   

  

 Prior experience in financial services or compliance is helpful, but not required. We are most interested in strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to turn requirements into reliable, well\-tested software.
   

  

**Primary Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Build and enhance full\-stack application features, from intuitive user interfaces to backend services, APIs, and data access.
* Partner with business analysts, product partners, and engineers to understand requirements, break work into clear user stories, and deliver incremental solutions with well\-defined acceptance criteria.
* Develop and support integrations with investment and enterprise systems using REST APIs, services, batch processing, and messaging or event patterns where appropriate.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code; participate actively in code reviews and apply standards for security, performance, resiliency, logging, and operational supportability.
* Use SQL to analyze data, validate results, troubleshoot workflows, and support data quality and reconciliation activities.
* Contribute to solutions for compliance monitoring, controls, exceptions, approvals, attestations, AML/KYC, and regulatory reporting, with guidance from domain and engineering partners.
* Gain exposure to modern data platforms such as Databricks and case\-management or low\-code platforms such as Pega as relevant to team priorities.
* Support releases and production stability by monitoring applications, investigating issues, documenting root causes, and improving automated checks and operational runbooks.
* Explore responsible uses of AI\-enabled automation and agentic workflows under guidance, with appropriate attention to security, traceability, and human oversight.
* Communicate progress, questions, and risks proactively while collaborating with colleagues in Mumbai, New York, and other global locations.


**Qualification**
**Experience Required:**
* 1\-3 years of professional software development experience building, testing, and supporting applications.
* Strong foundations in object\-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, clean\-code practices, debugging, and problem solving.
* Hands\-on development experience in at least one backend language such as Java, C\#, or Python, together with web development using JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and a modern component\-based frontend framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or an equivalent technology.
* Working proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts, including joins, data validation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with modern development practices such as Git\-based version control, code reviews, unit or integration testing, and CI/CD concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to working in a global team.
* Bachelor's degree required; Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones, including reasonable overlap with U.S. colleagues when needed for team meetings, releases, or production support.


**What Will Help You Stand Out**
*The following are advantages, not a checklist. We encourage candidates who meet the core requirements and are excited to learn to apply.*
* A portfolio, academic project, internship, open\-source contribution, or other example that demonstrates end\-to\-end application development.
* Exposure to REST services, microservices, batch processing, integration patterns, or messaging and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience with cloud or modern data platforms, data pipelines, analytics environments, or Databricks.
* Exposure to Pega or another low\-code, workflow, or case\-management platform.
* Interest in investment management, financial services, compliance technology, or other regulated and high\-control environments.
* Experience experimenting with AI or LLM\-enabled automation in a secure, testable, and responsible way.


**What You Can Expect**
* Practical learning through pairing, design discussions, code reviews, and collaboration with experienced engineers.
* Meaningful ownership: you will ship production features and gradually take responsibility for applications or components as your experience grows.
* Broad technical exposure across full\-stack engineering, integrations, data, workflow platforms, production operations, and AI\-enabled automation.
* A global working environment with direct exposure to business and technology partners across the organization.
* A team culture that values thoughtful questions, continuous improvement, disciplined execution, and high\-quality outcomes.


**We recognize that strong candidates do not always match every preferred qualification. If this opportunity excites you and your experience aligns with most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.**
**Reporting Relationships**
*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

description:
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Developer/Lead to join our technology team. This intermediate\-level position is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust, scalable, and high\-performance application systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Core Java and extensive experience with the surrounding Java ecosystem, including the Spring Framework and microservices architectures. You will play a key role in all phases of the development lifecycle, from analysis and design to implementation and support.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Core Java Development: Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable Java code with a focus on multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization.
* Microservices Architecture: Develop and manage scalable microservices using the Spring Boot framework, ensuring seamless integration and communication.
* System Design \& Analysis: Participate in feasibility studies, provide time and cost estimates, and contribute to IT planning for new and revised application systems that meet specific business needs.
* Event\-Driven Systems: Implement and manage messaging solutions using Kafka to build resilient, event\-driven applications.
* Database Management: Design and optimize database solutions using SQL and other data technologies, ensuring data integrity and performance.
* Full Lifecycle Development: Monitor and control all phases of the development process, including analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation.
* Containerization \& Deployment: Utilize container technologies like ECS to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment.
* Agile Practices: Actively participate in an Agile development environment, contributing to sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives.
* Code Quality \& Security: Ensure all code adheres to essential procedures, operating standards, and security best practices. Recommend and implement security measures based on post\-implementation analysis.
* Mentorship \& Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to junior analysts, providing guidance and sharing knowledge.
* Risk Management: Appropriately assess risk in business decisions, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. Drive adherence to policy and apply sound ethical judgment in all business practices.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Experience: 8\-12 years of professional experience in software systems analysis and programming.
* Core Java: Deep, hands\-on expertise in Core Java, including advanced topics like concurrency, collections, and JVM internals.
* Spring Framework: Extensive experience with the Spring Framework and Spring Boot for building enterprise\-grade applications and microservices.
* Messaging Systems: Strong, practical experience with Kafka for building and maintaining event\-driven architectures.
* Database Proficiency: Strong proficiency in SQL for database development and optimization.
* Containerization: Good working knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and ECS.
* Agile Methodologies: Solid experience working within and practicing Agile development methodologies.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* AI \& Prompt Engineering: Exposure to and practical experience with smart AI tools and the ability to craft optimized prompts for development and analysis tasks.

LUXASIA is powered by a diverse and dynamic \#OneTeam of 2700 talents across a growing footprint of 15 markets.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a driven Business Analyst to join our Data \& Analytics function. You will help unlock insights from our transaction, marketing, traffic, and operational data to guide strategic and tactical decisions across the business. As a key team member, you will partner closely with stakeholders in marketing, operations, finance, and tech to turn data into business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 AI Product Development \& Rollout
   

  

* Build, ship, and scale an internal AI assistant from limited beta to full organizational deployment — including usage tracking, feature development, and continuous improvement based on real user behavior
* Develop and produce key AI features: conversational memory and chat history, internet search integration, voice input, image generation, and natural language data querying
* Instrument AI products with telemetry and analytics to track adoption, identify drop\-off points, and prioritize improvements based on evidence
* Maintain high standards of reliability, response quality, and user experience across all AI products in production


 Agentic AI \& Workflow Automation
   

  

* Design and build multi\-step agentic AI workflows that automate commercial operations — task tracking, competitive pricing analysis, campaign performance monitoring, and marketing spend optimization
* Build human\-in\-the\-loop interfaces that allow business users to review, approve, or override AI\-generated recommendations before action is taken
* Develop automated alert and routing systems that surface AI\-driven insights to the right stakeholders at the right time
* Integrate AI agents with internal data platforms, ERP systems, CRM tools, and third\-party APIs to ensure agents have access to the data they need


 AI Evaluation \& Platform Research
   

  

* Evaluate emerging AI platforms and tools against specific business use cases — producing structured assessments and recommendations for leadership
* Define prompt engineering standards, system prompt versioning, and model evaluation frameworks across all AI products
* Implement guardrails, fallback handling, and monitoring for all production AI agents to ensure safe and reliable operation
* Stay current on the AI landscape and actively bring relevant ideas and tools to the team's attention


 Internal AI Enablement
   

  

* Contribute to internal AI training programmes — helping non\-technical teams understand and adopt AI tools effectively
* Run workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions to build AI literacy across the organisation
* Document AI systems clearly so that the broader engineering team can maintain and extend them


**Requirements**

* 2\-5 years in software or ML engineering with at least 1\-2 years of hands\-on production experience building LLM\-based or agentic AI systems.

We embed directly with customers to rapidly pilot AI use cases, solve real\-world business challenges, and help operationalize advanced AI capabilities within enterprise environments.

* Develop full\-stack AI/ML applications on Cloudera to demonstrate how AI and agentic systems solve real enterprise use cases.
* Work directly with customer teams to drive AI and agentic use cases from early prototype toward production readiness.
* Advise customer leaders on AI roadmaps, solution design, deployment, and AI use cases.
* Standardize successful patterns into repeatable reference architectures, productized solutions, starter kits, and internal playbooks.
* Act as a thought leader, mentor Cloudera teams, and contribute to resources that grow our overall AI capability.
* Channel field and customer feedback back to Product teams to continuously improve our AI platform and products.


 We’re excited about you if you have:
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience building and deploying production\-grade systems.
* 2–4 years of experience specifically focused on building ML systems or GenAI and agentic applications.
* Strong hands\-on software engineering, data engineering, and applied AI/ML skills.
* Demonstrated experience building full\-stack ML applications or agentic systems using modern AI frameworks and tooling.


 You may also have:
   

  

* Experience with MLOps frameworks, LLM orchestration, and modern AI stacks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Ray, MLflow).
* Hands\-on experience with Vector Databases and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Background in client\-facing consulting, technical account management, or solution architecture within enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with distributed data engineering platforms (Apache Spark, Iceberg, Kubernetes).

Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our agile, international team. You will design, implement, and evolve robust, scalable backend and frontend components. This position requires strong technical ability, attention to code quality, and a passion for delivering reliable products.
   

  

**In addition, you may have the opportunity to take on the role of Scrum Master for the squad, supporting agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver Full\-Stack Features: Actively design, develop, and maintain scalable backend (Go) and frontend (Angular) features. Uphold code quality, performance, and maintainability standards.
* Participate in Software Architecture Discussions: Collaborate with the team to ensure alignment on technical choices and contribute to the improvement of architectural solutions.
* Contribute to Code Reviews and Technical Problem Solving: Review peers’ code, identify issues, and share solutions to build a robust product.
* Collaborate Across International Teams : Work closely with distributed teams, product owners, architects, and stakeholders. Ensure clear communication, alignment, and efficient coordination in an international environment.
* Agile Leadership \& Scrum: Possibility to take on the role of Scrum Master, leading agile ceremonies and supporting team agility. Drive continuous improvement and facilitate collaboration within the squad


**Required Skills and Experience:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer with the below Skills preferably between 6 to 8 years of relevant experience
   

  

**Foundational Expertise** 
 :
   

  

 Deep expertise in algorithms and data structures, including proper optimization approaches for performance and speed (using Big O notation for time and space complexity).
   

  

 Distributed Systems, Networking basics, Operating Systems, API design, System design, Scalability, Reliability, Security fundamentals
   

  

**Programming Languages:**
 Experience with one or two of the following languages: Go (Golang), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, Bash/Scripting
   

  

**Software Architecture:**
 Experience with modern architectures, building resilient and communicative distributed systems, and working with replicated databases.
   

  

 Microservices architecture, REST APIs, Event\-driven architecture, Clean Architecture, Integration patterns, Resilience patterns
   

  

**Web/Mobile Technologies** 
 :
   

  

 Proficiency in modern web and mobile technologies, such as PWAs (Progressive Web Apps), modern JS frameworks (e.g., Angular, React), WebGPU/WebGL, WebRTC, and Web performance optimization. Responsible design, REST client integration.
   

  

 Strong experience in front\-end development using Angular (12\+), including component\-driven architecture
   

  

**Caching and Optimization:**
 Knowledge of caching tools and strategies (Redis, IndexedDB, Local Storage API, Load balancing, Latency reduction, etc.).
   

  

**Development Practices:**
 Clean code, Code review, Test\-driven development (TDD), Unit testing, Integration testing, Documentation, Version control (Git), Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), Secure coding practices
   

  

**DevOps \& SRE** 
 :
   

  

 CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Monitoring, Logging, Observability, High availability, Fault tolerance, Cloud environments.
   

  

**Team \& Mindset** 
 :
   

  

 Autonomy, technical excellence, communication, teamwork, problem\-solving, adaptability, curiosity, continuous improvement
   

  

**Agile \& Scrum:**
 In\-depth knowledge of the Scrum agile process, strong soft skills, and prior experience as Scrum Master would be a strong asset.
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Lead Engineer (Manager), Microsoft Power Platform
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.


This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.


The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands\-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C\#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well\-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**


Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.


They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.

* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.

**Our Values** 




 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
 


* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.

 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.

 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.



 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high\-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company\-level bets on where crypto\-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid\-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.
 



 You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade\-offs, and cross\-functional execution when it matters most.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
* Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
* Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
* Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140\-2\) into a coherent, forward\-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
* Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post\-quantum cryptography (PQC), short\-lived certificates (47\-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
* Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross\-cutting initiatives.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Design on the end\-to\-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
* Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
* Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C\-suite around a shared strategic direction.



 Required Qualifications:
 


* 10\+ years of product management experience, including at least 4\+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
* Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end\-to\-end, from market analysis and vision\-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi\-quarter strategic bets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross\-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
* Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing complex, API\-first products and platform\-level integrations.
* Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.



 Domain Expertise (Preferred):
 



 Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:
 


* Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
* Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST\-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
* Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.



**What’s more in store?** 





 AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health \& wellness policies, saving \& investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L\&D.
 



 What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.
 



**Why AppViewX?** 




 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

description:
Qdrant is an
 **open\-source vector** 
 search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real\-time recommendations.
   

  

 Trusted by global leaders like
 **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom** 
 , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising
 **$50M in Series B** 
 funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.
   

  

 As a remote\-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.
   

  

 As we expand our presence across Asia\-Pacific, we're looking for a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 to be the technical authority in deals that determine how enterprises build AI infrastructure for the next decade, and the trusted technical owner for our most strategic accounts in the region. Most SE roles are demo cycles. This one is different.
   

  

 You'll work directly with Staff Engineers and CTOs, architect real systems, and own the technical outcome of every engagement you touch, from a first prospect call through to expansion conversations with customers you already support. We care more about time\-zone overlap with our regional accounts than a specific city, so this role is open to candidates based anywhere aligned with major APAC hubs like India, Singapore, Japan, or Australia.
   

  

****What you will own:****
* Own the technical strategy in enterprise deals from first call to production deployment, partnering with Account Executives to qualify, architect, and close for our entire Asian\-Pacific client base
* Act as a Technical Account Manager for a small portfolio of existing enterprise customers in the region alongside active prospects, identifying new use cases, expansion opportunities, and upsell paths, and looping in Account Executives and internal resources to advocate for the customer.
* Design vector search architectures for high\-scale workloads, including multi\-tenant agentic systems, hybrid search pipelines, and low\-latency retrieval at billion\-vector scale.
* Build proof\-of\-concept systems that customers take to production (not throw away), demonstrating Qdrant's performance advantages over JVM\-based or proprietary alternatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on AI infrastructure decisions, helping customers navigate migration from legacy databases, avoid architectural lock\-in, and deploy across cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.
* Contribute to the field engineering knowledge base: reference architectures, technical guides, and reusable POC frameworks that scale the team's impact.


****Who you are****
* 5\+ years of pre\-sales or solutions engineering, ideally with a background in data infrastructure or systems architecture. Hands\-on infrastructure depth alone isn't enough, we need a proven track record running technical qualification and proof\-of\-concept processes within a live sales cycle.
* Experience designing or operating distributed systems, search infrastructure, or data pipelines at production scale.
* Ideally, hands\-on experience with RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) pipelines specifically, plus working knowledge of the broader modern AI stack (LLMs, embedding models, agentic frameworks).
* Ideally, working knowledge of a structured sales qualification framework such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, and the ability to apply it in real deal conversations, connecting technical decisions to business outcomes and deal strategy.
* Strong communicator across audiences: you can go deep on indexing trade\-offs with a Staff Engineer and explain infrastructure ROI to a CIO in the same afternoon.


****Nice to have****
* Experience with vector search, approximate nearest neighbor algorithms, or semantic retrieval systems.
* Background with Rust, C\+\+, or other systems languages.
* Familiarity with deployment patterns: Kubernetes, hybrid cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.


****Why join us****
* A remote\-first, international team working on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure.
* A competitive salary with additional perks.
* Flexible working hours and async\-friendly culture.
* High ownership and real impact.
* Open\-source, engineering\-driven culture.
* Choose your own laptop equipment.


 For US\-based full\-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.
   

  

 Qdrant is an equal\-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.
   

  

**Come build with us!**
 For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.


This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. * Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.

* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.


They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world.  International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the HSBC Asset Management (India) Pvt Ltd – Fund Accounting team.
   

  

**Job Introduction**
 The team member will play a pivotal role in ensuring end\-to\-end compliance for the daily calculation and dissemination of Net Asset Values (NAVs). The role covers oversight of NAV\-related activities, conducting independent/alternate checks, processing and validating vendor payments, and producing clear, comprehensive reporting. The incumbent will co\-ordinate internal, statutory, and SEBI audits, and will take ownership of tax co\-ordination and related tax activities. In addition, the role requires maintaining accurate documentation, tracking concurrent auditors’ work, and ensuring all deliverables are completed accurately and within required timelines.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Ensure daily NAVs for multiple Mutual Fund (MF) schemes are accurately calculated by Fund Accounting (FA) and disseminated to the RTA within regulatory cut\-offs.
* Manage scheme financials, including scheme accounting activities and related controls.
* Ensure invoices for scheme expenses are processed, validated, and recorded within agreed timelines.
* Provide extensive co\-ordination and support for audits, including internal and statutory audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, including ongoing monitoring and required submissions/activities.
* Perform alternate checks to strengthen the accuracy and reliability of processes; proactively identify opportunities to enhance controls and operational efficiency.
* Prepare monthly regulatory and internal reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.
* Maintain up\-to\-date process notes, supporting documentation, and audit\-ready records.
* Monitor concurrent auditors’ activities to ensure SLA adherence and provide timely, accurate responses to audit queries.
* Build and maintain strong knowledge of SEBI regulations and internal policies; stay current on regulatory changes and assess their operational impact.


**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline; Chartered Accountant qualification preferred/required.
* 5–10 years’ experience in fund accounting or a similar role, including NAV calculation, reporting requirements, preparation of annual financial statements, and audit co\-ordination.
* Strong understanding of financial instruments and markets; excellent numerical and analytical skills; clear written and verbal communication; collaborative team player; strong Excel proficiency. Knowledge of Mutual Fund and accounting regulations is an added advantage.


**Note**
 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.
   

  

 Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration \& Customization
   

  

* Configure and customize data quality platforms to ensure optimal user experience for data management
* Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls
* Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
* Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics


 Data Quality Analysis \& Remediation
   

  

* Perform data profiling and analysis to identify data quality issues
* Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions
* Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems
* Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner
* Identify recurring incidents and resolve root cause issues
* Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs


 Dashboard \& Reporting Development
   

  

* Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
* Create business\-friendly visualizations of data quality findings
* Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
* Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls


 Data Integration \& Synchronization
   

  

* Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems
* Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs
* Work hands\-on with MDM and related systems to implement quality controls
* Ensure data consistency and accuracy across the enterprise data landscape


 Stakeholder Collaboration \& Requirements Gathering
   

  

* Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business users
* Elicit and document data quality requirements from stakeholders
* Present data quality findings in a business\-friendly format
* Conduct meetings with large audiences independently
* Work effectively with business users across multiple regions and time zones


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Identify opportunities to enhance data quality processes and controls
* Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
* Support the long\-term data quality roadmap
* Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies


**Required Qualifications Experience**
* Minimum 8 \- 10 years of total experience in data quality, data development, or related fields
* Preferably in an MDM and data governance environment
* Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls
* Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Data Quality Platforms: Hands\-on experience with at least one platform such as Informatica, Talend, Alation, or similar tools
* SQL: Advanced SQL proficiency for data analysis, profiling, and quality checks
* ETL: Strong ETL development skills for data integration and transformation
* Data Visualization: Proficiency in creating Power BI reports and dashboards
* Data Profiling: Experience with data profiling tools and techniques
* System Integration: Understanding of data synchronization and integration patterns


 Communication \& Collaboration
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language
* Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
* Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
* Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
* Comfortable working across global teams and time zones


 Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Skills
   

  

* Strong analytical mindset for identifying root causes of data quality issues
* Ability to troubleshoot complex data quality problems
* Experience with incident management and resolution processes
* Detail\-oriented with focus on accuracy and quality


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multi\-Domain MDM Experience: Experience working with customer, supplier, contact, or item master data domains
* Manufacturing Industry: Background in manufacturing industry, particularly across multiple countries
* ServiceNow: Experience using ServiceNow for incident management and meeting SLAs
* Roadmap Planning: Ability to understand long\-term roadmaps and contribute to data quality maturity evolution

* Additional Tools: Experience with data governance tools, metadata management platforms, or data catalogs
