title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
What is this role all about?
 



 As a
 **Senior Customer Experience Manager** 
 , you will own the
 **technical success, customer experience, and long\-term growth** 
 of a portfolio of enterprise accounts on the Kapture platform. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to drive successful implementations, platform adoption, integrations, and value realization.
 



 You will act as a trusted advisor to customers while leading internal teams across Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to deliver solutions that address customer business needs. The role combines
 **customer relationship management, project and delivery ownership, technical solutioning, and business value realization** 
 .
 



  





 What will you do in this role?
 


* **Own enterprise customer success:** 
 Take end\-to\-end ownership of customer health, adoption, technical success, and long\-term account growth.
* **Lead and develop the team:** 
 Monitor team performance, provide coaching and feedback, build accountability, and ensure consistent delivery standards.
* **Build strategic customer relationships:** 
 Establish trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, manage multiple stakeholders, and drive a structured operating cadence.
* **Drive implementations \& change requests:** 
 Own the delivery of new implementations, enhancements, and change requests in close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
* **Drive adoption \& value realization:** 
 Identify opportunities to improve product adoption, platform utilization, customer experience, and measurable business outcomes.
* **Lead technical solutioning:** 
 Understand customer requirements and translate them into scalable solutions, guiding internal teams on feasibility, approach, integrations, and implementation.
* **Manage complex integrations:** 
 Work with APIs, JSON, webhooks, databases, CRM integrations, and other enterprise systems to ensure seamless platform adoption.
* **Own critical escalations:** 
 Lead complex technical and customer escalations, drive root\-cause identification, coordinate resolution across teams, and ensure timely communication to stakeholders.
* **Drive stakeholder communication:** 
 Provide regular updates on implementation progress, risks, dependencies, escalations, and business outcomes to customer and internal stakeholders.
* **Partner cross\-functionally:** 
 Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to represent the customer's voice and drive timely resolution of customer requirements.
* **Identify growth opportunities:** 
 Understand customer business priorities and identify opportunities for deeper adoption, additional use cases, and account expansion.



  





 What does success look like in this role?
 



 Success in this role means delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving measurable business outcomes. You consistently ensure customers adopt the platform effectively, resolve technical challenges efficiently, build executive relationships, improve customer health, and identify opportunities for expansion. Your ability to combine technical expertise with business consulting helps customers maximize the value of Kapture's platform while contributing to retention and revenue growth.
 



  





 What would make you a good fit for this role?
 



 Basic Requirements
 


* 5–7 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* Experience managing enterprise customers across both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations.
* Ability to manage multiple customer engagements while collaborating effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.



  





 What are the most critical skills for this role?
 


* Strong customer\-first mindset with ownership of customer outcomes and business success.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with experience debugging integrations and resolving technical issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring and debugging tools such as Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, or similar platforms.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify adoption gaps, customer risks, and account growth opportunities.
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

description:
1. About EXL EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and AI company. We help the worlds leading organisations — across insurance, healthcare and life sciences, banking and capital markets, retail, communications and media, and energy and infrastructure — reinvent their business models, improve outcomes and unlock growth at speed. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in New York, EXL today employs approximately 68,000 colleagues across six continents and is a constituent of the S&P MidCap 400. 2. Where This Role Sits Corporate Rewards is the global centre of expertise for compensation, benefits, incentives and reward governance at EXL. The function designs the frameworks that determine how 68,000 people are paid, and works with business leadership, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance and Controllership to apply them consistently across a highly diverse geographic footprint. This role sits within the Reward Reporting & Analytics team and reports to the Senior Assistant Vice President – Reward Analytics & Reporting. It is a global, non-country-specific role: the postholder supports corporate reward initiatives, contributes to regional programmes and responds to employee and stakeholder compensation queries across geographies. Why this role matters now EXL is scaling quickly, changing its skill mix, and operating in an environment of rising pay transparency regulation. Reward decisions are increasingly expected to be evidenced, modelled and defensible before they are made. This role is where that evidence is built — the analytical engine behind pay decisions, budget conversations and governance reporting for the enterprise. 3. Role Overview The Senior Manager – Total Rewards (Reward Reporting & Analytics) delivers analytical, operational and advisory reward support to the Corporate Rewards function and its stakeholders. The role converts compensation, benefits and workforce data into decision-grade insight: dashboards leadership actually uses, benchmarking that stands up to challenge, cost models that Finance recognises, and pay equity analysis that withstands regulatory scrutiny. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. Success depends less on managing people and more on technical depth, judgement, accuracy under pressure, and the ability to explain a complicated number simply to a busy executive. 4. Key Responsibilities The role is organized around eight areas of accountability. Weighting will flex with the reward calendar — benchmarking and budget work peaks in the planning cycle, pay equity and disclosure work peaks around statutory reporting deadlines. 4.1 Reward Analytics, Reporting & Insight Build, maintain and continuously improve the monthly and quarterly reward dashboards used for leadership and governance review — covering pay positioning, compensation cost, incentive funding, attrition-linked pay signals and reward programme utilisation. Design reporting that answers a question rather than simply displaying data: define the metric set, the comparison basis and the narrative before building the visual. Translate complex, multi-country reward and workforce datasets into concise, executive-ready insight and recommendations for HR and business stakeholders. Automate recurring reporting so that analyst time shifts from assembling data to interpreting it; maintain documented, repeatable and auditable production processes. Undertake ad-hoc modelling and scenario analysis — cost of change, sensitivity, what-if — to support live reward decisions. 4.2 Compensation & Incentive Programme Support Support the administration and governance of short-term incentive (STI) programmes, including annual bonus, pay-for-performance and sales commission frameworks: eligibility, funding, accrual tracking, modelling, payout calculation, validation and post-cycle analysis. Support the annual compensation review cycle — budget modelling, distribution guidelines, manager reporting, moderation analytics, exception tracking and post-cycle effectiveness review. Provide compensation analysis and recommendations for promotions, market adjustments, retention cases, geographic mobility and other ad-hoc requests, applying consistent internal equity and market logic. Interpret and apply global reward principles across regions, ensuring consistency, documented rationale and compliance with local requirements. 4.3 Job Pricing & Market Intelligence Work closely with the other leaders on the Market Benchmarking and support with participation in salary and benefits surveys — job matching, data submission, quality assurance and results interpretation — across major survey houses and industry forums (for example Mercer, WTW, Aon, Korn Ferry, Radford). Analyse market data to produce reliable pay positioning views by geography, job family and level, including compa-ratio and range penetration analysis. Support job pricing, job evaluation and levelling activity in partnership with Corporate Rewards and Finance, maintaining the integrity of the job-code to survey-benchmark mapping. 4.4 Pay Equity, Transparency & DEI Analytics Support pay equity, gender pay gap and wider DEI reward analyses — data preparation, cohort construction, statistical testing, remediation modelling and insight development. Prepare data and supporting analysis for statutory and voluntary disclosures, including UK and IR gender pay gap reporting and emerging pay transparency obligations across EU and other markets. Maintain the analytical audit trail so that any published or internally circulated figure can be traced to source and reproduced on request. 4.5 HR Budget, Cost & Workforce Financials Support monthly HR budget tracking, including headcount analysis, compensation cost movement and expense monitoring against plan. Review cost allocations, identify and explain variances, and help stakeholders understand what is actually driving spend patterns. Contribute to the annual HR budget planning process — collating inputs, preparing analyses and partnering with Finance and Controllership on alignment and assumptions. Support ongoing forecasting, tracking expenditure against budget and highlighting variances and emerging risks early enough to act on them. 4.6 Employee Value Proposition, Benefits & Reward Projects Contribute to reward projects spanning benefits, incentives, recognition and wider EVP initiatives — typically owning the analytical and cost-modelling workstream. Review benefit competitiveness, utilisation and cost-effectiveness as part of broader reward reviews, renewals or country-level initiatives. Provide the evidence base for reward design choices: what it costs, what it buys, who it affects and what the alternatives are. 4.7 Reward Data, Systems & Automation Own the accuracy, consistency and governance of compensation and benefits data across internal and external systems; investigate and resolve discrepancies in partnership with HR Shared Services and HRIS. Build and maintain reusable data pipelines, structured data models and reporting layers that make reward data dependable rather than repeatedly reconstructed. Collaborate with HRIS and HR Shared Services on the effective configuration and administration of reward systems, including compensation cycle tooling and downstream reporting. Apply data privacy, confidentiality and access-control discipline appropriate to sensitive personal and pay data across multiple jurisdictions. 4.8 Stakeholder Partnership & Advisory Act as a trusted analytical partner to HR Business Partners, Recruiters, Finance and business stakeholders on compensation-related queries, requests and escalations. Respond to general employee compensation queries with accuracy, discretion and clarity. Support cross-functional collaboration on reward initiatives, and influence outcomes through evidence rather than authority — this role carries no formal reporting line into the stakeholders it advises. 5. AI-Enabled Ways of Working EXL is a data and AI company, and we expect our own functions to work the way our clients aspire to. Practical fluency with enterprise AI tooling is a meaningful differentiator for this role, not an optional extra. Expected Confident, everyday use of Microsoft 365 Copilot across Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams to accelerate analysis, drafting, summarisation and meeting follow-through. Use of large language model assistants — such as Claude and Copilot Chat — to structure analysis, draft policy and communication content, interrogate documents, and produce first-cut code for data preparation and reporting. Sound judgement on what may and may not be shared with an AI tool: employee-level pay data, personal data and confidential business information are handled strictly within approved enterprise tooling and EXL data-handling policy. Verification discipline — AI output is treated as a draft to be checked, never as a source of truth. Every number that leaves this team is traceable to a system of record. Strongly Advantageous Prompt design skill sufficient to get reliable, repeatable output from AI tools on recurring reward tasks — benchmarking summaries, policy comparison, variance commentary, survey job-matching support. A demonstrable record of having made a reward process measurably faster or more accurate using AI — we will ask for a specific example. Interest in helping the wider Rewards team raise its own AI capability, including sharing reusable prompts, templates and working patterns. What we are looking for Not a prompt enthusiast, and not an AI sceptic. Someone who uses these tools daily, knows exactly where they add value and where they do not, and can show the difference it has made to real work. 6. Data Visualization & BI - Power BI (or Tableau/Qlik) dashboards with a defined metric layer, clean data model and design that supports a decision rather than decorating a dataset. HR Systems & Data Structures - Working command of a major HCM platform (Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM or similar), its compensation module and its underlying data model. Budgeting & Cost Analysis - Comfortable in the language of Finance — accrual, variance, phasing, forecast — and able to reconcile HR numbers to the ledger. AI Tooling - Daily, judicious use of Copilot and Claude for analysis, drafting and automation, within enterprise data-handling policy. description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** 




  





 The Enterprise Digital Product Office (EDPO) at Optum is a centralized organization focused on accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product\-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross\-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies—including cloud platforms, data, and AI—the organization supports the development of scalable, user\-centered solutions that help advance Optum’s mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.
 



  





 As a Senior Product Designer, you'll lead the design of complex digital experiences across responsive web and mobile applications while helping shape product direction and customer outcomes. You'll drive discovery, facilitate cross\-functional collaboration, mentor fellow designers, and influence product strategy through thoughtful design, research, and data\-informed decision making. This role balances strategic thinking with hands\-on design execution.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end design of complex product initiatives, from discovery and concept development through delivery and continuous improvement
* Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, and business stakeholders to define problems, identify opportunities, and create user\-centered solutions
* Facilitate discovery activities, including stakeholder workshops, journey mapping, concept exploration, and experience visioning to inform product direction
* Translate user research, analytics, and business insights into design strategies that balance user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility
* Explore multiple design concepts, iterate based on user feedback and testing, and continuously refine experiences throughout the product lifecycle
* Define and communicate design concepts through user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and compelling design presentations
* Champion user\-centered design, accessibility, and inclusive design principles while advocating for the needs of diverse users throughout the product lifecycle
* Drive consistency by contributing to and evolving the design system, reusable patterns, and design best practices across products
* Build alignment across cross\-functional teams by communicating design rationale, facilitating discussions, and influencing product decisions
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools responsibly to improve research, ideation, documentation, and design workflows while helping identify opportunities to increase team effectiveness
* Partner closely with engineering throughout implementation to ensure high\-quality execution through design reviews and quality assurance
* Mentor and provide constructive feedback to other designers, helping elevate design quality and foster a collaborative learning culture
* Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and continuous learning while contributing to the evolution of design practices across the organization
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams, including partners across multiple time zones, while communicating design decisions clearly and confidently
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so



**Qualifications \- External** 




**Required Qualifications:** 



* 7\+ years of experience designing digital products for web and mobile applications
* Experience leading discovery activities and collaborating with cross\-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile product development environments
* Deep understanding of user experience design principles, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and enterprise product design
* Expert proficiency with Figma for interface design, prototyping, design systems, and design documentation
* Solid portfolio demonstrating expertise in leading end\-to\-end product design for complex digital experiences
* Demonstrated solid communication, facilitation, and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels
* Demonstrated ability to mentor designers and contribute to a collaborative design culture



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience designing enterprise software or large\-scale digital products
* Experience working in a Product Company, Global Capability Center, or consulting organization supporting long\-term product development
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams, including U.S. based stakeholders
* Experience using AI\-enabled tools to improve research, design exploration, documentation, or team workflows
* Healthcare experience. Experience designing products in similarly complex or regulated industries including insurance, financial services, retail, telecommunications, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or enterprise software

We believe everyone–of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income–deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life.  athenaOne Foundations is focused on modernizing, stabilizing, and scaling the core services and environments that enable innovation across athenaOne. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, product engineering, R\&D, Security, Finance, and Infrastructure, and is accountable for shaping a coherent portfolio of capabilities that improve resiliency, scalability, developer experience, and productivity in an AI\-first world.
   

  

 This Hybrid role is based in Chennai, India, requires 10\+ years of experience, and reports to the Executive Director, Product.
   

  

 Team Summary
   

  

 athenaOne Foundations modernizes, stabilizes, and scales the core services and environments that enable innovation across athenaOne. The team works across platform engineering, product engineering, R\&D, Security, Finance, and Infrastructure to improve resiliency, scalability, developer experience, and productivity. The team places emphasis on leveraging AI and automation to simplify internal workflows, improve R\&D productivity, and support an AI\-first operating model.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
 Define and manage the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for athenaOne Foundations.
   

  

 Translate modernization, resiliency, scalability, security, and platform investment needs into clear priorities, sequencing, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Own success metrics for Foundations products and services, including reliability, adoption, satisfaction, productivity, scalability, and value realization.
   

  

 Represent internal users, including engineers, product teams, platform consumers, and operational stakeholders.

 Support build\-versus\-buy decisions, service boundary decisions, lifecycle management, and platform investment planning.
   

  

 Lead, coach, and develop product managers and/or product owners supporting Foundations capabilities and internal platform experiences.
   

  

 Build team operating mechanisms that reinforce accountability, fast learning, execution discipline, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Use AI and automation intentionally to improve product outcomes, reduce friction, simplify workflows, and increase productivity
   

  

 Expected Education \& Experience
   

  

 10\+ years of experience in product management, platform product management, or technical product leadership in complex software environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated success owning product roadmaps and measurable outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders.
   

  

 Strong product judgment in technical environments, including the ability to assess tradeoffs and influence priorities.
   

  

 Experience defining outcomes such as resiliency, scalability, quality, productivity, service performance, adoption, or customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Strong business acumen, including investment planning, cost management, and value\-based prioritization.
   

  

 Excellent communication and storytelling skills across executive, technical, and operational audiences.
   

  

 Experience leading and developing high\-performing product teams.
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in software, engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field preferred; experience in healthcare, regulated enterprise platforms, or SaaS/PaaS environments is a plus.

description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 5 days WFO
 



  





**Notice Period: 15\-30 days maximum**




  





 We are hiring a Growth Manager to own performance marketing end to end for one or more of our consumer brands. This is not a media buying seat that only manages budgets someone else has already figured out. You will run the full loop yourself: finding what customers are actually searching for and struggling with, finding the ad angles and formats that are already winning in the market, briefing our in\-house creative team to build against those angles, and then living inside the performance data every day to decide what scales, what gets killed, and what gets tested next.
 



  





 You will work closely with our video editors and graphic designers, and with the operations
 



 and finance side of the business, to make sure that whatever you scale is something we can actually fulfill and that genuinely makes money.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 • Research keywords and customer problems using tools such as Helium10, and use search intent and demand signals to decide which product angles are worth building campaigns around.
 



 • Source winning creative concepts from competitors and organic content using tools such as Foreplay, along with manual scouting on platforms like TikTok and Instagram, and identify why a given hook or format is working.
 



 • Generate ad scripts using our in\-house AI tools, refining them so that the final script is genuinely high quality rather than a rough first pass.
 



 • Brief our video editors and graphic designers clearly, including the reference creative, the hook, and the intended angle, and review and approve their work before it goes live.
 



 • Launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
 



 • Monitor performance daily against clear benchmarks, including CPM under thirty dollars, CPC under one dollar fifty, CTR above three percent, CAC in the range of forty to fifty dollars, and cost per add to cart under fifteen dollars, along with hook rate, hold rate, and click rate.
 



 • Make clear scale or kill decisions based on return on ad spend. Scale an ad when Meta ROAS is above one. Hold with no action when it is between zero point seven and one. Kill an ad when Meta ROAS stays below zero point seven for two to three consecutive days.
 



 • Understand and work within a subscription\-driven revenue model, where a Meta ROAS below one can still be a healthy result once repeat and subscription revenue is accounted for, and track blended Shopify ROAS against a breakeven target of one point four.
 



 • Own the revenue target and budget allocation for your assigned brand or product line.
 



 • Work closely with channel managers and growth executives to keep paid social, marketplaces, and organic efforts aligned rather than working against each other.
 



 • Provide regular, structured reporting on campaign performance, budget pacing, and revenue against target.
 



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 




  





 • At least three years of experience in performance or growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling paid campaigns and delivering measurable return on investment.
 



 • Hands\-on experience running and optimizing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager, along with familiarity with TikTok Ads or similar platforms.
 



 • A strong grasp of direct response marketing metrics and unit economics, including CAC, ROAS, and lifetime value, and how they connect to actual profitability.
 



 • Experience briefing and iterating with a creative team, since this role is as much about creative direction as it is about media buying.
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-testing, high\-volume creative environment where campaigns and creative are refreshed constantly rather than left to run untouched.
 



 • Working knowledge of analytics and attribution tools such as Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager reporting.
 



 • A master’s degree is preferred but not required.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or adjacent consumer categories.
 



 • Experience at a growth\-stage direct\-to\-consumer company, for example at businesses such as Bellavita, BetterAlt India, or Mosaic Wellness.
 



 • Experience with subscription or retention\-driven revenue models, rather than only one\-time purchase businesses.
 



 • Experience owning a channel or product line, P\&L, not just its ad spend.
 



  





**Where We Expect to Find This Person** 




  





**Strong candidates are likely to come from one of the following backgrounds.** 




  





 • A performance or growth marketer at a direct\-to\-consumer or e\-commerce brand, ideally one with a subscription or repeat\-purchase revenue model.
 



 • A media buyer at a performance marketing agency who has grown into owning strategy and creative direction, not just ad account management.
 



 • A growth marketer at a company in health, wellness, or a related consumer category who is ready to own a full brand or product line rather than a single channel.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




  





 • You are genuinely data\-driven, and can look at CPM, CTR, ROAS, and CAC together and know what story they are telling you, rather than optimizing for one metric in isolation.
 



 • You are creative\-literate, and can brief an editor or designer clearly enough that what comes back actually matches what you had in mind.
 



 • You are comfortable owning a number, and treat your product line's revenue and profitability as your own responsibility rather than something to report on.
 



 • You are decisive under ambiguity, and can make a scale or kill call on a campaign without waiting for someone else to tell you it is safe to do so.
 



 • You work well cross\-functionally, particularly with creative, operations, and finance, since a good campaign idea is worthless if we cannot fulfill it profitably.
 



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  





 • Pay is based on experience, in line with market standards.
 



  





**Success Metrics for the First Three to Six Months** 




  





 • Revenue and ROAS targets for your assigned brand or product line are consistently met or exceeded.
 



 • CAC is held within target range as spend scales, rather than rising uncontrolled with volume.
 



 • A clear testing cadence is in place, with new creative angles and hooks tested on a regular schedule rather than ad hoc.
 



 • Scale and kill decisions are made promptly and correctly, without campaigns being left to run well past the point they should have been cut.
 



 • Strong working relationship established with the creative team, reflected in fewer revision rounds and faster turnaround from brief to finished ad.

 Egmore, Chennai

 **full\-time, on\-site role**

 **creative writing, social media management, campaign ideation and client engagement** 
 .

 .

 .

 .

* Staffing Solutions
* Translation Services
* Data Analytics

 We are looking for a
 **Creative Writer \& Social Media Executive** 
 who can combine
 **strong writing, creative thinking, social media knowledge and communication skills** 
 .
 



 You will help manage social media accounts, develop content and campaign ideas, write scripts and copy, coordinate with the creative team and participate in client discussions.
 



 The role also involves
 **supporting business development from a creative perspective** 
 by researching prospective clients, identifying content opportunities and contributing ideas to pitches.

**Insight → Idea → Content → Campaign → Execution**

 .

 **CTAs and opening hooks** 
 .

* Research topics before developing content.

* Maintain consistency in brand voice and communication.
* Develop ideas around relevant
 **trends, cultural moments, memes and current conversations** 
 .

 .

* Schedule and publish content where required.
* Monitor audience responses, comments and messages where applicable.
* Track basic content performance and suggest improvements.
* Stay updated on platform trends and emerging content formats.



  





**3\. Creative Ideation** 



* Generate ideas for
 **posters, carousels, Reels, videos and social campaigns** 
 .
* Develop creative hooks and concepts for short\-form content.
* Suggest visual directions and references to designers.
* Suggest editing styles, transitions and visual treatments to video teams.
* Participate in creative brainstorming sessions.
* Turn simple or ordinary briefs into more engaging content concepts.
* Draw inspiration from
 **advertising, films, pop culture, memes, internet culture and current trends** 
 where appropriate.



  





**4\. Campaign Development** 



* Develop
 **campaign concepts, themes and communication directions** 
 .
* Create ideas for seasonal, promotional and topical campaigns.
* Develop content series and campaign narratives.
* Identify opportunities around festivals, cultural events and relevant trends.
* Help convert campaign concepts into actual social media content.
* Participate in campaign presentations and creative discussions.



  





**5\. Client Communication** 



* Participate in client calls and meetings when required.
* Understand client requirements, objectives and expectations.
* Convert client briefs into clear creative requirements.
* Present creative ideas and explain the thinking behind them.
* Communicate professionally with clients.
* Collect and understand feedback.
* Coordinate with internal teams to implement revisions.
* Develop an understanding of each client's
 **brand, audience, competitors and communication style** 
 .



  





**6\. Business Development Support** 




 You will also contribute to
 **client acquisition from a creative and research perspective** 
 .
 



 This may include:
 


* Researching potential clients and their brands.
* Reviewing their websites and social media presence.
* Identifying gaps in their current content and communication.
* Developing
 **sample creative ideas or content opportunities** 
 for prospective clients.
* Providing creative insights to the Business Development team.
* Supporting presentations and pitches with content and campaign ideas.
* Participating in pitches when creative input is required.



  





**This is not a conventional sales role.** 
 However, you should be comfortable contributing to client acquisition through
 **research, creative thinking, communication and understanding of digital marketing** 
 .
 



  





**SHOOTS \& TRAVEL** 




 This is an
 **on\-site role based in Egmore, Chennai** 
 .
 



  





 Occasional travel may be required for:
 


* Client meetings
* Photoshoots and video shoots
* Events and activations
* On\-location content creation
* Campaign execution
* Other content\-related activities



  





 You should therefore be comfortable with
 **local travel within Chennai and occasional travel outside Chennai** 
 when required.
 



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS** 



* Strong
 **English writing and communication skills** 
 .
* Excellent grammar and attention to detail.
* Strong creative thinking and ideation ability.
* Good understanding of social media platforms.
* Strong understanding of
 **Instagram and short\-form content** 
 .
* Ability to write engaging hooks, captions and scripts.
* Good storytelling ability.
* Ability to understand and adapt to different brand voices.
* Strong research skills.
* Good understanding of current trends and internet culture.
* Ability to work effectively with designers and video editors.
* Good client communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines.
* Ability to receive and implement feedback.



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* Experience in
 **content writing, copywriting, social media or digital marketing** 
 .
* Agency experience.
* Experience managing multiple brand accounts.
* Experience writing
 **Reel/video scripts** 
 .
* Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of graphic design and video editing.
* Experience with influencer/creator campaigns.
* Experience participating in shoots or content production.
* Experience presenting creative ideas to clients.
* A portfolio of
 **writing, campaigns, social media work or creative projects** 
 .



  





**IDEAL CANDIDATE** 




 The ideal candidate:
 


* **Naturally comes up with ideas.**
* Is curious about brands, advertising, social media and culture.
* Understands what makes content interesting and shareable.
* Can turn a basic brief into a strong creative concept.
* Understands
 **memes, trends, pop culture and internet culture** 
 .
* Knows when a trend is appropriate for a brand—and when it isn't.
* Can write both
 **professionally and creatively** 
 .
* Is comfortable presenting and explaining ideas.
* Has an eye for design and visual storytelling.
* Understands basic video and visual concepts.
* Is proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
* Can balance
 **creativity, brand requirements, client expectations and deadlines** 
 .
* Is comfortable working across different industries and communication styles.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in
 **English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Advertising, Marketing, Media or a related field** 
 is preferred.
* Prior experience in content writing, copywriting, social media, advertising or digital marketing is an advantage.
* Experience managing social media accounts is an advantage.
* Experience writing scripts for Reels or short\-form videos is an advantage.
* Freshers with
 **exceptionally strong writing, communication and creative skills** 
 may also be considered.
* A strong portfolio or examples of creative work will be highly valued.



  





**CORE SKILLS** 




**Creative Writing • Copywriting • Storytelling • Social Media Management • Content Strategy • Campaign Ideation • Script Writing • Trend Research • Brand Communication • Creative Direction • Client Communication • Presentation • Basic Design • Basic Video Understanding** 




  





**ROLE EXPECTATIONS** 




 Before applying, please ensure you are comfortable with:

* Managing social media accounts

* Campaign ideation

* Working with designers and video editors

* Supporting business development through creative ideas

**Please read the entire Job Description carefully before applying.** 




  





 If you are looking only for a

 **Senior Data Scientist**

 **customer value, customer behavior, and movement across value segments** 
 .

 **why the model or analysis matters** 
 .

 .
* Strong programming skills in
 **Python** 
 .
* Strong
 **SQL** 
 skills and experience working with large datasets.

	+ Propensity modeling

 .

 **Retail, CPG, Consumer, E\-commerce, Loyalty, or Marketing Analytics** 
 .

 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Cao Jewellery is a handcrafted statement jewellery brand on a mission to change the way the world experiences jewellery. We believe that beautifully crafted, meaningful pieces shouldn't be reserved for the few, they should be within reach of every person who desires them. We're looking for a highly driven, data\-oriented Performance Marketing Executive to scale our digital growth across paid channels. You'll own customer acquisition, funnel optimization, and ROAS scaling across Meta, Google, and other platforms — turning ad spend into a predictable revenue engine. 
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), other platforms.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance marketing funnel — Awareness → Consideration → Conversion— and the metrics at every stage.
 



 Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth while holding the line on target ROAS and CPA.
 



 Analyze campaign performance daily, spot trends early, and scale winning audiences, creatives, and placements.
 



 Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and ad copy — and turn learnings into the next round.
 



 Partner closely with creative, content, and brand teams to brief and ship high\-converting ad assets, including UGC and influencer\-led creatives.
 



 Track and report key metrics — CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, LTV — in clean, decision\-ready dashboards.
 



 Optimize landing pages and conversion funnels in collaboration with the website/Shopify team for better CVR.
 



 Plan and allocate monthly budgets across platforms, channels, and campaigns to maximize blended ROAS.
 



 Stay ahead of platform updates, algorithm shifts, and competitor strategies — and translate them into our roadmap.
 



  





 REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS
 



  




1. 3\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably in jewellery, fashion, or D2C e\-commerce.

1. Experience running performance marketing for a Shopify or similar D2C e\-commerce stack.

 WHY JOIN US
 



  




1. Chance to work with a growing premium fashion brand.

This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
   

  

  

* Role type: Full time

* Working with: CEO and Cofounder


 Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't.
   

  

 You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed\-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back\-to\-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you.
   

  

 What you'll actually do
   

  

 On any given day you might be:
   

  

  

* Running the full inside\-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing
* Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO)
* Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers
* Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working
* Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does
* Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones


 You'll be measured on revenue — pipeline created and deals closed. Not on activity, not on slides.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

  

* You can sell. You're sharp on calls, you can run a demo that lands, and you follow up like the deal depends on it — because it does
* You know your way around code and tech. You can write a script, wire up an API, or build your own tooling instead of waiting for an engineer
* You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced
* You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow\-ups needed
* You work hard and sweat the details. Conscientiousness isn't optional here; the follow\-up you skip is the deal you lose
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand\-holding, no fully\-defined role. The role is what you make it


 What you get
   

  

  

* Full ownership of a revenue line — you're not a cog in a GTM machine, you are the GTM machine
* A daily working relationship with the CEO and Cofounder, and a front\-row seat to how a profitable, venture\-backed startup grows
* The freedom to pick your channels and build your own systems — and the accountability that comes with it
* The kind of zero\-to\-one growth experience that's worth far more than the title

title: Senior Data / ML Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data / ML Engineer to join our Data Science \& Engineering team. In this role you will design, build, and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines and infrastructure on AWS, powering analytics, machine learning, and business\-critical reporting. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to ensure reliable, performant data delivery across the organization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep AWS expertise with modern development practices \- including AI\-assisted coding, containerization, and infrastructure as code \- to accelerate delivery without sacrificing quality.

 **Experience Level:** 
 5\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Rajarhat–Newtown)
   

  

**Mode of Working:** 
 Work from Office
   

  

**Timing:** 
 Ability to work in the US Eastern time zone. This may be relaxed to half day IST and half day US EST \- based on project needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and optimize large\-scale ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS services such as EMR (Spark), Glue, Lambda, and Step Functions.
* Orchestrate complex data workflows with Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA or self\-managed), ensuring reliability, observability, and SLA adherence.
* Architect and manage data storage solutions across Amazon S3 (data lake), Redshift (data warehouse), and RDS (relational databases), applying best practices for partitioning, compression, and cost optimization.
* Build and maintain containerized data applications and microservices using Docker and Amazon ECS/Fargate, including CI/CD automation.
* Develop event\-driven and serverless data processing solutions with AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, and EventBridge.
* Leverage AI\-powered coding assistants and IDE integrations (e.g., Kiro, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate development, code review, and documentation.
* Implement data quality frameworks, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data integrity across all pipelines.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists to productionize ML models and feature pipelines.
* Define and enforce data governance, security, and access\-control policies in line with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code initiatives using Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.


 ‍
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with at least 3 years of hands\-on AWS production workloads.
* 3\+ years of experience with AWS Services: EMR (Spark/Hadoop), Apache Airflow, S3, Redshift, RDS, Lambda, Sagemaker and ECS.
* Solid experience with Docker (building, optimizing, and deploying containers) and container orchestration.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with Typescript is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools within modern IDEs for rapid prototyping, code generation, testing and debugging.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data security best practices.
* AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Analytics \- Specialty or AWS Certified Solutions Architect are a plus.
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
* Exposure to ML Ops workflows, feature stores, or model serving pipelines (e.g., SageMaker).
* Knowledge of cost\-optimization strategies for large\-scale AWS data workloads.


 ‍

* Compute \& Processing: EMR (Spark), Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Glue, Sagemaker
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow (MWAA), Step Functions
* Storage \& Warehousing: S3, Redshift, RDS (PostgreSQL / MySQL)

* Languages: Python, SQL, Bash

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Advisor, Product Delivery**What does a successful Product Owner do at Fiserv?**


The Product Owner (PO) s responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the team and ensuring that the Team Backlog is aligned with customer and stakeholder needs. The PO is the team’s primary customer advocate and primary link to business and technology strategy. This enables the team to balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while continuously evolving the Solution.


The PO represents the needs of customers and the business within a particular Solution domain, which is typically co\-represented by a Product Manager. Together, they ensure that product strategy and implementation remain connected throughout the value stream. Serving as the ‘voice of the customer’ for the team entails a broad range of responsibilities. The PO must build and manage key relationships, synthesize information from multiple sources, maintain business alignment in the Team Backlog, and communicate effectively with a variety of audiences—all with a bias toward delivering, and learning, quickly.


The PO is ultimately responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Agile team, which requires the PO to ensure that the right solutions are built and that they are built the right way. However, the PO cannot accomplish this alone. Building the right solutions requires deep knowledge of business strategy, customer segments, market dynamics, and value stream economics. The PO establishes a close relationship with Product Management to derive these macro\-level insights and apply them to specific product domains. Building solutions the right way requires Team and Technical Agility, DevOps practices, and a Continuous Delivery Pipeline. These technical capabilities determine the speed and quality with which value can be delivered, and the PO relies on the Agile team to provide them. The PO provides a crucial link in the bi\-directional information flow between Product Management and the Agile team. As shown in Figure 2, the PO keeps the Agile team informed of the strategy that drives product design and keeps Product Management informed of the innovations that influence the evolution of product strategy. Customer feedback aligns thinking from strategy through execution and is accessible to all roles.

**What you will do:**

* The PO, in close partnership with Product Management, applies a customer\-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to guide the team toward delivering solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible, and sustainable.
* The PO must understand what solutions and experiences the teams can deliver. This practical insight is a valuable contribution to the vision and roadmaps that guide solution implementation.
* In collaboration with Product Management, System Architects, Delivery Management and other stakeholders, POs help guide the sequencing of features over time toward the best economic outcomes. Through their understanding of which problems need to be solved, which solutions would best solve them, and the feasibility of delivering those solutions, POs help ensure that the vision and roadmap are reflected in the Jira Project Backlog.
* The PO should communicate the vision and roadmap during PI Planning to ensure teams are aligned and ready to execute against them.
* It is the PO’s responsibility to ensure that they are well\-formed and aligned with product strategy. The PO clarifies story details, applies user\-story voice, ensures ‘INVEST’ characteristics are present, assists with story splitting, defines enablers, and incorporates behavior\-driven design (BDD) to ensure stories support continuous value flow. The PO also allows space for ‘local’ stories and spikes that advance product design but are not derived explicitly from the strategic roadmap.
* Achieving continuous value flow requires that the highest\-value backlog items are delivered in the shortest sustainable lead time and in the right sequence. The PO enables this by regularly ordering backlog items according to their cost of delay and communicating that sequence to the team during backlog refinement
* The PO works with the team to agree on accepted story completion. This includes validating that the story meets acceptance criteria, that it has the appropriate, persistent acceptance tests, and that it otherwise complies with its Definition of Done (DoD). In so doing, the PO assures that quality is built in.
* POs facilitate frequent conversations with their teams to resolve questions, manage dependencies, and communicate priorities that emerge as stories are implemented. This information also helps the team slice stories effectively to achieve increased velocity and shortened learning cycles.
* The PO regularly evaluates progress toward story acceptance criteria, including compliance with Built\-In\-Quality criteria, such as the scalable definition of done, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs). The PO works closely with the team to detect quality issues as they are introduced and correct them in or near real time.
* As a member of the Agile team, the PO attends and actively participates in team events during PI execution. During iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, team retrospectives, and team syncs, the PO provides crucial feedback on the team’s work from an outside\-in, customer\-centric point of view. By participating in PO Sync and System Demos, the PO helps the team satisfy dependencies, demonstrate incremental value, and maintain cadence with the roadmap.
* The PO collects and shares feedback with Product Management and System Architects as part of Continuous Exploration, with their teams during backlog refinement, iteration planning, and iteration reviews, system demos, and, if applicable, Inspect and Adapt events.

**What you will need to have:**

* Degree or equivalent experience
* 5 \+ years relevant experience in the Fintech sector
* Extensive Agile experience preferably with a recognised Product Owner certification
* Proven track record of managing a complex product backlog for delivery through regular refinement and prioritisation
* Experience in delivering a new product from inception to market/live
* Expert in User Story and Acceptance criteria creation, coaching and review
* Great communication and meeting facilitation skills
* Experience in managing and developing team members
* Expert in defining success criteria and creating meaningful reporting through the use of metrics and empirical measurements
* International travel may be required
* Strong verbal, written and organizational skills; strong customer orientation
* Ability to prioritise
* Pro\-active approach in meeting agreed deadlines
* Committed to clients and to delivery
* Strong analysis skills; tenacious, determined, interested in detail
* Strong document\-writing ability
* Quality\-focused, with attention to detail, good use of language (proficient with Word, Excel PowerPoint, Visio), familiarity with Jira and Confluence tools.
* Ability to adapt to different situations; Clients, technical requirements, business outputs
* Organised; analysis and documentation must follow pre\-determined project methodologies
* Present information to / illicit relevant information from stakeholders with ease
* Flexible
* Project and Process Management

**What would be great to have:**

* 2\+ years of experience in defining and implementing the security architecture of enterprise applications within the .NET family.
* 2\+ years of experience with SQL Server and other relational databases.
* Knowledge of tools and testing approaches such as AppScan, Burp Proxy, Sonar, and Coverity.
* Experience in the printing domain.
* Extensive experience in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies such as Agile/Scrum and waterfall.
* Ability to gather requirements, translate them into technical design, and guide teams through implementation.

**Job Description:**

**Principal Research Engineer, Applied AI** 




 www.enchargeai.com
 



**About EnCharge AI:** 




 EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in\-memory\-computing architecture delivers a 10x step\-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We are an experienced team of AI researchers, silicon \& systems engineers, and architects backed by leading investors, poised to become the essential platform for the next wave of AI innovation.
 



**The Opportunity:** 




 Modern AI workloads—from large language models to diffusion\-based generators to multimodal systems—represent some of the most compute\-intensive frontiers in AI, and some of the most promising applications for our hardware’s energy efficiency advantages. We’re building a vertically integrated AI stack that will showcase the transformative potential of our silicon while delivering real value to customers today.
 



 We are seeking a Research Engineer to push the boundaries of AI model capability, quality, and efficiency. You’ll build fine\-tuning and post training pipelines, develop rigorous benchmarking frameworks, and work at the intersection of ML research and hardware\-aware optimization—ensuring our models run beautifully on our silicon.
 



 This is a role for someone who thrives at the boundary between research and engineering. You’ll read papers, implement techniques, and ship production\-quality code—all in service of making AI inference faster, cheaper, and better.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Algorithmic Acceleration:** 
 Research and implement state\-of\-the\-art techniques to accelerate AI inference—quantization, sparsity, distillation, speculative decoding, caching strategies, and architectural modifications. Systematically characterize tradeoffs between model quality, latency, throughput, and power consumption to find optimal operating points across different use cases.
* **Hardware Co\-Design:** 
 Partner closely with hardware, compiler, and quantization teams to ensure algorithmic improvements translate to real gains on our silicon. Identify optimizations aligned with our architecture's strengths—maximizing throughput while minimizing power. Shape the feedback loop between model development and hardware.
* **Evaluation:** 
 Build profiling tools and comprehensive benchmarking frameworks to understand compute bottlenecks, measure model quality across standard and domain\-specific evals, and track efficiency metrics.
* **Applied Research:** 
 Build robust fine\-tuning workflows for modern AI models, enabling rapid experimentation with LoRA, adapters, and full fine\-tuning. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Overview Of 73 Strings**
 73 Strings is an innovative platform providing comprehensive data extraction, monitoring, and valuation solutions for the private capital industry. The company's AI\-powered platform streamlines middle\-office processes for alternative investments, enabling seamless data structuring and standardization, monitoring, and fair value estimation at the click of a button. 73 Strings serves clients globally across various strategies, including Private Equity, Growth Equity, Venture Capital, Infrastructure and Private Credit.
   

  

 Our 2025 $55M Series B, the largest in the industry, was led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from Golub Capital and Hamilton Lane, with continued support from Blackstone, Fidelity International Strategic Ventures and Broadhaven Ventures.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and own the data pipelines, integrations, and warehousing infrastructure that power 73 Strings' valuation and monitoring platform. This is a hands\-on engineering role — you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data solutions that ingest financial data from multiple sources, transform it for downstream analytics, and keep it reliable in production.
   

  

 You will work directly with product, engineering, and client\-facing teams to translate complex financial data requirements into well\-engineered, observable pipelines. The role demands deep technical execution, not just architectural direction.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Data Engineering \& Pipeline Development**
* Design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest financial and valuation data from relational databases, APIs, and Elasticsearch.
* Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) and incremental loading strategies to keep data fresh without full reloads.
* Build scalable ingestion frameworks for dynamic and evolving schemas, including semi\-structured JSON payloads.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex data integration issues in production through structured root cause analysis.
* Develop and maintain data transformation logic using dbt and Apache Airflow for orchestration.


**Cloud Data Warehousing**
* Build and maintain dimensional models, fact tables, and reporting data marts on cloud data warehouse platforms.
* Optimize warehouse performance through query tuning, partitioning strategies, and storage cost management.
* Develop and manage data pipelines using cloud\-native warehousing features for ingestion, transformation, and change tracking.
* Maintain transformation logic supporting analytical reporting and downstream BI consumption.


**API \& Integration Development**
* Build and maintain integrations from REST APIs, SaaS platforms, and internal applications into the data platform.
* Design reusable ingestion patterns that handle authentication, pagination, rate limiting, and schema drift.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define integration contracts and data schemas.
* Work with JSON and other semi\-structured formats; ensure clean parsing and lineage back to source.


**Data Quality \& Governance**
* Implement validation frameworks, reconciliation checks, and data quality rules across pipelines.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and auditing so data issues surface before they reach end users.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across systems and reporting layers.
* Participate in data governance practices: lineage tracking, documentation, and access controls.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work directly with business users, valuation teams, product managers, and client stakeholders to gather requirements.
* Translate business and regulatory data requirements into clear, implementable technical designs.
* Support production deployments, incident resolution, and ongoing pipeline enhancements.
* Communicate clearly with both technical teammates and non\-technical stakeholders on data issues and delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
 Experience
   

  

* 5\+ years in data engineering, ETL development, or data integration — with production systems, not just prototypes.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise data pipelines in cloud environments.
* Experience with Snowflake or Databricks as a primary data platform: dimensional modeling, performance tuning, and cost management.
* Hands\-on Informatica IICS development: mappings, tasks, REST API connectors, and error handling.
* Experience integrating data from REST APIs, relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL), and semi\-structured sources.
* Practical knowledge of dbt for transformation logic and Apache Airflow for orchestration.


**Technical Skills**
* ETL/ELT design: CDC patterns, incremental loads, full reloads, and SCD handling.
* Python or Scala for data processing, scripting, and pipeline automation.
* REST API consumption: authentication (OAuth, API keys), pagination, rate limiting, and schema mapping.
* JSON and semi\-structured data parsing; experience handling evolving or inconsistent schemas.
* Streaming and real\-time data: working knowledge of Kafka or Spark Streaming (production experience a plus).
* Cloud data platform experience: AWS (Glue, S3, Lambda), Azure (Data Factory, ADLS), or GCP (Dataflow, BigQuery).
* Data quality tooling: validation frameworks, reconciliation checks, pipeline observability, and alerting.
* SQL proficiency: complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.


 We cultivate a culture of innovation and collaboration, where your ideas matter. We empower our team members to take initiative, learn continuously, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets.  The Citi Services 10\-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry\-level employees hands\-on experience through training sessions and real, on\-the\-job learning. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research.

* Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
* Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth.
* Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk.
* Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings.
* Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.

* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail.
* Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self\-starter.
* A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
* Resilience to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.

 Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full\-time Analysts upon graduation. title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Overview
  
  

**About the Role:**  

**The team:** Our Engineering team develops and maintains modern, cloud\-based applications and AI\-powered solutions that support global business operations. Team members collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, and DevOps functions to build reliable, secure, and scalable solutions. The team embraces agile delivery practices and encourages continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
  
  

**Responsibilities and impact:**  

We build a platform that replaces manual month\-end NAV reconciliation and investor income allocation processes for hedge fund operations teams. You will be the bridge between our fund clients and our engineering team — understanding how each client's fund accounting operations work, translating that into precise specifications, and ensuring the platform delivers correct financial outcomes. This is a client\-facing role.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Lead UAT and Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate directly with fund operations teams during month\-end to observe reconciliation and allocation workflows, conduct feature demonstrations, and drive user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Own End\-to\-End Validation: Manage the full feature delivery lifecycle, ensuring that calculation results are fully verified and confirmed as accurate by the client before deeming a feature complete.
* Drive Hands\-on Analysis: Act as a forward\-deployed business analyst by drafting comprehensive specifications, exploring complex calculation edge cases, and proactively contributing to technical solutions.
* Collaborate with Engineering: Partner closely with engineering teams to define and refine data models and calculation logic, ensuring business requirements translate into robust technical implementations.
* Execute Technical Validation: Perform hands\-on data validation and analysis by utilizing SQL and other technical tools to verify system outputs and ensure data integrity.
* Integrate AI\-Augmented Workflows: Leverage AI assistants to accelerate analysis and process efficiency, maintaining a curiosity\-driven approach to pushing the boundaries of what is possible with new technology.


**What we’re looking for:**  

You will have 5\-8 years of experience with fluency in fund accounting: NAV calculation, trial balances, portfolio valuations, realized vs. unrealized P\&L, management and performance fee waterfalls, hurdle rates, high water marks, investor allocations, capital activity processing (subscriptions, redemptions, transfers), equalisation mechanics, and accounting period controls.
  
Required Skills
  
* Domain Expertise and Accounting Rigor: Deep knowledge of fund accounting and administration systems, utilizing strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to break down complex scenarios, identify edge cases, and maintain absolute precision in calculations to prevent compounding errors across periods.
* Business Analysis and Delivery: Proven proficiency in requirements elicitation—including structured interviews, process flows, and defining acceptance criteria—combined with a proactive, ownership\-driven mindset to drive deliverables to completion without needing prompting.
* Client Relations and Results Focus: Exceptional client\-facing confidence in presenting methodologies and fielding difficult questions when results deviate, with an outcome\-driven mindset that measures success strictly by the accuracy of financial results rather than completed process steps.
* Technical Acumen and AI Integration: Strong technical literacy, including SQL for data analysis and validation, paired with a genuine appetite for integrating and utilizing AI\-augmented workflows daily to accelerate work and contribute directly to technical solutions.


Preferred Skills
  
* Fund Accounting \& Operations Expertise: Deep functional expertise in fund accounting operations, encompassing complex fee calculation methodologies (management fee accrual, incentive fees with hurdle and HWM, equalisation, crystallisation, series/lot accounting), investor reporting, capital activity workflows, multi\-currency fund structures, and comprehensive reconciliation workflows, including managing tolerance thresholds, variance investigation, and resolution processes.
* AI\-Augmented Technical Skills: Demonstrated hands\-on practical experience utilizing AI assistants (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) as essential tools to accelerate and optimize professional workflows, specifically applying them to complex financial analysis, specification writing, and data exploration tasks.


**The location:** Gurgaon,India
  
  

**Our Benefits:** Global vision, local impact
  
At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market\-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
  
  

**Our approach is built on three core pillars:**  

* Global foundations: We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health \& Wellness, Financial Security, and Work\-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well\-being.
* Locally tailored: We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
* Flexibility and growth: We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.


The Trust employee ownership plan
  
Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly. This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
  
  

About OSTTRA
  
We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post\-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
  
Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end\-to\-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
  
Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
  
Joining our team now is a unique opportunity \- you will help to shape the next generation of post\-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more atwww.osttra.com.
  
Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA
  
We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post\-trade financial system runs on.
