 3–8 years (Patch Management / Vulnerability Content Development / macOS Systems Administration)
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled Apple macOS Patch Catalogue Engineer to design, develop, validate, and maintain macOS patch metadata and deployment catalogues in support of enterprise patch management solutions. This role is responsible for building and sustaining an in\-house macOS patch content repository covering both Apple OS updates and third\-party applications — ensuring accurate detection logic, reliable installation behavior, compliance reporting, and consistent deployment across enterprise environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Patch Catalogue Development
* Research and analyze security advisories published by Apple Inc. for macOS and related products.
* Create structured, schema\-compliant macOS patch metadata (version, architecture, detection, installation, and compliance fields).
* Build and maintain a centralized macOS patch catalogue repository.
* macOS Update \& Security Monitoring
* Continuously track new releases of macOS and other supported Apple and third\-party products.
* Monitor Apple security bulletins and release notes to identify patch\-relevant changes as they are published.
* Detection \& Compliance Logic
* Develop and validate detection logic using macOS system profiling commands and utilities.
* Apply working knowledge of OS builds, application bundles (.app), and package receipts (.pkg) to construct accurate version\-detection rules.
* Write and maintain automation scripts in Bash, Zsh, and Python to support content generation and validation.
* QA \& Validation
* Perform lab\-based testing across all supported macOS versions and architectures.
* Validate installation success, rollback scenarios, dependency handling, and fail\-safe behavior for every patch.
* Ensure patch content is stable and does not introduce regressions or system\-level side effects.
* Third\-Party macOS Application Patching
* Build accurate patch metadata for third\-party macOS applications.
* Develop packaging and deployment workflows for DMG, PKG, and ZIP installer formats.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of macOS architecture, filesystem structure, and system internals.
* Practical experience with:
* macOS software update mechanisms (Software Update, softwareupdate CLI)
* PKG/DMG packaging and installer behavior
* Launch Daemons and macOS system services
* Mandatory scripting proficiency in Bash and Python (Zsh a plus).
* Experience with Jamf Pro, Kandji, Intune, Munki, or Google Workspace would be a plus.
* Experience with Mac vulnerability management and Mac patch management.
* Solid understanding of CVE/NVD data, vulnerability severity scoring (CVSS), and patch supersedence logic.
* Experience with enterprise patch management tools is preferred (e.g., Ivanti Patch for Endpoint Manager, ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus, or similar platforms).
* Familiarity with Apple's MDM (Mobile Device Management) framework and Apple Business Manager.
* Knowledge of Secure Token and FileVault handling.
* Clear understanding of the architectural differences between Apple Silicon (ARM64\) and Intel\-based macOS systems.

description:
**About us:**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.


Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
 

A role in Merchandising Capabilities means partnering with Merchandising, technology, data science and analytics leaders to co\-create solutions that maximizes business value and enables key strategies that are critical to the enterprise and for the experiences we create for our guests. Truly an owner and expert of your product and underlying processes, you will set the vision, align on the roadmap and mobilize teams to deliver needed outcomes. Given most strategies have a business impact, you will also serve as a trusted resource to guide other enterprise partners in their solutions to ensure the success and integrity of end\-to\-end deliverables.


As a Sr. Manager, Data Analytics in Merchandising, you will be accountable for setting the vision, strategy, roadmap, and quality expectations for data, reporting, analytics, automation, and AI capabilities for a specific business function within our Merchandising organization. You will serve as an advocate of our data\-driven culture and a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping identify where analytics and AI can create the greatest business value. In partnership with your team of Data Analysts, you will translate business priorities into a portfolio of scalable solutions, ensure measurable outcomes, and build an effective analytics ecosystem that informs and influences decisions. You will build a high\-performing team through talent pipeline planning, hiring, coaching, setting clear expectations, capability development, and performance management. You will partner closely with Merchandising, Product Management, Data Science, Technology, and other analytics teams to align solutions, address capability gaps, and democratize trusted data and insights.


Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**As a Sr****.** **Manager****,** **Data** **Analytics** **for** **Target's** **Merch Data Analytics team** **you'll****:**


Lead an analytics team that supports our world\-class Merchandising leadership with data, insights, automation, and AI capabilities that enable faster, smarter, and more scalable decision\-making. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their priorities and roadmaps, translate business problems into a clear portfolio of work, and hold the team accountable for delivering measurable business outcomes.

* Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data, reporting, analytics, automation, and AI capabilities for the business area, and prioritize work based on business value, urgency, scalability, and strategic alignment.
* Provide thought leadership in the application of data and analytics, helping business leaders identify opportunities where insights, automation, Generative AI, AI agents, or agentic AI can materially improve decisions and outcomes.
* Translate complex and ambiguous business problems into a portfolio of scalable analytical and AI\-enabled solutions, defining clear success measures and ensuring the team remains focused on business outcomes rather than isolated technical deliverables.
* Guide and challenge the team's analytical and solution\-design approach, establishing expectations for technical quality, scalability, maintainability, and appropriate use of statistical, analytical, and AI methods.
* Ensure the team has the capability to work effectively with large\-scale datasets and modern data ecosystems, including platforms and technologies such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, SQL\-based data warehouses, and data pipelines using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.
* Establish standards for evaluating and monitoring AI\-driven analytical workflows, including defining appropriate quality metrics such as accuracy and relevance, assessing reliability, and measuring adoption and business impact of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact Generative AI opportunities and guide the adoption of AI\-agent\-enabled and agentic AI capabilities to automate repeatable analytical work, improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enable faster decision\-making.
* Establish and promote responsible and scalable AI practices, including data privacy, governance, bias and risk considerations, explainability, human oversight, and integration with the broader data and analytics ecosystem.
* Ensure analytical methodologies, AI solutions, key assumptions, evaluation approaches, and reusable patterns are appropriately documented to improve transparency, maintainability, knowledge sharing, and reuse across the team.
* Partner closely with Merchandising, Product Management, Data Science, Technology, and analytics partners to align roadmaps, resolve dependencies, identify capability gaps, and democratize access to trusted data and insights.
* Develop trusted relationships with business leaders and communicate complex analytical and technical concepts in clear business terms, ensuring recommendations are actionable and connected to measurable business drivers.
* Build and lead a high\-performing team of approximately 8\-10 analysts through talent pipeline planning, hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and career development.
* Develop both business acumen and technical capability within the team, fostering a culture of critical thinking, curiosity, experimentation, teaching, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adherence to corporate information protection and data governance standards across analytical and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Stay current on industry trends, best practices, emerging analytical methodologies, modern data platforms, Generative AI, AI agents, and agentic AI, and determine where they can create meaningful value for Target.

**About you:**

* Undergraduate Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in data analytics or related disciplines and a minimum of 2 years of people management experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading analytics teams, setting direction and priorities, and delivering analytical solutions that influence meaningful business decisions.
* Strong ability to translate business strategy and ambiguous problems into an actionable analytics roadmap and to manage trade\-offs across competing priorities and initiatives.
* Strong technical fluency across SQL, data warehousing and BI concepts, large\-scale data environments, and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or equivalent tools; able to review, challenge, and guide technical approaches without being the primary hands\-on executor.
* Strong understanding of modern data platforms and analytical ecosystems, including technologies such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, SQL\-based warehouses, and workflow orchestration or data pipelines such as Airflow.
* Working knowledge of analytical programming environments such as Python, R, Hive, or similar languages, along with strong conceptual understanding of analytical techniques such as regression, time\-series analysis, classification, experimentation, and other methods used to identify and measure business drivers.
* Experience guiding teams in the use of Generative AI and LLM\-based solutions, including prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI\-assisted analytical workflows, AI agents, and agentic AI capabilities.
* Ability to assess AI\-enabled solutions through appropriate measures of quality, reliability, relevance, adoption, and business impact, and to establish responsible AI practices including privacy, governance, bias and risk considerations, and explainability.
* Understanding of software development and analytical engineering practices including Git source code management, reusable development patterns, documentation, and Agile ways of working.
* Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage ambiguity and urgency in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, service orientation, and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate technical concepts into business implications and recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop, and retain analytical talent and to build an environment that supports accountability, learning, knowledge sharing, and career growth.
* Experience with Retail, Merchandising, or Marketing is a strong add\-on.

* Opportunity to work with a growing player in the poultry additives industry

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch
 




  






 The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.
 




  






 At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well\-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every
 





 aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.
 




  






 With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food \& nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt\-free, and inspired life.
 




  






 How will we do it?
 





 There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life\-transforming service:
 




  






 Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.
 





 Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.
 





 Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back\-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.
 




  






 Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:
 



* Individuals \& Families
* Landlords \& Second Home Owners
* Developers \& RWAs
* Corporates



  





*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family* 




  






 A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences \& behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family \& its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient \& a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre\-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service\-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family \& thus, the most important link between the company \& the customer.
 




  





*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager* 




  






 1\. Customer Onboarding
 



* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold \& onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.



  






 2\. Solution Deployment
 



* Define \& agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day\-to\-day chores, \& undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.



  






 3\. Partner Management
 



* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.



  






 4\. Customer Lifecycle Management
 



* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight \& transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.



  






 5\. Customer Feedback \& Service Improvement
 



* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify \& work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise \& highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.



  






 Who are we looking for?
 



* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start\-up
* Self\-motivated \& loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, \& is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity \& uncertainty
* Focused on problem\-solving, has a solution\-oriented mindset
* Hard\-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure



  






 Qualifications:
 



* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

**Job Title: Customer Success Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 4–8 years (D2C/eCommerce/Fashion preferred)
 



  





  





**About Us**




  





 We're looking for an ownership\-driven customer success manager who can run the back bone of customer experience for Oyela. You'll be the single point of accountability and own Oyela's entire post\-purchase customer experience — the team, the process and the promise. You will lead 10 support agents and 2–4 escalation leads, and be the single owner of what a customer hears from us, how fast they hear it, and what happens inside the company when they raise an issue. This is a build role, not a queue\-monitoring role.
 



 This is a frontend driven customer first approach role instead of operational lead.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




* **Team \& KRAs:** 
 Define KRAs and scorecards for agents and escalation leads. Run weekly QA audits, coaching, 1:1s, rosters, training, hiring and retention.
* **Ticket lifecycle:** 
 Own the helpdesk stack across WhatsApp, calls, email, Instagram, chat and marketplaces. Define contact\-reason taxonomy, P1–P4 priority, routing, SLAs, reply templates and brand tone — and define exactly what "closed" means, with CSAT on every closure.
* **Internal action triggers:** 
 Map every complaint to the internal team that must act — warehouse, logistics, quality, catalog, finance, marketing — with named owner, TAT and proof of completion. Own the L1–L4 escalation matrix and make sure the customer is updated within the promised window, every time.
* **SOPs:** 
 Write an SOP for every contact reason and every internal trigger, with a time standard on every step. Maintain them versioned, review monthly/quarterly, update on any policy or partner change, and audit adherence.
* **Reporting \& root cause:** 
 Own the leadership dashboard (FRT, resolution TAT, SLA adherence, backlog, CSAT, contacts per order, cost per contact). Run a weekly Voice\-of\-Customer review with ops and product to fix root causes — and bring support volume down, not just response time.



  





**Requirements**




  




* 4–8 years in customer experience/support, with 3\+ years managing a team of 10 or more.
* D2C, e\-commerce, fashion, retail or quick\-commerce background — you know order, delivery, return and refund journeys first\-hand.
* Proven experience building an SOP, SLA and escalation framework from scratch, not just running one.
* Hands\-on with Freshdesk, automations, routing rules, SLA policies, reporting.
* Working knowledge of Shopify order flows, returns and exchanges, RTO/NDR handling, payment gateway refunds and courier escalations.
* Strong in Excel/Google Sheets and comfortable with dashboards;
* Excellent written and spoken English and Hindi, with the ability to write in brand voice.
* Calm and decisive under escalation — able to say no to a customer and push a fix through another department.



  





**What we offer:**




  




* Opportunity to work with one of India’s fastest\-growing D2C fashion brands.
* Ownership and autonomy to experiment and build impactful features.
* Collaborative and growth\-focused culture.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-based growth.

 www.oyela.in

**Job Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION: Manager**
**Office: India**
**Department: Client Services**
**Job Summary**
* Concentrates in driving business growth and the development of talent. Spends time in reviewing and assessing overall team performance.

* To facilitate various accounting and administration processes of complex clients and conduct all work in accordance with IQ\-EQ India Global Client Delivery's policies and procedures, as needed. (when AM is unable to, depending on capacity).
* As a supervisor, the Manager leads, organizes, coordinates, develops, monitors the performance, delegates tasks and responsibilities to their direct reports and their team members (skip level), as needed.
* Ensures balanced work allocation across their teams and reallocates resources accordingly.


**Core Responsibilities**
* Responsible for review of Financial Statements with Disclosures and other ad\-hoc service requests for complex funds and/or corporate clients.
* Responsible for the preparation of complex reporting requirements, when necessary.
* Monitors the timely and accurate deliverables of their teams, and intervene, as necessary.
* Acquire knowledge to become specialists of their designated clients' requirements and deliverables.

* Seeks knowledge and expertise for their own professional development.
* Initiates the development of the technical competencies of their teams by providing feedback on their deliverables and endorsing them to the appropriate learning \& development activities
* Monitors the development and assigned trainings of their teams.
* Monitors and provides support to cluster counterparts escalations and involves the relevant stakeholders.
* Monitors the agreed timelines of deliverables with the cluster counterparts and provides support for escalations to ensure that their teams carry out the work, as agreed.
* To be able to effectively communicate and relate with various stakeholders of the team. Maintains and enhances relationships through crucial conversations.
* Monitors that all client cluster requirements are thoroughly being reviewed and follows standards.
* To act as an alternate for the Head of Delivery based on business needs which may include cluster client responsibilities, administrative tasks, and team management.


**Tasks \& Duties**
**Cluster Client Delivery**
* Acquires functional knowledge and understanding of the clients’ agreements, Scope of Work (SOW), SLA’s and other necessary information needed to review and/or prepare deliverables.

* Provides support (for timelines) and address issues (for quality), as needed.
* Provide support for the rest of the team and other teams by allotting additional capacity, as needed. At the same time, initiates the request for support needed from other teams.
* Monitors and communicates the review comments of the team and then follows up to address pending comments for preparers, as needed.

* Decides on escalated recommendations and if necessary, escalate to SMEs or technical team.
* Monitors and works with the Assistant Manager to enforce process standards across the teams.
* Acts as first level of escalation of issues/concerns from the funds assigned to their clusters.
* Supports Project Managers by functioning as SMEs, coordinating with stakeholders, and allocating resources.


**Workflow Management**
* Ensures timesheets are completed daily and accurately filed for all hours worked.

* Monitors and ensures the completeness and accuracy of all deliverables via the workflow planner in a timely manner.

**Systems**

**Risks**
* Monitors relevant procedures, checklists and SSAE requirements are adhered to and completed to mitigate errors.

**Key behaviours we expect to see**

* Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and Experience Required for this Role**

**Education / professional qualifications**
* Graduate of accounting or any business\-related course with 8\+ years relevant accounting experience.

**Background Experience**

**Desired**

* Experience working in Financial Services or Shared Services office environment.
* Experience working in a multinational office environment.
* Open to travel and other secondment opportunities abroad.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 As a forward\-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

* Demonstrated effectiveness with both oral and written communication.

description:
About the Role: As an Air Ticketing Executive at EaseMyTrip.com , you will be responsible for managing flight bookings, modifications, cancellations, and customer queries related to air travel. You will interact directly with customers, travel agents, and airline partners to ensure accurate and timely ticket issuance and support. This role is ideal for someone with a strong understanding of airline reservation systems, fare rules, and a customer-first approach. You will play a vital part in delivering smooth and efficient travel experiences. 
 Key Responsibilities Flight Booking & Ticketing: Handle domestic and international flight bookings, issue tickets accurately using airline reservation systems and GDS platforms. Amendments & Cancellations: Process rebookings, date changes, cancellations, and refunds as per airline and company policies. Customer Support: Assist customers with flight-related queries over calls, emails, or chatsincluding fare details, baggage policies, seat selection, and special requests. Fare Calculation & Comparison: Calculate accurate fares, apply discounts, compare flight options, and inform customers of the most economical and convenient choices. GDS & Airline Portal Operations: Work on GDS platforms like Amadeus, Galileo, Sabre or airline-specific portals to issue, modify, or cancel tickets. PNR Management: Monitor and manage PNRs (Passenger Name Records), ensure timely ticketing, and follow up on waitlisted or unconfirmed bookings. Coordination with Airlines & Vendors: Liaise with airlines, consolidators, and backend teams to resolve booking issues, seek fare waivers, or manage special service requests (SSRs). Documentation & Reporting: Maintain booking records, transaction logs, and share MIS reports with supervisors or management as required. Policy Adherence: Follow IATA standards, airline fare rules, and company procedures to ensure accuracy and compliance in all transactions. Team Collaboration: Coordinate with customer care, holiday, and sales teams to ensure smooth delivery of flight services. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Experience: 0 to 5 years of experience in air ticketing. Freshers with strong GDS training or travel domain knowledge are welcome. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Certification in Travel & Tourism or IATA is preferred. GDS Knowledge: Familiar with at least one Global Distribution System (GDS) like Amadeus, Galileo, or Sabre. Airline Policies: Understanding of airline fare rules, baggage policies, cancellation norms, and reissuance procedures. Communication Skills: Fluent in Hindi and English. Ability to explain travel terms clearly and confidently to customers. Customer Orientation: Polite, professional, and empathetic when handling customer concerns related to flight bookings. Tech Proficiency: Comfortable with reservation systems, airline portals, email communication, and MS Excel for reports. Detail-Oriented: High accuracy in fare calculations, PNR entries, and passenger data input. Problem Solving: Ability to handle last-minute booking challenges, fare differences, and route changes with quick turnaround. Flexibility: Willing to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and during peak travel seasons or emergencies.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager (B2B)** 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 Years (B2B Environment)
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹7 LPA – ₹9 LPA (Fixed) \+ Performance\-Linked Incentives
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time (Hiring Immediately)
 



**Role Type:** 
 Field Sales \+ Office\-Based Business Development
 



  





**Company Description** 




**Group Welkin** 
 is a corporate and bulk\-order solutions group with over 50 years of experience rooted in the Indian kitchenware and household products industry. We are currently scaling our B2B corporate gifting vertical and building structured systems to drive consistent visibility, inbound interest, lead generation, and business conversions across industries.
 



  





**Job Description** 




**This is a full\-time Business Development Manager (B2B)** 
 role based in Hyderabad. The position is focused on
 **new business development, corporate customer acquisition, closing deals, and key\-account growth** 
 .
 



  





 The BDM will be responsible for taking qualified leads generated by our prospecting and digital marketing teams, connecting with decision\-makers, fixing appointments, conducting corporate meetings, understanding requirements, presenting suitable solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
 



 The ideal candidate is a confident and self\-driven B2B sales professional who is comfortable meeting senior decision\-makers, building relationships, negotiating effectively, and taking ownership of the complete sales cycle from opportunity to order.
 



**Working Model – 4 Days Field \+ 2 Days Office** 




  





**This is primarily a field\-oriented Business Development role. Candidates should be comfortable travelling within Hyderabad and meeting corporate customers regularly.** 



* **4 Days – Field Visits:** 
 Visit and meet corporate customers, generate new business opportunities, conduct product presentations, understand customer requirements, follow up on active opportunities, negotiate commercial terms, and close orders.
* **2 Days – Office\-Based Business Development:** 
 CRM updates, lead follow\-ups, building new corporate connections, appointment fixing, proposal and quotation preparation, pipeline review, reporting, and coordination with the Marketing and Business Development teams.



 The candidate is expected to plan the week effectively to maintain a healthy balance between
 **new customer acquisition, field meetings, follow\-ups, conversions, and key\-account development.** 




  





**Work Location** 




**Welkin Convergence Pvt. Ltd.** 




**Welkin Campus, Sy. No. 120/5, Near Dundigal Police Station, D.P. Pally (Village), Quthbullapur (M), Hyderabad, Telangana** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Spend
 **4 days per week in the field** 
 , meeting existing and prospective corporate customers across Hyderabad.
* Generate new business opportunities through corporate visits, networking, referrals, existing databases, and company\-generated leads.
* Spend
 **2 days per week in the office** 
 on CRM updates, follow\-ups, appointment fixing, prospecting, quotations, proposals, pipeline review, and reporting.
* Own the follow\-up and conversion of qualified leads received from the prospecting team, digital campaigns, and inbound channels.
* Conduct discovery meetings to understand corporate gifting, bulk\-order, employee gifting, promotional gifting, and other business requirements.
* Present suitable Group Welkin product solutions and catalogues based on customer requirements and budgets.
* Prepare professional quotations and commercial proposals.
* Negotiate pricing, quantities, delivery schedules, payment terms, and other commercial requirements to close orders.
* Build strong relationships with decision\-makers across
 **Procurement, Purchase, HR, Admin, Marketing, and senior leadership** 
 functions.
* Develop business across priority sectors such as
 **Jewellery, Pharma, Cooperative Banking, Cement, Construction, IT, Manufacturing, Educational Institutions, and other corporate segments.**
* **Develop repeat business and identify cross\-selling and expansion opportunities within existing key accounts.**
* **Maintain accurate CRM records covering lead status, meetings, opportunities, quotations, deal stages, next actions, expected closure dates, and sales forecasts.**
* **Coordinate closely with the Marketing and Business Development teams to ensure smooth lead\-to\-deal conversion.**
* **Provide market and customer feedback to help improve lead generation, product positioning, and sales campaigns.**
* **Submit structured weekly reports covering field visits, meetings, new opportunities, quotations, pipeline value, conversions, revenue, and key\-account updates.**



  





**Qualifications** 



* **3–5 years of B2B Sales or Business Development experience** 
 with a proven track record of generating and closing business.
* Experience in field sales and direct meetings with corporate customers is essential.
* Experience handling qualified leads and managing key accounts.
* Experience in
 **Corporate Gifting, FMCG, Distribution, Consumer Products, Kitchenware, Household Products, or Product\-Based B2B Sales** 
 will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of quotations, proposals, commercial negotiations, and order closure.
* Familiarity with CRM and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related discipline is preferred.



  





**Skills \& Requirements** 



* Strong
 **business development, negotiation, and closing ability** 
 .
* Comfortable with regular field visits and face\-to\-face corporate meetings.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to confidently interact with senior corporate decision\-makers.
* Strong relationship\-building and consultative selling skills.
* Disciplined pipeline management and reliable follow\-up.
* Ability to read pipeline and conversion data and take corrective action.
* Self\-driven, organised, and capable of independently managing customers and opportunities.
* Strong planning and time\-management skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Willingness to take ownership of revenue targets and business conversions.



  





**Compensation** 




**CTC: ₹7 LPA – ₹9 LPA (Fixed)** 
 , based on experience and demonstrated skills.
 



 In addition to the fixed CTC, the role includes
 **performance\-linked incentives based on business generated and deals closed.** 
 The detailed incentive structure will be discussed and finalised with management.
 



 PF and other statutory benefits/deductions will be applicable as per company policy.
 



 The Offer Letter and Annexure will be issued after the office visit, interview, and final discussion with management.
 



**Languages** 



* **English – Required**
* **Hindi – Required**
* **Telugu – Preferred**



  





**Why Join Group Welkin?** 



* Join a trusted organisation with
 **over 50 years of industry experience** 
 .
* Play a direct role in building and scaling Group Welkin's B2B corporate gifting business.
* Receive qualified leads and opportunities generated by a dedicated prospecting and digital marketing team.
* Combine company\-generated opportunities with your own field\-level business development.
* Directly interact with corporate decision\-makers and build valuable key accounts.
* Attractive
 **performance\-linked earning potential** 
 based on the business you close.
* Sell a strong portfolio of kitchenware, household products, and corporate gifting solutions with significant repeat\-order potential.
* Opportunity for fast career growth as the B2B sales function expands.



  





**Company Websites**

* Understanding of chemical handling, workplace safety standards, PPE compliance, and preventive maintenance practices.
* Flexible to work in shifts.


**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**
* Experience in Automotive, Electronics, Electrical, Heavy Engineering, or Industrial Manufacturing environments.
* Experience maintaining production checklists, maintenance records, rejection reports, and rework reports.

description:
**We need someone who's already good on the phone. CAT prep can teach the rest.** 



1. **📍 Gurugram, on\-site**
2. **6 days a week** 
 ·
3. **Full\-time**
4. **₹28,000–35,000 fixed \+ up to ₹15,000 variable**
5. **6 months to 1 year experience** 
 ,
 **any degree**



  





 3 lakh\+ CAT aspirants follow this brand. 40,000\+ of them have gotten into an IIM. Every day, some of them fill out a form asking to talk to someone. That someone is you.
 



  




 This is for you if
 
  




* You've sold something over the phone before, and you know what a "maybe" sounds like before the prospect says it out loud
* You can hold a real conversation in English and Hindi, not just read from a script in either
* You want a number to hit every month, not a vague "let's see how it goes"
* You'd rather ask someone their actual timeline and percentile goal than push whatever programme is easiest to sell
* You've either taken CAT yourself, or you know the B\-school admissions game well enough to talk about it credibly



  




 This probably isn't for you if
 
  




* You want a desk job with zero calls and zero targets
* You freeze up on price objections instead of engaging with them
* Being in Gurugram, in person, six days a week is a dealbreaker



  




 What the job actually looks like
 
  




* Aspirants come to you already interested. You figure out their target percentile, timeline, and what's actually stopping them
* You recommend the right cohort (6 to 15 months) for where they are, not where a target sheet wants them to be
* You run your own pipeline: first call, every follow\-up, right through to enrolment
* You handle real price and credibility objections with real answers
* You keep your CRM clean and tell marketing the truth about lead quality, even when it's not flattering


 Tools you should already know
 
  





 CRM (LeadSquared, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), Excel or Google Sheets, WhatsApp Business. Bonus points if you've used a dialer like Ozonetel or Exotel.
 



  




 Why people take this over other sales jobs
 
  





 The brand has already done the convincing. You're not cold calling, you're following up with someone who raised their hand. The upside is real too: up to ₹15,000 a month in variable, on top of a fixed ₹28,000 to ₹35,000\. And you're helping someone decide how to spend the next year of their life, which is a heavier, more interesting conversation than most sales jobs give you.
 



  




 How hiring works here
 
  





 One round. One conversation that covers screening and a mock counselling exercise. If it's a fit, you'll know within 7 working days of your first call.
 



  




 Who's hiring you
 
  





 Fast hiring usually drops the bar. Thirty CVs get skimmed, three that look fine get picked, and the rest of the stack never gets opened. The role fills quickly. You find out in month three what was sitting on page forty.
 



  





 Aara Recruits doesn't make that trade. Send the JD, that's the only part the client does. Every application gets read in full against the brief. When the inbound pipeline isn't enough, they source beyond it, make first contact, chase the replies, and qualify people on the things that usually kill offers late. Confirmed interviews land straight in the calendar, often within hours of a shortlist forming.
 



 Clients pay only when they hire. No retainer, no upfront fee, nothing owed if a search doesn't land.
 



  





**How they keep the bar high while moving fast:** 




  




* Full reads, not keyword scans. Candidate forty gets the same attention as candidate one
* One rubric across the whole pool, so nobody's judged on a different scale
* Experience weighted for depth and recency. Listing a tool isn't the same as having shipped with it
* Every shortlist comes with the reasoning behind it, so a client can push back if they disagree
* Gaps get stated plainly. Nobody gets quietly rejected without the client knowing why



  





 Built for teams filling roles under pressure, who'd rather be interviewing than recruiting.

**Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Administrator** 




 Position Summary
 



 The IAM Junior Administrator supports the management of user identities, access privileges, authentication systems, and cloud identity services across the organization's IT environment. This role assists in user provisioning, access reviews, compliance activities, AWS IAM administration, and troubleshooting access\-related issues while ensuring adherence to security policies and regulatory requirements.

 User Access Management
 


* Create, modify, and disable user accounts across enterprise systems and applications.
* Process access requests in accordance with established policies and approval workflows.
* Perform user onboarding, transfers, and offboarding activities.
* Maintain role\-based access controls (RBAC) and user group memberships.
* Help provision and deprovision access across enterprise systems and cloud platforms.



 Identity Administration
 


* Support the administration of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), LDAP, or similar identity platforms.
* Manage password resets, account unlocks, and Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) enrollment.
* Assist with Single Sign\-On (SSO) configuration and troubleshooting.
* Document IAM configurations, procedures, and operational processes.



 AWS Identity \& Access Management
 


* Assist in creating and managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies.

* Support access provisioning and deprovisioning within AWS environments.

 Access Governance \& Compliance

* Support internal and external audits by providing access\-related evidence and reports.

 Incident \& Problem Management

* Escalate complex issues to senior IAM administrators or security teams.
* Monitor IAM systems and identify potential security concerns.
* Participate in root\-cause analysis for recurring access issues.



 Reporting \& Documentation
 


* Generate reports on user access, privileged accounts, and compliance metrics.
* Maintain IAM operational procedures, knowledge base articles, and process documentation.
* Track and document service requests through ticketing systems.

**Education**

 About AI Unika
 



 AI Unika is a technology company building intelligent products for real\-world problems across
 **Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Automation, Mobility, Data and Software Engineering** 
 . We are not interested in simply creating another software product or building a company where people come to work, complete assigned tickets and go home. We are building a team that wants to create something meaningful, ambitious and lasting.
 



 We are at a stage where the right people can genuinely influence what the company becomes. Your work can be seen, your ideas can be heard and your decisions can directly contribute to the products we build. That's why this opportunity is for someone who is looking for more than a designation and a monthly salary.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Full Stack Developer with 3\+ years of strong hands\-on MERN Stack experience** 
 who genuinely enjoys building products. Someone who can take an idea or business problem, understand what needs to be solved, design the right technical approach, build the application, deploy it, troubleshoot it in production and continuously make it better.
 



 You will work primarily with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript** 
 , building complete applications rather than working within a narrow technical boundary. You should be comfortable moving between frontend, backend, database, APIs and production environments whenever the product requires it.
 



 Your work will involve developing modern React applications, designing reusable components, building Node.js and Express.js backend services, creating secure REST APIs, designing MongoDB schemas and aggregation pipelines, integrating third\-party services, implementing authentication and authorization, optimizing application performance and supporting production deployments.
 



  





 💻 Technical Skills \& Qualifications
 


* **3\+ years** 
 of professional Full Stack Development experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js**
* Excellent knowledge of
 **JavaScript (ES6\+)**
* Good hands\-on experience with
 **React.js** 
 , Hooks, component architecture and state management
* Strong experience developing
 **Node.js \+ Express.js** 
 backend applications
* Strong understanding of
 **RESTful API design, development and integration**
* Strong knowledge of
 **MongoDB schema design, aggregation, indexing and query optimization**
* Experience with
 **authentication, authorization and API security**
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming and event\-driven architecture
* Experience with
 **Git/GitHub/GitLab** 
 and collaborative development workflows
* Strong understanding of
 **HTML5, CSS3 and responsive web development**
* Knowledge of clean code, reusable architecture and software development best practices
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Understanding of application performance, scalability and security
* Experience with production application deployment and maintenance
* Working knowledge of
 **AWS or equivalent cloud platforms**
* Experience with
 **Docker and CI/CD** 
 is an advantage
* Experience with
 **TypeScript** 
 is an advantage
* Experience integrating
 **AI APIs, LLMs, Computer Vision or automation systems** 
 is an advantage
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, testing and release management



  





 ❤️
 **We Are Looking for a Builder** 




 We can teach a framework. We can introduce you to a new technology. We can help you understand a new business domain.
 



 What is much harder to teach is
 **the desire to build something extraordinary.** 




 We want someone who sees an unfinished product and gets excited rather than uncomfortable. Someone who can receive a difficult requirement and say,
 **“Let's figure it out.”** 
 Someone who doesn't need every step explained before beginning. Someone who takes ownership when something breaks, thinks about why a feature exists instead of blindly implementing it, and cares about whether the customer actually benefits from what was built.
 



 At AI Unika, we don't want developers who only ask,
 **“What should I code?”** 




 We want developers who ask,
 **“What are we trying to achieve, and what is the best way to build it?”** 




  





 🚀
 **Our Startup Culture** 




 AI Unika is a startup, and startup life is different. Not every requirement will arrive perfectly documented. Priorities can change. New problems can appear unexpectedly. Sometimes the most important work of the day won't be mentioned in your original job description.
 



 Our culture is simple:
 



**“Every work is my work. We complete every challenge as one team.”** 




 If the product needs help, we help. If production has a problem, we solve it. If another team needs technical support, we contribute. If the customer has a problem, we don't start by asking whose responsibility it is—we start by asking how we can solve it.
 



 Your designation tells us your expertise.
 **It does not define the limit of your contribution.** 




 We value people who step forward, learn quickly, communicate openly and take responsibility even when nobody is standing behind them.
 



  





 🤝
 **Work Close to the Action** 




 You will have the opportunity to work closely with
 **Founders, Product, Technology, Business and other teams** 
 , giving you exposure that goes far beyond writing code.
 



 You'll understand why a product is being built, what customers actually need, how business decisions influence technology and how technology ultimately creates value. If you have a better technical idea, we expect you to bring it forward. If you see a risk, we expect you to raise it. If you believe something can be built better, we want you to challenge it constructively.
 



 We want engineers who can
 **think like owners** 
 , not simply execute instructions.
 



  





 🌍
 **Build Technology That Goes Into the Real World** 




 Your work at AI Unika may contribute to products involving
 **AI, Computer Vision, Mobility, Automation, Data, SaaS and intelligent systems** 
 . You may work with real\-world datasets, intelligent workflows, third\-party platforms, APIs and applications that are used outside the development environment.
 



 You will experience the complete journey of software:
 



**Build it. Deploy it. Watch it work. Find what doesn't work. Fix it. Improve it. Scale it.** 




 That experience is difficult to gain when your entire career is limited to maintaining an already\-finished product.
 



  





 📈
 **What This Opportunity Can Become** 




 We don't want your next five years to simply add five years to your resume.
 



 We want those years to fundamentally change what you're capable of.
 



 Your growth at AI Unika will come from the problems you can solve, the products you can own, the responsibility you can handle and the impact you create. As your capability grows, your responsibility can grow with it.
 



 You may begin by owning features, then larger modules, architecture, technical decisions and eventually complete products or teams. The opportunity will be driven by
 **capability, ownership, performance, learning and contribution** 
 .
 



  





 💰
 **Compensation** 




 The CTC for this position is
 **up to ₹7 LPA** 
 , with the final compensation determined based on experience, technical capability, practical problem\-solving ability, interview performance and overall suitability.
 



 We understand that salary is important. Everyone deserves fair compensation for their work.
 



 But there is something we want to be very clear about.
 



**If you're looking for this role only because you want a salary hike or a bigger number on your CTC, this may not be the right opportunity for you.** 




 We respect people who priorities compensation, but that's not the person we're trying to build our core team around.
 



 At AI Unika,
 **we are looking for assets, not liabilities.** 




 We want people who make the organization stronger because they are here. People who create value instead of simply consuming resources. People who take responsibility, learn continuously, solve problems and help the entire team move forward.
 



 If your mindset is only
 **“What will I get?”** 
 , we may not be the right fit.
 



 If your mindset is
 **“What can I build, what can I learn, what can I contribute and what can I become?”** 
 , then we genuinely want to meet you.
 



  





 🌟 Maybe This Is the Opportunity You've Been Waiting For
 



 There are thousands of Full Stack Developer openings.
 



 Most will offer you a technology stack, a designation, a salary and a defined list of responsibilities.
 



 We are offering something different.
 



 You can join while the journey is still being written. You can work on products that are still evolving. You can sit close to the people making decisions. You can see your code become a real feature, your feature become a real product and your product create real impact.
 



 You won't simply inherit someone else's roadmap.
 



**You can help shape it.** 




 You won't simply maintain someone else's creation.
 



**You can help create something of your own.** 




 And perhaps years from now, the most valuable thing you remember won't be the salary you received in your first year.
 



 It will be the things you learned, the problems you solved, the people you built with and the products you can point to and say:
 



**“I was there when we built this.”** 




 If that feeling matters to you more than simply finding another job,
 **AI Unika could be the place you've been looking for.** 




 🚀 AI Unika
 **Build something real. Own your work. Learn without limits. Grow with the journey. Create something you'll be proud of. we People First Company.** 




  





 If You are looking something similar and Having experience of 5 Years

**Your mission**
----------------


**About the Organisation \& Role:**


You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.


As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will build backend services for the membership and loyalty capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, development and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer, Product Owner and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low latency services that support real\-time consumer experiences. You will also be building reusable assets for consistent development and delivery.


**What you will do:**


* Design, build, and operate scalable, low\-latency APIs, event\-driven services, and integration layers that support real\-time and batch membership, loyalty, rewards, and consumer engagement use cases.
* Develop and evolve customer\-facing web applications and supporting backend services, ensuring a seamless and consistent membership and loyalty experience across digital channels.
* Configure, extend, and integrate the Antavo loyalty platform, including custom workflows, reward mechanisms, member lifecycle processes, event processing, and promotional capabilities.
* Design and implement integrations between Antavo and enterprise commerce platforms such as SFCC, Fluent Commerce, CDP, CRM, marketing automation, and data platforms to support accurate and near real\-time member data synchronisation.
* Apply distributed systems principles including asynchronous processing, idempotency, caching, retries, circuit breakers, and event\-driven architectures to build resilient and reliable member experiences at scale.
* Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient by implementing engineering best practices for monitoring, logging and performance optimisation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Lead Engineers, Architects, Data Engineers, and AI/ML Engineers to deliver business capabilities and contribute to technical design decisions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable libraries, reference implementations, and platform capabilities that improve consistency, maintainability, and developer experience across teams.
* Troubleshoot production issues through monitoring, logging, crash analysis, and root cause investigation.
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, share technical knowledge, and promote engineering best practices across the team
**Your talent**
---------------


* 7\+ years of experience designing and building large scale distributed backend systems on cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience implementing or integrating enterprise loyalty platforms (Antavo preferred), including member lifecycle management, rewards, promotions, campaign execution, and loyalty transaction processing.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms, with practical experience applying them to real\-world use cases.
* Expertise in backend engineering, API design, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and scalable integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend development practices sufficient to contribute to customer\-facing applications.
* Experience with Node.js and related frameworks.
* Experience in event streaming platforms like Kafka.
* Experience with SQL/No\-SQL databases with understanding of database architecture and distributed data management.
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

description:
**Job Description**




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Data Modeler** 
 to support the design and delivery of enterprise data models across business domains such as Finance, Sales, Retail, Supply Chain, Product, Customer, and Digital Commerce.
 



 The role will focus on translating business requirements into high\-quality
 **conceptual, logical, physical, and semantic data models** 
 . The Data Modeler will work closely with Data Architects, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, BI developers, and business stakeholders to ensure that data structures are consistent, scalable, governed, and fit for analytical consumption.
 



 The ideal candidate has strong experience in enterprise data modeling, dimensional modeling, lakehouse or data warehouse environments, and modern analytics platforms such as Databricks or similar technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Data Modeling** 




  




* Create and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models
* Design entities, attributes, relationships, hierarchies, keys, and cardinalities.
* Develop dimensional models, including facts, dimensions, bridge tables, slowly changing dimensions, and aggregation structures.
* Define and document business entities such as Customer, Product, Store, Order, Transaction, Supplier, Account, and similar core business concepts.
* Support the design of reusable and conformed data models across domains and data products.



  





**Semantic and Analytical Modeling** 




  




* Design models optimized for analytics, reporting, and BI consumption.
* Define business metrics, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, and calculation logic.
* Support semantic layer design for tools such as Power BI, Databricks SQL, Databricks Metric Views, or similar platforms.
* Ensure consistent business definitions for KPIs and analytical measures.

**Source\-to\-Target Mapping** 




  




* Analyze source system structures and map them to target data models.
* Create and maintain source\-to\-target mappings, including transformation logic and business rules.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplicate structures, and data quality issues in source systems.
* Work with Data Engineers to translate mappings into implementation\-ready pipeline logic.
* Support validation of implemented data models against business and technical requirements.

* Strong knowledge of data modeling methodologies: Conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional
* Strong SQL skills
* Understanding of database and lakehouse concepts: tables, views, keys, constraints, partitioning, clustering, delta tables, schema evolution
* Experience with cloud data platforms, ideally Databricks
* Understanding of BI and semantic modeling concepts: Semantic layers, Metrics layers, DatabricksSQL, PowerBI



  





**Soft Skills:** 



* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

* Strong communication skills with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Structured and documentation\-oriented working style.
* Ability to challenge unclear requirements and identify inconsistencies.
* Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.
* Ability to work independently as an external consultant.

description:
**About The Crafture** 




 The Crafture is a Gurugram\-based bespoke furniture studio creating handcrafted, made\-to\-order furniture for homes, hospitality spaces and design\-led businesses. With our own manufacturing setup, we work across solid wood, cane and upholstery to deliver distinctive, durable pieces and complete\-home furniture solutions.
 



**The Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Performance Marketer who can plan, execute and scale paid campaigns across Meta and Google. You will own the complete performance funnel \- from audience strategy and creative testing to tracking, optimisation and lead quality. The role is ideal for someone who is analytical, commercially aware and comfortable working closely with founders, sales and creative teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Plan, launch and optimise lead\-generation and conversion campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
 



 Own campaign structure, audience segmentation, keyword strategy, bidding, budgets and daily performance optimisation.
 



 Drive qualified enquiries for full\-home furniture, bespoke furniture, hospitality projects and B2B partnerships across priority cities.
 



 Track and improve core metrics including spend, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPL, CAC, ROAS and lead\-to\-sale conversion.
 



 Build a disciplined testing calendar for creative formats, hooks, copy, audiences, offers and landing pages.
 



 Translate campaign data into clear creative briefs and work with the design/content team to produce higher\-performing ads.
 



 Set up and maintain accurate tracking through GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/CAPI, UTMs and relevant conversion events.
 



 Connect marketing performance with lead quality and sales outcomes using Zoho CRM, WhatsApp and website enquiry data.
 



 Prepare concise weekly reports with insights, learnings, budget recommendations and next actions \- not just metric dumps.
 



 Monitor competitors, platform changes and emerging opportunities without chasing trends that do not support business outcomes.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 2\-4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably with a D2C, e\-commerce, interiors, real\-estate, luxury or premium consumer brand.
 



 Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including Search, Display, Performance Max and remarketing.
 



 Demonstrated ability to manage budgets independently and improve ROAS, CAC or CPL through structured optimisation.
 



 Practical understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, GA4, GTM and performance dashboards.
 



 Comfort with numbers, experimentation and making decisions from imperfect data.
 



 Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with founders, salespeople, designers and content creators.
 



 A portfolio or case studies showing actual campaign budgets, approach and results.
 



  





**Success in This Role Will Be Measured By** 




 Growth in qualified leads and revenue influenced by paid campaigns.
 



 Improvement in CPL, CAC, ROAS and lead\-to\-sale conversion.
 



 Lead quality across retail, complete\-home, hospitality and B2B enquiries.
 



 Speed and quality of testing, learning and budget reallocation.
 



 Accuracy and usefulness of tracking, reporting and actionable insights.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Work directly with the founders and influence growth strategy, not only campaign execution.
 



 Build performance marketing for a design\-led brand with its own manufacturing capability and strong visual content.
 



 Take ownership across the full funnel and see a direct connection between campaigns, leads and sales.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply with your CV and 2\-3 campaign case studies. Please include the objective, media budget, platforms used, your specific contribution, key results, current and expected CTC, notice period and present location.
 



**Please apply only if you are comfortable working full\-time from our Gurugram office.**

**Description**
 As a Senior Salesforce Project Manager, you will lead, orchestrate, and own the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-cloud enterprise Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies, SAFe frameworks, and modern, AI\-enabled delivery practices. You will be directly accountable for delivery excellence across highly visible global accounts, program\-level financial performance, strategic governance, and C\-suite stakeholder alignment, operating with a mature business\-owner, consultative, and customer\-first mindset.
   

  

 This role requires advanced strategic thinking, exceptional executive presence, and a proven track record of hands\-on delivery leadership to turn around complex Salesforce programs, maximise project margins, mitigate systemic risks, and scale best\-in\-class delivery practices across the organisation.
   

  

**What We Expect**
* AI\-First Delivery \& Agentic Productivity Strategy: Champion and strategically scale the adoption of authorized AI technologies and prompt engineering across your delivery teams. Actively utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation, eliminate operational friction and compress overall project delivery timelines.
* Performance Evaluation \& ROI: "Collaborate with customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance for their specific use cases."
* Enterprise Delivery \& P\&L Governance: Plan, direct, and oversee the complete enterprise Salesforce delivery lifecycle. Own financial performance at the program level—managing macro\-scope, multi\-track timelines, systemic risks, and cross\-project dependencies while driving high\-quality business outcomes and aggressively protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Scale Agile \& Delivery Leadership: Champion and institutionalize Agile delivery architectures using Scrum, Lean, and SAFe frameworks. Drive multi\-track sprint execution, rigorous backlog prioritization, predictive flow metrics, and foster high\-performing, self\-organizing, cross\-functional global delivery squads.
* Strategic Planning \& Portfolio Roadmap Management: Architect and govern integrated portfolio plans and long\-term delivery roadmaps. Ensure transparent, data\-driven progress reporting, proactive macro\-risk visibility, and complex technical dependency management across the global engagement lifecycle.
* C\-Suite \& Executive Stakeholder Management: Serve as trusted advisor to senior leaders. Drive alignment across global organizations through executive communication, steering committees, and proactive escalation management.
* Quality Governance \& Institutional Excellence: Design and enforce delivery governance, engineering standards, and quality benchmarks. Implement quality checkpoints to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
* Strategic Resource \& Capital Optimization: Orchestrate and optimize multi\-shore resource demand planning, manage complex program budgets, accurate forecasts, and financial reconciliation while engineering mitigation strategies for structural delivery risks.
* Global Synchronisation \& Timezone Flexibility: Maintain the structural timezone flexibility required to ensure seamless synchronisation, seamless governance, and executive support across global delivery regions (AMER/EMEA/APAC).


**Requirements**
**Must Have** 
 :
   

  

* 15\+ years of total experience in the IT consulting/services industry, with 8\+ years of dedicated experience leading complex, enterprise\-scale Salesforce implementations.
* Proven track record managing multi\-cloud, highly integrated Salesforce transformations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or specialised Industry Clouds.
* Advanced, practical proficiency with AI\-augmented productivity suites and LLMs (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) alongside a clear, actionable vision for applying an Agentic Delivery approach to project tracking, documentation, and risk forecasting.
* Deep, authoritative understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem architecture and delivery lifecycle, with a demonstrated history of collaborating with Enterprise Architects and Technical Leads to map technical scope to business outcomes (hands\-on configuration is not required).
* Stellar executive presence with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with C\-suite executives, global sponsors, and enterprise steering committees.
* Salesforce Core Consultant Certifications (at least two or higher\-tier equivalent):
+ Sales Cloud Consultant
+ Service Cloud Consultant
+ Experience Cloud Consultant

* Advanced Project / Scaled Agile Management Certification (at least one):
+ PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2 Practitioner, or Senior Scrum Master credentials (CSM, PSM II).

* Expert\-level command over modern enterprise project management, portfolio tracking, and collaboration platforms such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smart sheet, and Google Workspace.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel internationally or domestically on a need basis.


**Desirable / Nice To Have**

* Strong functional awareness of data streaming and mid\-tier enterprise connectivity strategies, including MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, and real\-time, event\-driven architectures.
* Salesforce Agentforce Specialist or Legend certifications, with a proven playbook for managing and delivering Agentforce\-enabled autonomous AI agent work\-streams.

**About JustAct** 




 JustAct is an AI\-powered dispute resolution technology company building the digital infrastructure for faster, more accessible and more efficient dispute resolution.
 



  





 Our platform enables organisations to resolve disputes through technology\-enabled Negotiation, Mediation, Arbitration and allied legal services.
 



  





 We work with leading banks, NBFCs, enterprises, law firms, arbitral institutions and other organisations to transform how disputes are managed and resolved.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Legal Solutions Consultant – Enterprise \& Strategic Partnerships to help JustAct build and deepen relationships with organisations that have significant legal and dispute\-resolution requirements.
 



  





 This is not a conventional sales role.
 



  





 You will operate at the intersection of Law, Technology and Business, engaging with senior legal professionals, business leaders, law firms, financial institutions, arbitral institutions and other stakeholders to understand their challenges and develop the right JustAct solution.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be someone who can walk into a meeting with a senior lawyer, General Counsel, CXO, institutional head or partner at a law firm and engage with confidence, credibility and commercial maturity.
 



  





 You should be articulate, intellectually curious, commercially driven and comfortable representing JustAct at high\-quality professional forums and industry events.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



1. Identify and develop relationships with corporates, banks, NBFCs, law firms, arbitral institutions and other potential clients.
2. Build a strong pipeline of enterprise opportunities through direct outreach, referrals, professional networks, industry events and strategic relationships.
3. Understand the client's legal, operational and dispute\-resolution challenges and identify relevant JustAct solutions.
4. Own opportunities through the complete sales cycle — from initial conversation and discovery through solution presentation, proposal, negotiation and closure.
5. Develop and maintain relationships with senior decision\-makers including General Counsels, legal heads, business heads, CXOs, partners and institutional leaders.
6. Present and demonstrate JustAct's platform and services to prospective clients.
7. Prepare proposals, presentations, commercial proposals and solution recommendations.
8. Work closely with the product, legal, operations and customer success teams to develop appropriate solutions for enterprise clients.
9. Develop relationships with law firms, arbitration practitioners, mediators, arbitral institutions, industry bodies and other ecosystem stakeholders.
10. Represent JustAct at conferences, arbitration and ADR events, legal forums, seminars and industry networking opportunities.
11. Work with internal teams to ensure a high\-quality client experience and successful implementation.
12. Maintain an accurate enterprise sales pipeline and CRM.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



1. LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. / B.B.A. LL.B. or equivalent legal qualification.
2. 3–6 years of professional experience.
3. Excellent spoken and written English.
4. Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
5. Strong professional presence, confidence and maturity.
6. Ability to engage comfortably with senior lawyers, CXOs and institutional decision\-makers.
7. Strong understanding of the Indian legal and dispute\-resolution ecosystem.
8. Genuine interest in arbitration, mediation, legal technology and the future of dispute resolution.
9. Willingness to travel for client meetings, conferences and industry events.



  





**Why Join JustAct?** 



1. Build a career at the intersection of Law, Technology and Business.
2. Work with leading enterprises, financial institutions, law firms and dispute\-resolution institutions.
3. Represent JustAct at India's leading legal and ADR forums.
4. Work directly with senior stakeholders across the legal and business ecosystem.
5. Be part of a company building the digital infrastructure for dispute resolution.
6. Significant opportunity for growth into Enterprise Sales, Strategic Partnerships, Key Accounts and Business Leadership.
7. Compensation: Competitive fixed compensation plus performance\-linked incentives, commensurate with experience and profile.
